summary_a1m14_1_001.cn: 秦茳尺向你介绍了名为“危机合约”的神秘组织，以及他们送来的“礼物”——一个特别的协议空间。
summary_a1m14_1_001.en: Director Qin Jiangchi introduces a mysterious organization called the Contingency Contract and the "present" they bring. This happens to be a special Protocol Space.

summary_a1m16d1_1_001.cn: 你在天王坪遇见了正在寻找线索的巡卫左顾言，原来他正在调查天桩报告的几处出现异常的地方。
summary_a1m16d1_1_001.en: You encounter Watchguard Zuo Guyan at Sky King Flats. He has been charged to investigate several faulty sky poles and is looking for some leads.

summary_a1m16d1_2_001.cn: 左顾言没想到改进后的侦察装置是龙泡泡样貌的，被吓了一跳。你向他解释了息壤龙泡泡的侵蚀探测功能，准备批量生产息壤龙泡泡。
summary_a1m16d1_2_001.en: Zuo Guyan is surprised to see that the improved drone looks like a Chubby Lung. You explain to him that the Xiranite Chubby Lung comes with Blight detection feature as you prepare the AIC Factory for mass production.

summary_a1m16d1_3_001.cn: 你了解到陈千语出现在这里的原因后，左顾言前来和你告别，虽然他没猜出你的言外之意，但调查总要继续。你提出协助他研发并生产一款侦察装置，以便更快调查出事件的真相。
summary_a1m16d1_3_001.en: After you learn why Chen Qianyu came to this place, Zuo Guyan tells you that he is going to leave. He does not understand your plans but his investigations must continue. You propose to develop and produce a recon device that can aid his duties.

summary_a1m16d2_1_001.cn: 调查已经进行了一段时间，却没有找到任何线索。正当你和左顾言因此而沮丧时，刚回收完息壤龙泡泡的陈千语告诉了你们龙泡泡千奇百怪的损坏原因，其中一个引起了你的注意。
summary_a1m16d2_1_001.en: The investigation has been ongoing for a while but it has found no leads. Both you and Zuo Guyan are left feeling stumped. Chen Qianyu, who has just completed Xiranite Chubby Lung recovery, shares all sorts of reasons for drone malfunctions. One of them catches your attention.

summary_a1m16d3_1_001.cn: 你把大家叫到了天王坪，宣布将用这几天收集到的所有线索，解开谜题。
summary_a1m16d3_1_001.en: You call everyone to meet you at Sky King Flats and announce that you will be using all the leads gathered so far to solve the investigation.

summary_a1m16d3_3_001.cn: 你已知晓一切，开始向大家揭露事件的真相。原来导致所谓“异常报告”出现的真凶，居然是之前分发给大家的防护装置。
summary_a1m16d3_3_001.en: You have uncovered the truth and decide to reveal it to everyone. The actual culprit behind the "anomalous data" messages turns out to be the protective device previously issued to everyone.

summary_a1m2_1_001.cn: 终末地为派遣到新环境的干员准备了实地拓荒生存训练，你见到了四号谷地的教官克拉拉，开始训练吧。
summary_a1m2_1_001.en: Endfield has prepared a Frontiers Survival Training for operators dispatched to new environments. You find Instructor Klara in Valley IV — time to start the training!

summary_a1m3_1_001.cn: 你在工人之家见到了卡莉。了解后才知道，原来卡莉想和你一起画一本能让大家开心的故事书。
summary_a1m3_1_001.en: You meet Carly in the Worker Dorms and learn that she wants to make a storybook that will bring joy to everyone.

summary_a1m4_1_001.cn: 你在枢纽区基地见到了热情的赛尔乔·莱昂，她邀请你体验改编自真实事件的作品《影拓丰碑》。
summary_a1m4_1_001.en: You meet Sergio Leon at the Hub Base. She's buzzing with excitement and invites you to check out her adaptation of real-life events, titled "Umbral Monument".

summary_a1m5_1_001.cn: 你在生态种植区见到了罗曼，得知他们打算通过庆祝开拓节鼓舞士气，但因人手不足，需要你帮忙制作一些特色美食。
summary_a1m5_1_001.en: You meet Roman in the Eco-Farm. Turns out he and the crew mates plan to celebrate Exploration Day for morale boosting. However, they are short on hands and may need your help to make some specialty food.

summary_a1m5_6_001.cn: 开拓节结束后，你找到了罗曼。他感谢了你这段时间的帮助，并阐述了开拓节对四号谷地的意义。他相信，四号谷地终将渡过难关。
summary_a1m5_6_001.en: Exploration Day is over. You find Roman and he thanks you for helping him out during the holidays and explains the meaning of Exploration Day to Valley IV. He believes that Valley IV will eventually overcome the difficulties.

summary_a1m7_1_001.cn: 你在方兴衢见到了卡莉，她正在给武陵城的小朋友们讲故事。了解后才知道，卡莉想用你在武陵的冒险故事画一本故事书。
summary_a1m7_1_001.en: You meet Carly at Fangxing Avenue. She is telling stories to the local children. You talk to Carly and find out that she wants to draw a new storybook based on your adventures in the region of Wuling.

summary_a1m8d1_1_001.cn: 你在天师府学院门口看见了苦恼的彦宁，她似乎正在思考如何应对最近的侵蚀灾害。
summary_a1m8d1_1_001.en: You see a troubled Yan Ning at the entrance of the Tianshi Bureau Academy. She seems to be thinking about ways of handling the recent Blight disasters.

summary_a1m8d1_3_001.cn: 你帮助彦宁完成了息壤防护装置的迭代，她将新的防护装置命名为“息壤葫芦”，并提出之后的升级由她负责。此外，她还请求你帮忙生产息壤葫芦，送给需要的人。
summary_a1m8d1_3_001.en: You help Yan Ning upgrade the Xiranite-based protection device. She names it the "Xiranite Gourd" and promises to carry out all device upgrades in the future. Yan Ning also asks if you can help produce the Xiranite Gourds for the people who need them.

summary_a1m8d1_4_001.cn: 你来到了清波寨，发现了无痕对你刚刚送来的息壤葫芦持有怀疑的态度。在你的劝说下，了无痕和其他寨民们终于愿意试一试。
summary_a1m8d1_4_001.en: You arrive at Qingbo Stockade. However, Liao the Scarless is suspicious of the Xiranite Gourds you brought. You use your skills and successfully convince Liao and the other Stockaders to try out the Xiranite Gourds.

summary_a1m8d2_1_001.cn: 你刚进清波寨，就看见了重伤的了无痕。正当你以为是息壤葫芦没起作用时，了无痕告诉你，息壤葫芦保护了他。安全起见，你决定检查下清波寨外的侵蚀情况。
summary_a1m8d2_1_001.en: You enter Qingbo Stockade and see Liao the Scarless heavily injured. Just when you are doubting the Xiranite Gourd's effectiveness, Liao tells you how the device actually saved him. To play things safe, you decide to check the situation of the Blight outside Qingbo Stockade.

summary_a1m8d2_2_001.cn: 你离开清波寨后，正巧碰见了左顾言在寻找救过自己的寨民。与他短暂沟通后，他将息壤葫芦迭代升级后的配方交给了你。
summary_a1m8d2_2_001.en: You leave Qingbo Stockade and happen to run into Zuo Guyan. The watchguard is looking for a Stockader who saved his life. After a brief discussion, he hands you the formula for an upgraded version of the Xiranite Gourd.

summary_a1m8d3_1_001.cn: 你刚走进清波寨，伤势未愈的了无痕就扑了过来。原来是有寨民外出未归，但碰巧遇上周边环境突然恶化，寨民们都不敢外出寻找。
summary_a1m8d3_1_001.en: An injured Liao the Scarless rushes at you just as you enter Qingbo Stockade. He tells you that a few Stockaders went into the wilderness but have not yet returned. The ambient Blight has suddenly become worse, and none of the Stockaders dared to venture outside to find them.

summary_a1m8d3_2_001.cn: 你在清波寨门外见到了匆匆赶来的左顾言。当他得知寨民们都不敢外出寻找失踪的寨民时，便用自己在书里学到的激将法，帮助寨民们鼓起勇气外出寻找失踪的寨民。
summary_a1m8d3_2_001.en: After going out of the Qingbo Stockade gate, you see Zuo Guyan come rushing in. When he learns that the Stockaders lack the courage to look for their missing people, he uses an instigation technique he read about in the books and successfully encourages the Stockaders to start a search operation.

summary_a1m8d3_4_001.cn: 将失踪的寨民带回清波寨后，了无痕向你提起了一件往事。这时你才知道，原来左顾言一直寻找的救命恩人居然就在面前。
summary_a1m8d3_4_001.en: You find and bring the missing Stockaders back home. Liao the Scarless tells you a story from the past. It turns out that Zuo Guyan's savior has been pretty close by all this time.

summary_a1m9_2_001.cn: 维尔莫林希望你能够用他给你的种实参加比赛，让他培育的种实在比赛上出出风头。
summary_a1m9_2_001.en: Wellmorin hopes you can use the seeds he cultivated, win this cook-off competition, and make a name for his brand of seeds.

summary_a1m9_3_001.cn: 你们在田悯那里了解到，举办厨艺爱好者竞赛是为了用美食活跃氛围，让武陵城的居民暂时摆脱天使袭击的恐慌，于是你决定加入到比赛中。田悯告诉你，只要将参赛作品提交给主持人即可，主持人也会转达赛事评委的评价。
summary_a1m9_3_001.en: From Tian Min, you learn that the cooking competition aims to liven up the atmosphere with great food and ease public panic about Aggeloid attacks in Wuling. You decide to take part. Tian Min tells you to submit your dish to the competition host who will then give you the results.

summary_a1m9_6_001.cn: 正当你纠结在决赛中提交什么菜品时，佩丽卡帮你想到了那道你已经记不太清但最能代表“你”的食物。
summary_a1m9_6_001.en: While you struggle to think of a dish to prepare and submit for the final round, Perlica comes up with a food that best represents "you", even though you barely remember anything about it.

summary_a1m9_7_001.cn: 见识到了许多的“黑暗料理”后，你成功拿下了竞赛特等奖。依旧在苦恼自己项目的田悯，看上了你用在决赛作品中的种实，得知是维尔莫林提供的后，便与他交谈了起来。在众人欢声笑语中，阵列外侵蚀涌动。
summary_a1m9_7_001.en: After witnessing many dishes of the "dark cuisine", you secure the grand prize. Tian Min, still troubled by his project, becomes interested in the seeds you used and starts discussing them with your supplier, Wellmorin. The joyous atmosphere is suddenly interrupted by a Blight surge outside the array.

summary_c13m1_1_001.cn: 洁尔佩塔独自飘浮在空中，看着眼前的信纸发呆，身边还有许多货物。在询问后得知，四号谷地人手不足，她正在帮忙送货，也希望能让这里的人们重新振作精神。在她的邀请下，你决定帮她一起送货。
summary_c13m1_1_001.en: Gilberta floats alone in the air, staring blankly at the letter in her hand, surrounded by cargo. After asking, you learn that Valley IV is short handed. She is helping with deliveries while hoping to lift everyone's spirits. At her invitation, you decide to join her in making the rounds.

summary_c13m1_3_001.cn: 你与洁尔佩塔一起完成了调味剂的递送。收到包裹的工作人员大受感动。
summary_c13m1_3_001.en: You deliver the condiments with Gilberta. The recipient is extremely touched.

summary_c13m1_5_001.cn: 你与洁尔佩塔一起把精密零件递送给了安德烈，并从他口中得知，离心机明天就能顺利启动了。
summary_c13m1_5_001.en: You deliver the precision parts to Andre with Gilberta. His centrifuge can finally start working tomorrow.

summary_c13m1_7_001.cn: 你与洁尔佩塔一起把医疗物资递送给了米格尔，缓解了医疗物资短缺的压力。米格尔提到卡莉不愿意打针，洁尔佩塔打算先去找到卡莉。
summary_c13m1_7_001.en: You and Gilberta deliver the medical supplies to Miguel. The medical staff no longer needs to worry about a shortage of medication. Miguel says Carly refused to get her injections. Gilberta wants to find Carly first.

summary_c13m2_10_001.cn: 你们俯瞰着谷地，伤痕被刻在了这片土地上。
summary_c13m2_10_001.en: Your gazes sweep across the entire Valley, the wounds of the land lay bare for you to see.

summary_c13m2_12_001.cn: 卡莉告诉你和洁尔佩塔，她迷上了摄影，却怎么也拍不好。你提议去拍摄她喜欢的事物，卡莉则想让你为她和洁尔佩塔拍摄合影。
summary_c13m2_12_001.en: Carly tells you and Gilberta how she got started on photography. However, she does not know how to take a nice photo. You tell Carly to photograph things she likes. Carly wants you to take a photo of her with Gilberta.

summary_c13m2_20_001.cn: 你帮助卡莉拍摄了她和洁尔佩塔的合影，卡莉找到了想拍的事物，心满意足地回了医务室。
summary_c13m2_20_001.en: You help take a photo of Carly with Gilberta. Carly finds out what she wants to photograph, and happily heads back to the medical bay.

summary_c13m2_4_001.cn: 洁尔佩塔为自己没能更多地帮助饱受苦难的人们而感到自责，她决定前去寻找安德烈所需的过滤装置。
summary_c13m2_4_001.en: Gilberta blames herself for failing the people at the Power Plant. She decides to help look for the water purifier Andre needs.

summary_c13m2_5_001.cn: 工团的成员封锁了前方区域，在管理员斡旋下，封锁区域的负责人给了你们一段时间进行寻找。
summary_c13m2_5_001.en: Members of the UWST have blocked off the area ahead. Through your negotiations, the person in charge of the blocked off area has given you a limited time to search.

summary_c13m3_10_001.cn: 洁尔佩塔发现了女研究员的日记，她因侵蚀研究影响了记忆，在独自完成研究的过程中遗忘了所有，过去的日记成了她恐惧的源头。洁尔佩塔想到了自己，她也看过不一样的“记忆”。在你的安慰下，她决定坦然面对一切。
summary_c13m3_10_001.en: Gilberta finds the female researcher's diary. Her memory was damaged by Blight studies, and while working alone she forgot everything. Her old diaries became sources of fear. Gilberta sees herself in this. She's also seen different "memories." With your comfort, she decides to face it all head on.

summary_c13m3_13_001.cn: 你和洁尔佩塔从空中落下，她希望你能先行保管这封空白的信，等到她想好写满什么样的内容。你们二人就此定下约定。
summary_c13m3_13_001.en: You and Gilberta descend from the sky. She asks you to hold onto this blank letter until she figures out what to fill it with. The two of you make this promise right there.

summary_c13m3_1_001.cn: 你和洁尔佩塔取得了可能锁有过滤装置的保险柜，但没有开启它的密码。你们最终决定前往医务室，看看知晓密码的罗普目前的情况。
summary_c13m3_1_001.en: Although you and Gilberta have retrieved the safe that might contain the filter, no one has the password. Ropp is the owner of the safe and should know the password. Thus, you decide to head to the medical bay and see how the scientist is doing.

summary_c13m3_2_001.cn: 神志不清的罗普反复念叨着“小美”，这个名字对他而言似乎非常重要。
summary_c13m3_2_001.en: Though unconscious, Ropp is constantly mumbling the word "MASIE". This sounds like the name of someone very important to him.

summary_c13m3_4_001.cn: 这位工团成员没有听过“小美”，但提到罗普曾和一个神秘的女孩走得很近。可女孩很快就消失了。她告诉我们抢救回的文件的位置，或许那里面会有罗普相关的线索。
summary_c13m3_4_001.en: The worker doesn't know any "Masie," but she says Ropp used to hang around with some mysterious girl who disappeared soon after. She points you to where they stashed the rescued files... There might be some Ropp leads in there

summary_c13m3_5_001.cn: 工团的老人也没见过和罗普走得近的女孩，但罗普曾有一台遗失的终端存放在失物招领处。老人建议你们查查看。
summary_c13m3_5_001.en: Even the old timers at the UWST haven't seen any girl hanging around Ropp. But they mentioned he had a lost terminal sitting in the lost and found. The elder suggests you check it out.

summary_c13m3_7_001.cn: 你解除了保险柜的锁定。除了过滤装置，保险柜里还放着一封信。
summary_c13m3_7_001.en: You unlock the safe. It contains the filter as well as a letter.

summary_c13m3_8_001.cn: 罗普苏醒了，他告诉你们，“小美”其实是他和一名神秘女研究员的实验成果——一个侵蚀物质过滤装置。罗普非常珍视和那位研究员共度的时光，但对方却突然不辞而别，这令他意志消沉。你们带回来的信让他重新燃起了希望。
summary_c13m3_8_001.en: Ropp is awake. He says "Masie" was actually an experimental project he worked on with a mysterious female researcher: a Blight matter filtration device. Ropp cherished the time they spent together, but she left without saying goodbye, which crushed his spirit. That letter you brought has given him hope again.

summary_c13m3_9_001.cn: 用水问题得到解决，众人聚在一起庆祝。
summary_c13m3_9_001.en: Water's running again! Everyone's gathering to celebrate.

summary_c16m1_1_001.cn: 回到帝江号的静滞核心后，你在佩丽卡的协助下试图回忆起些什么，结果依然一无所获。突然，你看到了一道神秘的火光……
summary_c16m1_1_001.en: You return to the Stasis Core aboard Dijiang. With Perlica's assistance, you attempt to recover some of your memories. There is nothing at first, but then you suddenly catch a glimpse of a mysterious flame...

summary_c16m1_3_001.cn: 被神秘的痕迹所吸引，你来到了一片陌生的冰原，并在这里遇到了一位红发萨卡兹少女。得知你迷路后，她愿意带你走出这里。
summary_c16m1_3_001.en: Mysterious traces caught your attention and you suddenly find yourself in an unfamiliar icefield. You then meet a red-haired Sarkaz girl. She learns that you are lost and agrees to lead you out of the place.

summary_c16m1_4_001.cn: 你发现这里是一处散布着记忆碎片的协议空间，而那位红发少女希望能在此找到她失去的记忆。
summary_c16m1_4_001.en: You discover that this is a Protocol Space strewn with fragments of memories. The red-haired girl wants to find her lost memories in this place.

summary_c16m1_4d5_001.cn: 红发少女看到了一段关于自己的描述——那时她曾深入雪原，寻找属于她的记忆。
summary_c16m1_4d5_001.en: The red-haired girl sees writing that describes her. She once ventured into an icefield in search of her own memories.

summary_c16m1_4d7_001.cn: 一篇描述火焰崇拜的祷文，让红发少女想起了一段与火焰和大剑有关的往事，但她并不确定这段记忆是否真正属于她。
summary_c16m1_4d7_001.en: A prayer about the worship of fire. It reminds the red-haired girl of fire and a greatsword. However, she is uncertain if this memory belongs to her.

summary_c16m1_4d8_001.cn: 一首有关阵亡战士的短诗，让红发少女想起了曾在雪原上战斗的模糊经历。
summary_c16m1_4d8_001.en: A short poem about fallen warriors. It gives the red-haired girl fuzzy memories of fighting in a snowy icefield.

summary_c16m1_4d9_001.cn: 这段铭文描述了一把会反噬主人的火焰之剑，好像与红发少女手里的剑有所关联，但更多的细节仍然无法查明。
summary_c16m1_4d9_001.en: The engravings describe a flaming sword cursed to devour its wielder. The weapon seems related to the sword wielded by the red-haired girl. However, you fail to gather other details.

summary_c16m1_5_001.cn: 和红发少女有着相同容貌的诡异幻影在这里出现，试图阻止红发少女寻回记忆，战斗随即展开。
summary_c16m1_5_001.en: A strange illusion sharing the exact likeness of the red-haired girl appears. The illusion attempts to stop the red-haired girl from recovering her memories. A battle then commences.

summary_c16m1_6_001.cn: 红发少女解释道，方才遇到幻影曾多次阻挠她。接下来她要追上那个幻影，寻回记忆。在确认你管理员的身份之后，她独自离开，继续寻找记忆去了。
summary_c16m1_6_001.en: The red-haired girl explains that the illusion has attempted to stop her many times. She intends to chase down the illusion and recover the past. After confirming your identity as the Endministrator, she sets off on her own and continues her search for memories.

summary_c16m1_8_001.cn: 你离开协议空间，在静滞核心中醒来。在了解刚才发生的怪事之后，佩丽卡展开了调查。此时，联络员菲奥娜报告，神秘的火光伴随陌生的源石反应在四号谷地出现，你怀疑与那位红发少女有关，决定前去一探究竟。
summary_c16m1_8_001.en: You leave the Protocol Space and wake up in the Stasis Core. Perlica learns about your encounter and starts looking into this matter. Meanwhile, Fiona the comms officer reports the sighting of mysterious fires and strange Originium reactions in Valley IV. You suspect this is associated with the red-haired girl and decide to investigate.

summary_c16m2_1d5_001.cn: 红发少女似乎想要借助长耳兽寻找她的家乡，但没有成功。
summary_c16m2_1d5_001.en: The red-haired girl wants to use the long-ears to help find her home, but it does not seem to be working.

summary_c16m2_1d7_001.cn: 红发少女发现了一些过去的记录，但这些并非她想要寻找的记忆。
summary_c16m2_1d7_001.en: The red-haired girl finds some records from the past. However, they are not the memories she is looking for.

summary_c16m2_1d8_001.cn: 红发少女为找不到“家”的记忆而感到失望。她决定前往世代摇篮，继续这段寻找记忆的旅程。
summary_c16m2_1d8_001.en: The red-haired girl is disappointed when she fails to find memories about "home". She decides to continue her search at the Cradle of the Ages.

summary_c16m3_12_001.cn: 你们没有共同进入下一个协议空间。你决定想办法找到莱万汀。
summary_c16m3_12_001.en: You realize you did not enter the next Protocol Space together, and decide to go look for Laevatain.

summary_c16m3_2_001.cn: 已被打败的罗丹突然出现在协议空间里，并试图再度逞凶。面对不该出现在此处的他，你陷入困惑。幸好莱万汀及时出现，帮助你打破了假象。
summary_c16m3_2_001.en: Rhodagn, whom you have defeated before, makes a sudden appearance in the Protocol Space and attempts violence again. You are confused by his totally unexpected presence. Fortunately, Laevatain enters the place in time and helps you defeat this illusion.

summary_c16m3_3_001.cn: 得知你再次进入协议空间的目的之后，莱万汀提醒你留心被扭曲的、虚假的记忆，并宣布你已经是她寻找记忆的同行者。
summary_c16m3_3_001.en: After learning your aim for re-entering the Protocol Space, Laevatain warns you of twisted and false memories. She formally makes you her fellow companion in her memory search.

summary_c16m3_4_001.cn: 刚才的假象源自你失去记忆后对自己“管理员”身份的怀疑，而莱万汀也同样为类似的问题感到困扰，于是你们彼此相互安慰。
summary_c16m3_4_001.en: The illusion arose from your doubts in your role as the Endministrator. Laevatain is also troubled by a similar problem. The two of you try to comfort each other.

summary_c16m3_5_001.cn: 从被扭曲的记忆中，莱万汀看出了你内心害怕着些什么。
summary_c16m3_5_001.en: Laevatain identifies your inner fears from the twisted memory.

summary_c16m3_6_001.cn: 另一个“你”出现在你们面前，并宣称塔卫二不值得被拯救。这让你陷入了震惊与迷茫。在莱万汀的鼓励下，你决心打破这个假象。
summary_c16m3_6_001.en: The other "you" appears before you and declares that Talos-II deserves no redemption. You are shocked and confused. With Laevatain's encouragement, you become determined to dispel this illusion.

summary_c16m3_7_001.cn: 失去记忆的你，为自己能否真正成为“管理员”而感到担忧。为混乱记忆所困的莱万汀邀请你同行，你们就此立下互相帮助对方找回记忆的约定。
summary_c16m3_7_001.en: Due to your amnesia, you are worried if you have what it takes to become the true "Endministrator". Laevatain, who is also afflicted with polymnestic confusion, invites you to travel with her. And thus the two of you make a promise to help each other recover memories that truly belong to you.

summary_c16m4_12_001.cn: 莱万汀与你一起回到了帝江号。她决定作为你的干员留在这里，继续履行同伴的承诺，而你也要为她创造新的记忆。
summary_c16m4_12_001.en: Laevatain and you return to Dijiang together. She decides to stay, become an operator, and fulfill her promise to a fellow companion. She also expects you to create memorable moments with her.

summary_c16m4_1_001.cn: 在佩丽卡和菲奥娜的帮助下，你决定再次借助协议奇点，循着莱万汀在四号谷地留下的痕迹进入她所在的协议空间。
summary_c16m4_1_001.en: With Perlica and Fiona's help, you decide to use the Protocol Singularity to follow Laevatain's trail left across Valley IV and enter the Protocol Space where she is.

summary_c16m4_2_001.cn: 你和莱万汀在协议空间中会合，共同踏上寻找记忆的旅程。
summary_c16m4_2_001.en: Laevatain and you meet in the Protocol Space. Together, you start your memory-searching journey.

summary_c16m4_2d5_001.cn: 莱万汀的幻影在房间中出现，质疑莱万汀无法从记忆中找到存在的意义，但莱万汀不愿意就此放弃。
summary_c16m4_2d5_001.en: The illusion of Laevatain suddenly appears in the room and doubts if Laevatain could ever find her raison d'être from her memories. However, Laevatain does not intend to give up like this.

summary_c16m4_33_001.cn: 阿吉的幻影在这里出现，勾起了莱万汀脑海中的回忆，但这段记忆实际上并不属于她。
summary_c16m4_33_001.en: An illusion of Ginny appears and it triggers a memory fragment within Laevatain's mind. Unfortunately, that fragment is not hers to begin with.

summary_c16m4_34_001.cn: 裂地者的幻影在这里出现，让莱万汀再度为“不属于自己的记忆”所困扰。
summary_c16m4_34_001.en: An illusion of a Landbreaker appears. Laevatain is once again confused by seeing a "memory that is not hers".

summary_c16m4_35_001.cn: 莱万汀的身体因协议空间而受到了损伤，但她依然决心在这里找到真正属于自己的记忆。
summary_c16m4_35_001.en: Laevatain has been injured in her dive into the Protocol Space. However, she remains determined to locate her true memories here.

summary_c16m4_36_001.cn: 你被幻影所阻挡。描述了莱万汀的色彩之后，你得到指引，继续寻找她。
summary_c16m4_36_001.en: An illusion blocks your way. After describing Laevatain's color, you receive directions to look for her.

summary_c16m4_37_001.cn: 你被幻影所阻挡。告知莱万汀的名字之后，你得到新的指引，继续寻找她。
summary_c16m4_37_001.en: The illusions block your way. You share Laevatain's name and receive a new instruction. You then continue your search for her.

summary_c16m4_38_001.cn: 你向幻影打听莱万汀的踪迹。说出莱万汀的目的之后，你得到了幻影的帮助。
summary_c16m4_38_001.en: You ask the illusion for Laevatain's whereabouts. When you speak about Laevatain's goals, the illusion agrees to help.

summary_c16m4_39_001.cn: 莱万汀的幻影再度出现，试图说服你放弃莱万汀。
summary_c16m4_39_001.en: Illusion of Laevatain appears once more and persuades you to give up on her.

summary_c16m4_6_001.cn: 莱万汀感觉到史尔特尔“家乡”的所在，不顾一切地冲了出去。
summary_c16m4_6_001.en: Laevatain feels the existence of Surtr's "home" and rushes forth without thinking.

summary_c16m4_6d8_001.cn: 莱万汀已经到达了记忆的尽头，但仍然没有在“家乡”找到关于自己是谁的答案。你帮助面临崩溃危机的莱万汀重拾希望，向史尔特尔留下的“答案”进发。
summary_c16m4_6d8_001.en: Laevatain has reached the end of her memories, but she failed to find out who she was from "home". You give hope to Laevatain who is on the brink of breaking down. Together, you follow Surtr's "answer" and press forward.

summary_c16m4_7_001.cn: 你和莱万汀看到了史尔特尔最后的“答案”——她把罗德岛当作了自己的“家”，就此放下了过去的记忆。你邀请莱万汀前往终末地，希望以同样的方式帮助她解开心结。
summary_c16m4_7_001.en: You and Laevatain witness Surtr's final "answer" — she finally left her past memories behind and treated Rhodes Island as "home". You hope to use the same approach to solve Laevatain's dilemma and invite her to Endfield Industries.

summary_c16m4_7d5_001.cn: 这是一段史尔特尔珍视的记忆，她驯服了体内的火焰巨人，之后展开了游历和冒险之旅。
summary_c16m4_7d5_001.en: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about her taming of the flaming giant and how she started her journey and adventures.

summary_c16m4_7d7_001.cn: 这是一段史尔特尔珍视的记忆，关于她心心念念的冰淇淋。
summary_c16m4_7d7_001.en: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about ice cream and how deeply she cares about it.

summary_c16m4_7d8_001.cn: 这是一段史尔特尔珍视的记忆，关于她加入罗德岛时的经历。
summary_c16m4_7d8_001.en: Surtr's treasured memory fragment. It is about her experiences of joining Rhodes Island.

summary_c16m4_8_001.cn: 此处残余的记忆不甘被抛弃，于是转化为敌人，阻止你和莱万汀离开。
summary_c16m4_8_001.en: The remaining memory fragments refuse to be left behind. They turn hostile and try to stop you and Laevatain from leaving.

summary_c16m4_9_001.cn: 莱万汀下定决心，与剩余的记忆告别。
summary_c16m4_9_001.en: Laevatain is determined to say goodbye to the rest of her memories.

summary_c17m1_2_001.cn: 你找到了包裹，工人发现收件人是伊冯后有些紧张，担心包裹里是静态侵蚀样本，叮嘱你小心对待。
summary_c17m1_2_001.en: You find the package but the crew mates become slightly nervous when they realize that the recipient is Yvonne. The crew tells you to treat the package carefully as it may contain Static Blight samples.

summary_c17m1_3_001.cn: 你把包裹送到伊冯手上，得知只是些普通的颜料。伊冯表示它们已经用不上了，但她有个计划，邀请你加入。
summary_c17m1_3_001.en: You deliver the package to Yvonne and realize that it only contains simple paints. Yvonne says they are not needed anymore, but she has a plan and is inviting you aboard.

summary_c17m1_4_001.cn: 伊冯的计划原来是用颜料在源石实验园区内涂鸦。你们涂鸦时被法比安·柯林斯逮个正着，伊冯招呼你一起跑走。
summary_c17m1_4_001.en: Yvonne's plan is to use the paint for her Originium Science Park graffiti. Fabian Collins catches you in the act. Yvonne hollers at you to run away with her.

summary_c17m1_5_001.cn: 躲过法比安·柯林斯后，伊冯审视着涂鸦，表示这幅作品没能传递出内心的“呐喊”，邀请你陪她去枢纽区基地寻找灵感。
summary_c17m1_5_001.en: After hiding from Fabian Collins, Yvonne looks at her graffiti and says her work fails to deliver the "scream" she needs to get off her chest. She invites you to the Hub Base for inspiration.

summary_c17m2_10_001.cn: 你跟伊冯找到了所有的孩子，他们告诉你们，阿丽娅去了世代摇篮附近。
summary_c17m2_10_001.en: Yvonne and you find all the children. They tell you that Alia went somewhere close to the Cradle of the Ages.

summary_c17m2_11_001.cn: 你们希望阿丽娅推荐些取材地点，她惆怅地表示锚点破坏了一切。伊冯送出颜料，鼓励她画出源石大树。阿丽娅由此想到世代摇篮，准备带着你们过去。
summary_c17m2_11_001.en: You ask Alia to recommend a few places for inspiration. However, she is depressed and tells you that the Ankhors wrecked everything. Yvonne gives her paint and hopes she can draw the Great Originium Oak. This reminds Alia of the Cradle of the Ages and she offers to take you there.

summary_c17m2_12_001.cn: 在送别仪式上，伊冯鼓励了悲伤的孩子们。看着源石树苗，她对画面有了想法，提议前往超域试验场。
summary_c17m2_12_001.en: Yvonne encourages the grieving children during the Send-Off ceremony. Looking at the Originium sapling, she suddenly gets an idea about her painting, and suggests going to the Æther Test Site.

summary_c17m2_13_001.cn: 你们碰到了克劳，他打算把一些数据发给伊冯。这些数据也许能用来复原塔塔。
summary_c17m2_13_001.en: You run into Crowe. He intends to send Yvonne some data that might be useful in reviving Tata.

summary_c17m2_14_001.cn: 你从克劳处得知了伊冯的过去，以及她对终末地工业的看法。提到复原塔塔一事，克劳有些担心她是否做好了准备。
summary_c17m2_14_001.en: You talk with Crowe and learn about Yvonne's past as well as her opinions on Endfield Industries. When you mention the restoration of Tata, Crowe is a little worried that Yvonne might not be prepared.

summary_c17m2_15_001.cn: 克劳询问伊冯是否得到了更多伙伴，伊冯表示伙伴就在她的身边。
summary_c17m2_15_001.en: Crowe asks Yvonne if she has made more friends. Yvonne replies that her friends are by her side.

summary_c17m2_1_001.cn: 你们来到安德烈近乎报废的实验室，伊冯决定顺手帮他翻修。在她工作时，安德烈请你一起去维修停摆的电机外廊。
summary_c17m2_1_001.en: You arrive at Andre's lab which is almost completely wrecked. Yvonne decides to help him fix the situation. While she works, Andre invites you to repair the generator gangway power facility that broke down.

summary_c17m2_2_001.cn: 前去修复电力装置的路上，安德烈偷偷问你伊冯收到包裹后有什么表现。得知颜料被她拿去涂鸦后，他似乎松了口气。
summary_c17m2_2_001.en: While you're heading to the power facility for repair work, Andre secretly asks how Yvonne responded when she received the package. He breathes a sigh of relief when he learns that Yvonne used the paint to create graffiti.

summary_c17m2_3_001.cn: 电力装置修复完毕后，安德烈有些担心伊冯会把他的实验室大变样，赶紧招呼你一起回去。
summary_c17m2_3_001.en: The power facility has been repaired but Andre is worried about Yvonne's massive overhaul of his lab. He quickly asks if you want to head back with him.

summary_c17m2_5_001.cn: 安德烈请求你帮忙打听伊冯未来的打算。而伊冯为了寻找更多涂鸦的灵感，决定去电机外廊看看电力恢复测试时的景色。
summary_c17m2_5_001.en: Andre asks you to find out about Yvonne's future plans. Yvonne wants to get more inspiration for the graffiti and decides to head out to the generator gangway to witness the power restoration tests.

summary_c17m2_5d5_001.cn: 伊冯从灯光中获得了一些灵感，但似乎还是不太够。你提议再去矿脉源区看看。
summary_c17m2_5d5_001.en: Yvonne receives her inspiration from the lights but that still isn't enough. You recommend visiting the Origin Lodespring.

summary_c17m2_6_001.cn: 你带着伊冯来找阿丽娅，但对方不在。你们决定向其他人询问她的行踪。
summary_c17m2_6_001.en: You take Yvonne to meet Alia, but she is not around. You decide to ask around for her whereabouts.

summary_c17m2_7_001.cn: 你打听到今天要举行“送别仪式”，阿丽娅可能在照顾失去父母的孩子们，也可能被临时调走了。
summary_c17m2_7_001.en: You heard about the Send-Off ceremony. Alia is either caring for the children who lost their parents, or has been temporarily assigned elsewhere.

summary_c17m2_9_001.cn: 孩子们说，如果你们在游戏中获胜，他们就会告知阿丽娅的去向。伊冯拉着你一起扮演裂兽，玩起了捉迷藏。
summary_c17m2_9_001.en: The children say if you beat their game they will tell you where Alia went. Yvonne drags you in to act as manglerbeasts and play hide-and-seek with the children.

summary_c17m3_10_001.cn: 你们被防卫系统阻拦，伊冯决定另辟蹊径——启动传送带。
summary_c17m3_10_001.en: The defense system is in your way. Yvonne decides to create a shortcut — by activating the transport belt.

summary_c17m3_11_001.cn: 你们遇到了一扇会露出笑脸的门，它果然是伊冯的设计。
summary_c17m3_11_001.en: You run into a gate capable of giving a smiley. It was designed by Yvonne as well.

summary_c17m3_12_001.cn: 你们碰到了伊冯做的防御装置，需要设法通过面前的障碍。
summary_c17m3_12_001.en: You encounter defense systems that Yvonne made, and must find a way to overcome the obstacles.

summary_c17m3_13_001.cn: 伊冯想到了通行的办法，需要你在她进行准备的时候帮忙清理外面的天使。
summary_c17m3_13_001.en: Yvonne thinks about a way to pass through. She needs you to clear the Aggeloi outside while she prepares.

summary_c17m3_14_001.cn: 等待无人机搭建道路的间隙，你询问伊冯未来的打算。她表示自己并没想好，但作为终末地的干员，会听你的指挥，也希望你会在她遇到阻碍时支持她。
summary_c17m3_14_001.en: While waiting for the drones to repair the road, you ask Yvonne about her plans for the future. She tells you she has not figured it out but as an Endfield operator, she will heed your commands. Yvonne also hopes you will lend your support when she runs into problems.

summary_c17m3_15_001.cn: 伊冯正在此处取材，收集灵感时，忽然反问你未来的打算。而此时，出现了一群危险的天使……
summary_c17m3_15_001.en: Yvonne is gathering inspiration here when she suddenly asks you about your own plans for the future. Just then, a group of dangerous Aggeloi shows up...

summary_c17m3_17_001.cn: 伊冯邀请你跟她一起参与塔塔的复原工作，表示她、终末地的大家、塔塔会跟你一起抵达“遥远的目的地”……
summary_c17m3_17_001.en: Yvonne invites you to take part in her Tata Restoration Project. She tells you that she, Tata, and every Endfielder will join you and reach the "faraway destination" together...

summary_c17m3_18_001.cn: 电梯权限被锁，伊冯打算留下破解控制主板，拜托你去寻找工团的语音日志，以获取启动口令。
summary_c17m3_18_001.en: Elevator access has been locked. Yvonne decides to stay behind to hack the control panel and asks you to search for UWST audio logs to acquire the activation command.

summary_c17m3_19_001.cn: 伊冯向你介绍工团的设计风格与她自己的设计理念，她希望自己的造物能有更多人情味。
summary_c17m3_19_001.en: Yvonne introduces the UWST style of design as well as her own style to you. She wants her creations to feel more friendly and human.

summary_c17m3_1_001.cn: 伊冯将获得的灵感加入涂鸦，但她依旧觉得不够完美。她邀请你最后再去一个地方。
summary_c17m3_1_001.en: Yvonne adds the inspiration she acquired to her graffiti but still believes it is not yet perfect enough. She invites you to one final place.

summary_c17m3_20_001.cn: 工人们在语音日志里提到了新的启动口令——“超级迭代人”。
summary_c17m3_20_001.en: From the audio logs, the crew mates mention a new activation command: "Super Iterator."

summary_c17m3_2_001.cn: 你们从工人处听说，一些天使闯入了地下车间，伊冯表示可以帮忙解决。
summary_c17m3_2_001.en: The crew mates tell you that a few Aggeloi made it to the underground production floors. Yvonne is certain she can take care of them.

summary_c17m3_3d5_001.cn: 伊冯表示自己以前就在这里工作，想再去更下层的区域找找灵感。这时你们发现了天使的踪迹。
summary_c17m3_3d5_001.en: Yvonne tells you that she worked here before and she intends to head to the lower floors for inspiration. This is when you find traces of Aggeloid activity.

summary_c17m3_4_001.cn: 你们一起重启了电梯。聊天时，伊冯提到这个片区之前都是她一个人在用。
summary_c17m3_4_001.en: You restart the elevator together. During the dialog, Yvonne mentions that she was the only user of this entire area.

summary_c17m3_5_001.cn: 击败天使后，伊冯走到一扇门前，但踯躅不前。在你的鼓励下，她决定跟你一起进去。
summary_c17m3_5_001.en: After defeating the Aggeloi, Yvonne walks up to a door but hesitates. With your encouragement, she decides to go in with you.

summary_c17m3_6_001.cn: 这个房间是伊冯一开始研究塔塔的地方。她向你吐露了心声，告诉你颜料的秘密——那是她准备给塔塔做新涂装用的。
summary_c17m3_6_001.en: The room is where Yvonne first worked on Tata. She shares her feelings with you and the secret about the paint. She originally ordered the paint to give Tata a new coating.

summary_c17m3_7_001.cn: 伊冯表示自己没事了，你们准备离开此处。
summary_c17m3_7_001.en: Yvonne tells you she's alright. You prepare to leave the place.

summary_c17m3_8_001.cn: 从地下车间返回，你们碰到了法比安·柯林斯。伊冯表示会擦掉涂鸦，但对方却说大家很喜欢这幅有生机的作品，希望她能把涂鸦完成。
summary_c17m3_8_001.en: You reach the surface from the underground production floors and run into Fabian Collins. Yvonne tells him that she will wash away the graffiti, but Fabian informs her that everyone actually likes the lively work and hopes to see it complete.

summary_c17m3_9_001.cn: 伊冯表示自己会复原塔塔，但她的情绪依旧有些低落。在你的安慰下，伊冯打起精神，带着你前往她的实验室。
summary_c17m3_9_001.en: Yvonne tells you that she will restore Tata but she still feels a little sad. You comfort her and she gets back to her feet, and brings you to her lab.

summary_c1m2_1_001.cn: 乔瓦尼指出了碾骨氏族在谷地通道的几处藏匿点。你和狼卫决定分头行动，迅速排查。

summary_c1m2_2_001.cn: 你从乔瓦尼处获得了有关狼卫的些许情报。

summary_c1m2_3_001.cn: 在出发前，你从狼卫口中了解了一些散碎信息。

summary_c1m2_8_001.cn: 废弃据点的诸多迹象疑点重重。经过情报讨论，你决定相信狼卫的判断，深入谷地通道深处的要塞进行调查。

summary_c1m2_9_001.cn: 乔瓦尼趁乱逃离，对他有所防备的狼卫早已在他身上留下了追踪信标。

summary_c1m3_10_001.cn: 狼卫向你分享了他的过去。他建议你保留他的追踪器——从此，你随时都能知道他在哪里。

summary_c1m3_13_001.cn: 乔瓦尼向你们透露了电梯的密码：3786151。

summary_c1m3_1_001.cn: 哈伦准备用炸药毁掉整个要塞。你拒绝了狼卫独自深入的提议，选择与他一同阻止哈伦的邪恶计划。

summary_c1m3_3_001.cn: 裂地者们拒绝了乔瓦尼的再次投诚。听到乔瓦尼提及“卢卡”这一名字，狼卫突然变得激动了起来。

summary_c1m3_4_001.cn: 你和狼卫救下了乔瓦尼，但狼卫此时似乎除了卢卡便无暇顾及其余事物。

summary_c1m3_5_001.cn: 据哈伦所说，为了惩戒叛徒，他杀死了狼卫的弟弟卢卡。

summary_c1m3_7_001.cn: 乔瓦尼告知狼卫，卢卡也许并未遭哈伦杀害。随后，乔瓦尼突然死于复仇心切的工团工人之手。

summary_c1m3_9_001.cn: 狼卫用狼群的仪式安葬了乔瓦尼。善恶总在一念之间，而独狼只有主宰与被主宰两条路可走。

summary_c27m1_10_001.cn: 你再次向河佬询问汤汤的去向，但河佬却露出为难的神色，不愿直说，只是暗示你可以靠偷听得到线索。
summary_c27m1_10_001.en: You ask He Lao again for Tangtang's whereabouts but the Stockader looks hesitant. He only hints about something he heard while snooping around.

summary_c27m1_12_001.cn: 通过偷听石牙和浪头的交谈，你得知汤汤就在水车边上。
summary_c27m1_12_001.en: You eavesdrop on Stonefang and Lang Tou's conversation, and learn that Tangtang is near the waterwheel.

summary_c27m1_7_001.cn: 在水车附近，你看到汤汤抱着阮一的角发泄着心中的愤懑，刚想上前，埋伏着的阮一残党向你们攻来。
summary_c27m1_7_001.en: You see Tangtang near the waterwheel. She is unloading her emotions and anger while holding Ruan Yi's horn. While approaching her, you are suddenly ambushed by the remnants of Ruan Yi's loyalists.

summary_c27m1_9_001.cn: 你向汤汤询问了她的近况，汤汤却坚持自己没事，不愿多讲。她告诉你，阮一有位手下叫做商叔，阮一死后，商叔一直伺机报复。
summary_c27m1_9_001.en: You ask Tangtang how she is holding up. Tangtang insists that she is alright and refuses to say more. She then tells you about a follower of Ruan Yi named Uncle Shang and his schemes of vengeance.

summary_c27m2_10_001.cn: 在地下水渠中，阮一残党布置好了炸药，汤汤不知如何拆解，只能离开地下水渠，寻求帮助。
summary_c27m2_10_001.en: Ruan Yi's loyalists have placed explosives in the underground canal. Tangtang does not know how to disarm them, and is forced to leave the canal and seek help.

summary_c27m2_11_001.cn: 汤汤撞见了弭弗，事情紧急，她却不知该不该和盘托出。汤汤两难之际，你出来帮她解围。
summary_c27m2_11_001.en: Tangtang runs into Mi Fu. Despite the desperate situation, she wonders if she should tell the watchguard captain about everything. While she hesitates, you step forward to resolve the dilemma.

summary_c27m2_12_001.cn: 你帮助汤汤拆除炸弹后，她终于卸下心防，请求你和她一起阻止阮一残党再次袭击武陵。
summary_c27m2_12_001.en: After helping Tangtang disarm the bomb, the Stockade Chief finally opens up. She asks you to help her stop Ruan Yi's loyalists and their attacks on Wuling.

summary_c27m2_14_001.cn: 汤汤接到青芜的消息，得知进入武陵城的阮一残党共有四人，一人前往市民广场，其他人在方兴衢。随后，汤汤以信号不好为由挂掉了你发来的远程通信。
summary_c27m2_14_001.en: Tangtang receives Qingwu's message and learns that four of Ruan Yi's loyalists have infiltrated Wuling. One went to the Citizen Square while the rest went to Fangxing Avenue. Tangtang suddenly says she is getting poor signal connection and rejects your radio call.

summary_c27m2_1_001.cn: 你找到青芜后，她交给了你汤汤的礼物——一大把汤汤券。言谈间，你留意到青芜不愿透露来武陵城的目的。
summary_c27m2_1_001.en: You find Qingwu and she gives you a present from Tangtang — a wad of Tangtang Certs. During the conversation, you notice that Qingwu is keeping her lips tight about her reasons for coming to Wuling.

summary_c27m2_4_001.cn: 得知阮一残党有可能在方兴衢会合，汤汤决定前往调查。
summary_c27m2_4_001.en: Having learned that Ruan Yi's loyalists may be meeting up at Fangxing Avenue, Tangtang decides to investigate.

summary_c27m2_6_001.cn: 汤汤通过打听得知，阮一残党正在跟踪一个穿着黑衣服的人，汤汤判断，他们可能是冲着你来的。
summary_c27m2_6_001.en: After asking around, Tangtang learns that Ruan Yi's loyalists are tracking someone dressed in black. She deduces that they are after you.

summary_c27m2_7_001.cn: 来到火锅店，汤汤决定从阮一残党手中救出管理员，却碰到了同样穿着黑衣的大潘，才发现只是一场误会。
summary_c27m2_7_001.en: Tangtang arrives at the hot pot eatery and decides to rescue the Endmin from Ruan Yi's loyalists. However, she runs into Da Pan who is also dressed in black and realizes it is just a misunderstanding.

summary_c27m3_11_001.cn: 顺着足迹，你和汤汤跟上了洗浊，并且探听到阮一残党藏匿的地方。
summary_c27m3_11_001.en: Tangtang and you follow Dirt Rinser's footprints and track him down. You also acquire the location of the loyalist hideout.

summary_c27m3_6_001.cn: 击退了阮一残党后，你发现汤汤受了伤，于是给她敷了药。随后，你们决定去追逃跑的洗浊。
summary_c27m3_6_001.en: You defeat Ruan Yi's loyalists and find out that Tangtang has been wounded. After treating her injuries, you decide to chase down the fleeing Dirt Rinser.

summary_c27m4_11_001.cn: 你陪着汤汤将阮一的角埋在了祖泉边上。
summary_c27m4_11_001.en: You accompany Tangtang as she buries Ruan Yi's horn next to the Ancestral Spring.

summary_c27m4_13_001.cn: 你们来到湖边，雾气弥漫，汤汤决定追进迷雾，前往阮一残党的藏匿之处。
summary_c27m4_13_001.en: You arrive at the lakeshore and see a thick fog. Tangtang decides to go into the fog and find the hiding spot of Ruan Yi's loyalists.

summary_c27m4_3_001.cn: 在阮一残党的藏身处，你们亲眼目睹一些坚决要向武陵寻仇的寨民加入了裂地者。汤汤非常气愤，发誓绝不会放任寨子分裂。
summary_c27m4_3_001.en: You enter the hiding place of Ruan Yi's loyalists. There, you witness a few Stockaders who want vengeance against Wuling joining the Landbreakers. Tangtang is infuriated and swears to keep her Stockade in one piece.

summary_c27m4_4_001.cn: 洗浊不敌汤汤和你，于是乘着唯一的竹筏离开。你们只能另外寻找道路继续深入。
summary_c27m4_4_001.en: Dirt Rinser is no match for Tangtang and you. He took the only bamboo raft and escaped. You are forced to find another way to get deeper into the hideout.

summary_c27m4_5_001.cn: 你们发现了阮一的房间，汤汤想看看阮一在这里藏了什么。
summary_c27m4_5_001.en: You discover Ruan Yi's room. Tangtang wants to see if Ruan Yi hid anything at this place.

summary_c27m4_6_001.cn: 你们在阮一的房间发现了汤汤父亲的遗物——天师仪，你们意识到，武陵与清波寨有着不小的渊源。
summary_c27m4_6_001.en: You search Ruan Yi's room and find a Tianshi apparatus, an heirloom from Tangtang's father — You realize that Wuling and Qingbo Stockade might share a common history.

summary_c27m4_8_001.cn: 你们见到了商叔，汤汤试图说服商叔放弃复仇，但商叔却固执己见，双方只能一战。
summary_c27m4_8_001.en: You meet Uncle Shang. Tangtang tries to persuade Uncle Shang to give up vengeance but he stubbornly refuses. You have no choice but to fight.

summary_c27m4_9_001.cn: 你们打败了商叔。为了劝说商叔回心转意，汤汤将阮一的角赠送给他。商叔拒绝收下阮一的角，但却与汤汤暂时达成一致，先清理寨子里的裂地者。
summary_c27m4_9_001.en: You defeat Uncle Shang. To persuade him to change his mind, Tangtang gives him Ruan Yi's horn. Uncle Shang declines it, but arrives at a temporary consensus to clean out the Landbreakers lurking in the Stockade.

summary_c27m5_10_001.cn: 回到清波寨的路上，汤汤接受了你的邀请。她愿意加入终末地，寻找一个独属于自己的答案。
summary_c27m5_10_001.en: While traveling to Qingbo Stockade, Tangtang accepts your invitation. She agrees to join Endfield and look for her own answers.

summary_c27m5_1_001.cn: 你来到方兴衢与汤汤会面，发现她正试图从一个孩子的手中拿到气球。
summary_c27m5_1_001.en: You head to Fangxing Avenue to meet up with Tangtang, and find her trying to get a balloon from a kid.

summary_c27m5_2_001.cn: 你买了一个气球送给汤汤。她告诉你，今天她到武陵城是应弭弗的邀请来办正事，你发现汤汤还没有吃东西，决定先带她吃些什么。
summary_c27m5_2_001.en: You buy a balloon for Tangtang. She tells you that Mi Fu invited her to Wuling for official business. You realize that Tangtang has not eaten yet, and thus decide to treat her to some food.

summary_c27m5_4_001.cn: 你们来到大潘的火锅店大吃一顿，汤汤被火锅辣得直冒汗。
summary_c27m5_4_001.en: You arrive at Da Pan's hotpot place for a feast. Tangtang sweats profusely as she downs the super spicy hot pot.

summary_c27m5_8_001.cn: 吃火锅时，汤汤告诉你自己来武陵城是为了见庄方宜一面。
summary_c27m5_8_001.en: While eating the hotpot, Tangtang tells you that she is visiting Wuling to meet Zhuang Fangyi.

summary_c27m5_9_001.cn: 总桩办公室内，汤汤希望武陵能够网开一面，放过作乱的寨民，自己会肩负起大当家的责任，确保武陵城和清波寨的和平。庄方宜也承诺向清波寨予以援助。
summary_c27m5_9_001.en: The discussion starts in the Main Pillar Office. Tangtang wants Wuling to pardon the Stockaders who caused trouble, and promises that she will be a proper Chief and keep the peace between Qingbo Stockade and Wuling City. Zhuang Fangyi also agrees to aid the Stockade.

summary_c28m1_2_001.cn: 你在裂地者营地附近遇到了终末地干员洛茜，她也接到了菲奥娜的联络，前来寻找样本。你们二人决定结伴行动，继续任务。
summary_c28m1_2_001.en: You find Endfield operator Rossi near a Landbreaker Camp. She also received Fiona's call and came here to look for the missing sample. The two of you decide to continue this mission as a team.

summary_c28m1_3_001.cn: 你和洛茜顺着线索一路追踪，却出人意料地遇到了一群骑士装扮的小孩。你们用配合孩子们过家家的方式收获了他们的好感。通过询问，你们得知是这群孩子从裂地者营地拿走了样本，并将其交给了扮演“国王”的孩子。
summary_c28m1_3_001.en: You and Rossi follow the traces and unexpectedly run into a group of children dressed up as knights. You play along their make-believe game and earn their friendship. You then ask them a few questions and learn that the children acquired the sample from the Landbreaker Camp and gave it to a child who plays the role of the "King".

summary_c28m1_6_001.cn: 你们来到一处山洞，发现一群孩子正围着手持权杖的小孩玩闹。你们得知他就是“国王”。红色的样本容器被他当作了宝石挂在了权杖上。他拒绝归还权杖，并提议用另外两件“王国宝物”进行交换。
summary_c28m1_6_001.en: You arrive at a cave and find a group of children playing with a boy wielding a scepter in the middle. You learn that the scepter-wielding boy is the "King" and he has attached the red sample jar to his scepter as its crowning jewel. The "King" refuses to offer up his scepter and proposes exchanging it for two "Treasures of the Kingdom".

summary_c28m2_1_001.cn: 你们见到了“风铃公爵”，但“王国宝物”——“圣剑”并不在她手中，而是被插在了危险的集装箱高处。你们决定帮她取回“圣剑”。
summary_c28m2_1_001.en: You meet the "Duchess of Windbell" but she does not have the "Treasure of the Kingdom" known as the "Holy Sword". It turns out that it has been plunged into a cargo container perched at a dangerous height. You decide to help her retrieve the "Holy Sword".

summary_c28m2_2_001.cn: 你们将“圣剑”取回，“风铃公爵”则爽快地把“圣剑”交给了你们。她急于拿回剑，原来是因为想得到剑上的花环，以此安慰身旁哭泣的小孩。
summary_c28m2_2_001.en: You retrieve the "Holy Sword". The "Duchess of Windbell" is quick to give you the treasure as promised. Turns out she actually wants the floral wreath on the sword to soothe the crying child next to her.

summary_c28m2_4_001.cn: 你们赢得了游戏，“发条公爵”却不想认账。其他孩子不满于他耍赖的举动，纷纷离他而去。焦急的“发条公爵”交出了盾牌，想要和伙伴们重归于好。
summary_c28m2_4_001.en: You win the game but the "Duke of Clockwork" refuses to admit defeat. The other children are displeased with his unreasonable actions and leave his side. A desperate "Duke of Clockwork" finally gives up the Shield to keep his friends around.

summary_c28m2_6_001.cn: “发条公爵”是一名有些跋扈的男孩，他霸占着另一件“宝物”——“坚盾”，并坚称只有在捉源石虫的游戏上赢过他，才愿意交出“宝物”。你们决定尝试一下。
summary_c28m2_6_001.en: The "Duke of Clockwork" is quite a bossy boy who clings to the "Treasure" known as the "Strong Shield". He will only give up the "Treasure" if you beat him in the game of catching Originium Slugs. You decide to give it a go.

summary_c28m3_10_001.cn: 你们救出了“国王”，孩子们把你们视作了英雄。“国王”兑现了承诺，将样本还给了你们。原来他让你们取回宝物，为的是继续孩子们的过家家游戏。孩子们将你们二人视作了新的朋友，并给予了你们相应的“骑士封号”。
summary_c28m3_10_001.en: You save the "King" and the children treat you as heroes. The "King" fulfills his promise and returns the sample. It turns out that he wants the two treasures just to continue the "Kingdom" game. The children name you and Rossi as their new friends and "knight" you in honor of this friendship.

summary_c28m3_12_001.cn: “国王”再次被矿道中的动静吓到，你们停下了脚步。洛茜继续讲起了狼群里流传的故事，告诉“国王”——他的恐惧或许只是来源于自己的想象。
summary_c28m3_12_001.en: The "King" is surprised by the sounds and movements in the mining trail. You are forced to stop. Rossi continues the old story of the Pack and tells the "King" this lesson: His fear might be caused by his imaginations.

summary_c28m3_14_001.cn: 孩子们告诉你们，眼前这些上升气流被他们称作“超级熔岩蹦床”，通过它们也可以深入“王国”内部。
summary_c28m3_14_001.en: You see gas vent updrafts in this place. The children call them "Super Lava Trampolines" and you can use them to head deeper into the "Kingdom".

summary_c28m3_19_001.cn: 你们遇到了几个相似的集装箱，分别通往不同的方向。孩子们告诉你们，附近生活的长耳兽也许能够帮助你们找到一条正确的路。
summary_c28m3_19_001.en: You see several identical cargo container paths leading to different places. The children tell you that the long-ears living nearby might lead you to the correct path.

summary_c28m3_1_001.cn: 你们回到了“积木王国”入口，这里陷入了一片骚乱。询问后得知，不久前一群裂地者闯入了这里。孩子们利用熟识地形的优势逃了出来，但“国王”仍滞留在里面。情况紧急，你们决定立刻动身展开救援。
summary_c28m3_1_001.en: You return to the entrance to the "Kingdom of Brickyland" but the place is in chaos. You found out that a band of Landbreakers broke in. The children escaped as they are familiar with the cave, but their "King" is still trapped. The situation is desperate, so you immediately start a rescue operation.

summary_c28m3_23_001.cn: 你们成功回收了样本，但洛茜却提出想多留在这里一会儿。你猜测她想像孩子们一样在这里游玩，却被她矢口否认。你心领神会，表示会替她保密。
summary_c28m3_23_001.en: You successfully retrieve the sample but Rossi wants to stay for a while longer. You guess she wants to keep playing with the children, though she strongly denies it. With tacit understanding, you promise to help her keep this secret.

summary_c28m3_2_001.cn: 你们进入了“积木王国”。眼前许多设施已经被碾骨氏族破坏，路线无法走通，通信器另一端的孩子们告诉你们，可以通过“勇者之路”继续前行。
summary_c28m3_2_001.en: You enter the "Kingdom of Brickyland". The Bonekrushers have smashed many of the things inside the place and the paths have been blocked. The children call you by radio and tell you to take the "Trail of the Brave".

summary_c28m3_3_001.cn: 你们前进的路被一个转盘所阻挡，孩子们告诉你们，这是他们平时玩的“旋转木马”。但眼下“旋转木马”没电了，需要按顺序启动附近的电源开关才能让“旋转木马”重新旋转，带你们到对面。
summary_c28m3_3_001.en: The path is blocked by a rotating platform. The children tell you that it is the "swiftbeast carousel" that they often play with. The ride is out of power. You must activate the power switches nearby in the right sequence to rotate the carousel and reach the other side.

summary_c28m3_4_001.cn: 你们进入了“积木王国”的宝库，这里被孩子们布置得十分杂乱。很多地方无法通行，你们决定先找到一条通往出口的路。
summary_c28m3_4_001.en: You enter the "Brickyland Vault". The children have stored all sorts of things in a disorganized fashion. Many places have been blocked. You decide to find a way to the exit.

summary_c28m3_6_001.cn: 你们遇到了孩子们精心放置的“积木大军”，成片的箱子挡住了去路。孩子们告诉你们，进入“王国宫殿”的钥匙就在某一个“纸箱将军”身上。
summary_c28m3_6_001.en: You run into the "Bricky Legion" that the children meticulously placed. An entire army of crates blocks your way. The children tell you that a particular "General Crate" carries the key for entering the "Kingdom Palace".

summary_c28m3_7_001.cn: 你们乘坐电梯，来到“宫殿”前。这里聚集了不少碾骨氏族的人，他们似乎也在寻找着什么。洛茜判断“国王”应该还算安全。你们需要打倒此处的碾骨氏族，找到“国王”的踪迹。
summary_c28m3_7_001.en: You take the elevator and arrive at the "Palace". Many Bonekrushers have gathered here and they seem to be looking for something. Rossi deduces that the "King" is still safe. You must defeat the Bonekrushers intruders and find the "King".

summary_c28m3_8_001.cn: 获救的“国王”受到了惊吓，误以为洛茜是传言中的“赤红怪物”。在你们的安慰下，他逐渐冷静下来，原来他是想掩护其他孩子逃走才主动留了下来。洛茜称赞了他的勇敢，鼓励他一起穿过昏暗的矿道，离开这里。
summary_c28m3_8_001.en: The rescued "King" is quite shocked. He mistakes Rossi for the legendary "Red Monster" and the boy only calms down after you comfort him. The "King" actually chose to stay behind to help the other children escape. Rossi praises him for his courage and encourages him to pass through a dark mining trail to leave the place.

summary_c28m3_9_001.cn: 头顶的岩石突然碎裂，砸在了你们面前，“国王”受到了惊吓，不愿继续前进。你建议洛茜鼓励一下“国王”，洛茜决定给他讲一个故事。
summary_c28m3_9_001.en: The rocks above suddenly break apart and fall in front of you. The "King" is extremely shocked and refuses to go any further. Rossi accepts your advice to encourage the "King" by telling him a story.

summary_c31m1_1_001.cn: 你来到总桩办公室与弭弗会合，发现庄方宜已经失踪。唯一线索是现场留下的一封信，说会在竹林做个了断。
summary_c31m1_1_001.en: You meet Mi Fu at the Main Pillar Office and find Zhuang Fangyi missing. The only lead is a letter she left at the place that mentions that a decision will be made at the Stragglers Grove.

summary_c31m1_2_001.cn: 三位幕后主使现身，他们是弭弗过去的师父，曾经抚养弭弗并教她武艺。当时弭弗允诺传承清波武艺，挑战武陵，如今却“背弃”了誓言。师父们要求与弭弗对决，她获胜后才会放了庄方宜。
summary_c31m1_2_001.en: The three individuals who planned the entire thing are revealed to be Mi Fu's masters of martial combat. Mi Fu once promised to learn the Qingbo combat arts to fight Wuling, but she has "betrayed" her oath. Now her former masters demand a fight. Mi Fu must win for them to release Zhuang Fangyi.

summary_c31m1_3_001.cn: 弭弗向你讲述了她和三位师父——清波寨“三绝”的过去。你允诺与弭弗一同面对挑战。
summary_c31m1_3_001.en: Mi Fu tells you about her training with the Three Masters of Qingbo Stockade. You promise to face the challenges together with her.

summary_c31m1_4_001.cn: 你和弭弗一起来到了她闭关备战的地方。在介绍了三位师父之后，弭弗与你为了准备比武而展开训练。
summary_c31m1_4_001.en: You and Mi Fu arrive at her isolated training place to prepare for battle. After introducing her three masters, Mi Fu begins training for the upcoming bout together with you.

summary_c31m2_11_001.cn: 你和弭弗按照约定踏上擂台，二师父却迟迟不见身影。二师父的弟子主动上台挑战弭弗。
summary_c31m2_11_001.en: Mi Fu and you step onto the arena as promised but the Senior Master is nowhere to be seen. Instead, his disciples seize the initiative and answer your challenge.

summary_c31m2_12_001.cn: 你与弭弗成功击败了二师父，却得知这是二师父试图挽回弭弗的方法。此时大师父出现，告诉弭弗，如果她肯在最后一场比武前认错并重归师门，就能放了庄方宜。这让弭弗陷入了两难。
summary_c31m2_12_001.en: Mi Fu and you successfully defeat the Senior Master but realize that the challenge was his attempt to bring Mi Fu back into the fold. The Grand Master then shows up. He tells Mi Fu that if she admits her errors and returns to the school, he will release Zhuang Fangyi. This forces Mi Fu into a dilemma.

summary_c31m2_14_001.cn: 面对实力悬殊、几乎无法战胜的大师父，弭弗陷入了沉思。你表示会始终站在弭弗这一边。
summary_c31m2_14_001.en: Mi Fu ponders long and hard about her Grand Master, who outmatches her in every way. The fight will be nearly impossible to win. You tell Mi Fu that you will stand by her, no matter what her choice is.

summary_c31m2_15_001.cn: 三位师父同时出现，提出了你始料未及的要求……
summary_c31m2_15_001.en: All three masters appear and make an unexpected proposal...

summary_c31m2_2_001.cn: 你和弭弗来到比武场地的入口，负责检查武器的守门弟子是弭弗的旧识。叙旧过后，她带你们前往擂台。
summary_c31m2_2_001.en: Mi Fu and you arrive at the entrance of the arena. The gatekeeping disciple is an old acquaintance of Mi Fu. After a brief conversation of the good old days, she leads the both of you to the fighting grounds.

summary_c31m2_3_001.cn: 击败三师父后，你们得知之后还有两场对决，需要分别对战二师父和大师父。你们只能继续备战。
summary_c31m2_3_001.en: After defeating Mi Fu's Master, you learn that two more fights against the Senior Master and the Grand Master have been arranged. You have no choice but to prepare.

summary_c31m2_4_001.cn: 你正与弭弗准备与二师父的比武。在备战间隙，弭弗回忆了自己当初是如何从一个挑战者变为武陵人的，并拜托你替她去武陵城看看有没有出什么岔子。
summary_c31m2_4_001.en: Mi Fu and you prepare to fight the Senior Master. While you ready yourselves, Mi Fu remembers her transformation from Wuling's challenger to an actual Wulinger. She asks you to make your rounds in the city just in case anything goes awry.

summary_c31m2_8_001.cn: 弭弗的线人带你找到了一个可疑人士，那人是弭弗的二师父。他似乎没有恶意，只是想了解弭弗在武陵的近况。
summary_c31m2_8_001.en: Mi Fu's informant leads you to a suspicious individual who turns out to be Mi Fu's Senior Master. He does not seem to harbor any ill intent, and only asks Mi Fu how she has been holding up in Wuling.

summary_c31m2_9_001.cn: 你回到弭弗身边，回报了遇见二师父的事情。虽然弭弗不想与二师父交手，但还是与你前往擂台。
summary_c31m2_9_001.en: You return to Mi Fu's side and report your sighting of the Senior Master. Although Mi Fu is hesitant about the fight, both of you harden your resolve and march to the arena.

summary_c31m3_2_001.cn: 你发现汤汤将主持这场对决，于是向她打听弭弗可能在哪儿。
summary_c31m3_2_001.en: You find out that Tangtang is hosting the fight, so you ask her where Mi Fu has gone.

summary_c31m3_3_001.cn: 你终于找到了弭弗，她向你表达了自己对整件事的疑惑。然而无论有什么障碍与疑虑，她都决定站上擂台。
summary_c31m3_3_001.en: You finally find Mi Fu. She tells you about her suspicions of the entire incident. Nevertheless, no doubting mind nor any obstacles will stop her. She is determined to step into the arena.

summary_c31m3_4_001.cn: 你与弭弗一起去找汤汤，不料她竟然正在开盘口，你还询问了行情。弭弗对你们的“胡闹”感到又气恼又无奈。
summary_c31m3_4_001.en: Mi Fu and you go off to look for Tangtang but the Supreme Chief is busy running her betting stand. Curious, you ask her about the current odds. An infuriated Mi Fu is left speechless by your "trifling attitude".

summary_c31m3_7_001.cn: 击败弟子们后，弭弗拒绝了大师父的劝诱，选择与之对决。情况却峰回路转，庄方宜出现。原来她和三位师父一起演了这出戏，以证明弭弗的决心。三位师父心服口服，最后，庄方宜邀请弭弗与她继续当年未完的对决。
summary_c31m3_7_001.en: Mi Fu defeats the disciples, rejects her Grand Master's offer, and chooses to fight. Zhuang Fangyi shows up unexpectedly. Everything turns out to be a plan she made with Mi Fu's three masters to convince them of Mi Fu's resolve. Zhuang then invites Mi Fu to conclude their unfinished battle.

summary_c31m3_8_001.cn: 你与弭弗回味三位师父此行的用意——不是真的要拉她回清波寨，而是来看看她所选之路、所托之人是否能让他们放心。弭弗理解了庄方宜和师父们所做的事情，但对同样参与其中的你，她“余怒未消”，发出了“挑战”……
summary_c31m3_8_001.en: Mi Fu and you think about her masters' goal. They were not forcing her to choose the Stockade. Instead, they wanted to see if her path and the person she trusts lived up to their expectations. Though she appreciates what Zhuang Fangyi and her masters did, she "remains angry" and issues a "challenge".

summary_c33m1_10_001.cn: 你指出卡缪因陷入焦躁，失去判断。他袒露，因为查尔夺走了他的东西，所以才要亲手清算。他推测塞什卡请你来协助，是因为他失去了信任，而这与他不信任其他人的态度有关。
summary_c33m1_10_001.en: You point out that Camille is losing his better judgment due to his agitation. He reveals that Char took something from him, which is why he wants to settle the score personally. He speculates that Seš'qa asked for your assistance because they no longer trust him, and this is also why he distrusts others.

summary_c33m1_11_001.cn: 卡缪认为查尔故意引他进入废弃设施，里面可能会有危险，希望你能留下……
summary_c33m1_11_001.en: Camille suspects that Char is deliberately luring him into the abandoned facility where danger awaits. He hopes you will stay behind...

summary_c33m1_13029_001.cn: 因你拿出的线索，卡缪确定了此事与通缉犯查尔有关，也向你袒露了他之前想要单独行事的原因。你们决定一起沿着运输车的路线向前追踪。
summary_c33m1_13029_001.en: Based on the clues you provided, Camille confirms that this matter is connected to the wanted criminal Char, and he reveals the reason why he wanted to act alone at the beginning. You both decide to follow the transport vehicle's route together and continue the pursuit.

summary_c33m1_13034_001.cn: 你跟在后面，看到卡缪碰了一鼻子灰，被物流负责人德鲁安驱逐……
summary_c33m1_13034_001.en: Following behind, you see Camille get the cold shoulder and chased out by the logistics supervisor, Druan...

summary_c33m1_13_001.cn: 你们找到了运输车，但司机跟血液样本都不在这里。卡缪判断司机是主动带着样本，弃车逃走的。
summary_c33m1_13_001.en: You have located the transport, but the driver and the blood samples are nowhere to be found. Camille concludes that the driver intentionally took the samples and abandoned the vehicle.

summary_c33m1_14_001.cn: “查尔”是卡缪一直在追捕的塞什卡通缉犯，你对他说出这个名字后，他出现了明显的动摇，答应与你合作。
summary_c33m1_14_001.en: "Char" is a wanted criminal from Seš'qa who Camille has been relentlessly pursuing. After you mention this name to him, he shows clear signs of wavering and agrees to cooperate with you.

summary_c33m1_18_001.cn: 你找到了一个空的瓶子，但里面沾的是普通的血。这是查尔留下，刻意引诱你们的线索。
summary_c33m1_18_001.en: You find an empty vial, but it only contains ordinary bloodstains. Char deliberately left this obfuscating clue to throw you off course.

summary_c33m1_1_001.cn: 你结识了看护人卡缪。他认为塞什卡是请你来监视他的。他似乎出于一些原因，坚持要自己亲手解决事件，拒绝了你的协助。
summary_c33m1_1_001.en: You meet Camille the Agaš'mekanaz (Keeper of Wisdom). He believes Seš'qa has asked you to monitor him. For some reason, he insists on resolving the matter himself and declines your assistance.

summary_c33m1_2_001.cn: 你得知德鲁安生气是因为卡缪怀疑运输队的司机菲利普监守自盗。了解情况后，德鲁安答应你，查到匿名捐赠人的信息后会联络你。
summary_c33m1_2_001.en: You learn that Druan is upset because Camille suspects the transport driver, Philip, of stealing from the company. After hearing the situation, Druan agrees to contact you once he uncovers information about the anonymous donor.

summary_c33m1_3_001.cn: 你们发现了运货员达宁的尸体，卡缪变得非常急躁，请求你联络德鲁安进行善后，自己则先行前往联盟停车场。
summary_c33m1_3_001.en: You discover the body of the cargo handler, Dunning. Camille becomes visibly agitated and asks you to contact Druan to handle the aftermath, while he heads to the United Parking Lot ahead of you.

summary_c33m1_6_001.cn: 杰弗里亲眼看到菲利普袭击并抢走了血液样本，但他不相信对方会杀死达宁。他提到，车队出发时似乎遇到了一名萨卡兹。你正想与卡缪讨论时，一段联络通信传来……
summary_c33m1_6_001.en: Though he witnessed Philip attacking and stealing the blood samples, Jeffrey does not believe he killed Dunning. He mentions that the convoy seemed to have met a Sarkaz when setting out. You are about to discuss this with Camille when you suddenly receive a call...

summary_c33m1_7_001.cn: 得知血液样本来源于查尔，卡缪判断他这次的诡计是为了把自己的血运出四号谷地，利用巫术脱身。他坚持认为菲利普也是凶手，听到你有不同意见后，表现出了一些不被信任的失落……
summary_c33m1_7_001.en: Upon learning that the blood sample originated from Char, Camille deduces that Char's current scheme is to transport his own blood out of Valley IV, then use his witchcraft to escape. He insists that Philip is also an accomplice. Upon hearing your differing opinion, he shows signs of disappointment for being distrusted...

summary_c33m1_8_001.cn: 卡缪判断运输车的远程锁定系统破坏了查尔的计划，所以他才抛弃了车子。眼下线索已经断掉，卡缪提出用自己的源石技艺进行追踪。
summary_c33m1_8_001.en: Camille deduces that the vehicle's remote-lock system disrupted Char's plan, forcing him to abandon the transport. With the trail having gone cold, Camille suggests using his own Arts to trace the next lead.

summary_c33m1_9_001.cn: 你跟卡缪讨论发现的线索，他怀疑查尔与菲利普里应外合，袭击了运输车队。此外，你们认为那道血迹有些古怪……
summary_c33m1_9_001.en: You discuss the discovered clues with Camille. He suspects that Char and Philip worked together from inside and outside to attack the transport convoy. Additionally, both of you feel that the bloodstain is rather peculiar...

summary_c33m2_10_001.cn: 你们本以为抓到了查尔，但出现在眼前的人却是被其控制的菲利普。卡缪将昏迷的菲利普交给你，自己前去追逐将要逃走的查尔。
summary_c33m2_10_001.en: You thought you caught Char, but the person turns out to be Philip, who is under Char's control. Camille hands the unconscious Philip over to you and rushes off in pursuit of the fleeing Char.

summary_c33m2_11_001.cn: 查尔利用巫术转移离去，你们失去了他的踪迹，只能先离开……
summary_c33m2_11_001.en: Char has escaped by using his witchcraft. You have lost his trail. You have to withdraw for now....

summary_c33m2_12_001.cn: 在监控室中，你们与查尔对峙，揭开了他将血液藏在尸体中逃脱的手法。查尔提到他留下了一份“礼物”，你猜测或许藏在发现达宁的地点。
summary_c33m2_12_001.en: You confront Char in the surveillance room and expose his method: he placed the blood samples in a corpse to escape. Char mentions that he left a “gift” behind, and you suspect it is hidden where you found Dunning.

summary_c33m2_13_001.cn: 卡缪找到了血液样本与查尔留下的一个问题。同时，德鲁安也发来通信，告诉你们达宁未死的消息。
summary_c33m2_13_001.en: Camille manages to secure a viable blood sample, along with a cryptic message left behind by Char. Meanwhile, Druan calls and tells you that Dunning is actually still alive.

summary_c33m2_15_001.cn: 经历此事后，卡缪彻底向你敞开了心扉。为了继续追逐查尔，也为了回应你对他的信任与帮助，他与你做了一起去远方的约定。
summary_c33m2_15_001.en: After the ordeal, Camille has completely opened his heart to you. In order to continue his hunt for Char, and to repay your trust and assistance, he promises to join your journey into distant lands.

summary_c33m2_16_001.cn: 裂地者将卡缪错认成了查尔，你们顺利蒙混了看守者，但就在此刻，因卡缪提到你是他的朋友，横生变故……
summary_c33m2_16_001.en: The Landbreakers mistake Camille for Char, and both of you easily deceive the guards. But Camille suddenly addresses you as a friend. An unexpected complication immediately follows...

summary_c33m2_21_001.cn: 卡缪跟你去分头处理后续的事务，约定再联络。
summary_c33m2_21_001.en: Camille leaves to handle the rest of the investigation, but promises to stay in touch.

summary_c33m2_23_001.cn: 查尔试图引诱卡缪叛离塞什卡，但卡缪选择相信你对他一路的支撑，拒绝了查尔的提议。
summary_c33m2_23_001.en: Char tries to lure Camille into betraying Seš'qa, but Camille chooses to trust the support you have given him along the way and rejects Char's offer.

summary_c33m2_27_001.cn: 卡缪说出查尔·亚尔诺是他的孪生兄弟，也讲述了自己不愿面对的过往，与针对查尔之事的动摇。他下定决心，要杀死查尔。
summary_c33m2_27_001.en: Camille reveals that Char Arno is his twin brother, shares the past he's been unwilling to face, and explains how his resolve regarding Char has been wavering. He makes up his mind: Char must die by his hand.

summary_c33m2_6_001.cn: 查尔的房间中放着一张家庭合照，你在上面看到了卡缪的脸。你终于明白卡缪拒绝他人插手，表现出回避情绪，是因为查尔是他的血亲。
summary_c33m2_6_001.en: A family photo placed in Char's room shows a face you recognize: Camille's. You finally understand his evasiveness and refusal of outside involvement: Char is his blood relative.

summary_c33m2_7_001.cn: 卡缪告诉了你更多往事。原来他们的父母死去、查尔当年的背叛，都与荒地军阀雅各布出走塞什卡有关。
summary_c33m2_7_001.en: Camille tells you more about his past. The deaths of their parents and Char's betrayal years ago were linked to the Jakub the Warlord of the Wilds and the latter's betrayal of Seš'qa.

summary_c33m2_9_001.cn: 在你的鼓励下，卡缪推开了眼前的门。
summary_c33m2_9_001.en: With your encouragement, Camille pushes open the door before him.

summary_c34m1_12_001.cn: 从留下的手稿中，提弗洛斯发现，雪祀在林中布置了唤醒沉睡巨兽萨米的仪式，三人被困也是因为仪式中残存的力量。要想离开林地，须得破坏组成仪式的三个祭坛。
summary_c34m1_12_001.en: Typhoeus finds out from the notes that the Snowpriestess has been attempting rituals for waking the slumbering Feranmut Sami. Residual energy from the ritual happens to be the reason why the three of them are trapped in this forest. Three ritual shrines must be taken down to exit the woods.

summary_c34m1_2_001.cn: 深入飘雪的林中，里面的雾气让你几次迷失。但最终，你还是顺着安德烈的呼喊，成功找到了他。见到你，他异常激动，希望能够在你的帮助下，早些找到丢失的行李，离开这片古怪的树林。
summary_c34m1_2_001.en: You attempt to enter the forest of drifting snow. The fog almost disorients you a number of times, but you are able to follow Andre's calls and find him at last. The engineer is extremely excited and hopes that you can help him recover his lost baggage and get him out of the strange forest.

summary_c34m1_4_001.cn: 提弗洛斯向你解释，林中异象源自一位萨米雪祀留下的防护陷阱。而她此次来到林中，正是为询问那位雪祀有关萨米兽主安玛留下的传说。最后，你们决定前往林中的雪祀小屋，寻找消除雾气，离开林子的办法。
summary_c34m1_4_001.en: Typhoeus explains that the anomalies in the forest are protective traps created by a Sami Snowpriestess. Typh is trying to find the Snowpriestess for legends about the Sami Beast Lord Amma. You finally decide to visit the Snowpriestess's forest cabin and hope that she can lift the fog and let you leave.

summary_c34m1_5_001.cn: 你帮助提弗洛斯找到合适的位置，女孩拉弓射出三支箭，阵法被破除，前方的雾气消散，显出道路。
summary_c34m1_5_001.en: You help Typhoeus to find a spot to aim her shot. She nocks her bow with three arrows, draws, and shoots. The array is shattered and the fog lifts. A path is revealed before you.

summary_c34m1_6_001.cn: 在温暖炉火的陪伴下，安德烈昏昏欲睡，而提弗洛斯与你讲起了她在铁誓军要塞的经历——在那里，她曾有过一段与安玛相关的奇遇，并且收获了三支意义非常的长箭。
summary_c34m1_6_001.en: The fireplace is lit and warms the place. An exhausted Andre is falling asleep. Typhoeus tells Endmin about her experiences at Order of Steel Oath forts where she had a strange encounter with Amma and acquired three large arrows that carry special meaning.

summary_c34m1_7_001.cn: 你们进入木屋，发现它早已破败，生活在其中的雪祀也不知踪影。但好在，屋内留下了大量手稿，提弗洛斯或许能借助它们找到离开林地的办法。
summary_c34m1_7_001.en: You enter the cabin and discover its dilapidated state. The Snowpriestess who resides here is nowhere to be found. Thankfully, she left plenty of writings in the cabin. Typhoeus might be able to find a way to leave the forest from them.

summary_c34m1_8_001.cn: 秦茳尺此前发来消息，告知你安德烈在前往武陵的途中失踪，并希望你能够前去寻找。你根据安德烈最后的行迹，来到应龙关外的一片树林，却发现此处景色与武陵的青翠山水截然不同。
summary_c34m1_8_001.en: Director Qin messages you how Andre went missing when he attempted to travel to Wuling and hopes you can find him. You follow the traces left by Andre and arrive at a forest outside Yinglung Pass. The surroundings are very different from the lush green groves and hills you typically see in Wuling.

summary_c34m1_9_001.cn: 在林中，你与安德烈最终又回到原地。他唉声叹气，感慨这片林子诡异至极，说不定藏着鬼怪。突然，一片黑影从雾中穿行而来，吓得他当场昏迷。直至黑影显出真身，你才发现，来者并非鬼怪，而是再旅者干员提弗洛斯。
summary_c34m1_9_001.en: You fail to leave the forest. A disappointed Andre feels there is something wrong with the place and hints at a supernatural presence. A shadowy figure suddenly bursts from the fog, and the engineer passes out from the surprise. You take a closer look and realize the figure is Typhoeus, a reconvener.

summary_c34m2_15_001.cn: 回到木屋中，提弗洛斯决定独自前往最后一处祭坛，留你照顾昏迷不醒的安德烈。
summary_c34m2_15_001.en: Back at the cabin, Typhoeus decides to head to the last shrine on her own so you can take care of the semi-conscious Andre.

summary_c34m2_1_001.cn: 出发去祭坛前，你发现沉睡的安德烈怎么也叫不醒。于是你和提弗洛斯决定让他留在木屋好好休息。
summary_c34m2_1_001.en: You prepare to set off to find the shrines but realize that you cannot wake Andre from his slumber. Both Typhoeus and you decide it is better to leave him resting in the safety of the cabin.

summary_c34m2_3_001.cn: 使用特殊的箭支破坏祭坛后，一只捕梦网飘浮在祭坛中央。提弗洛斯将其取下后，林中一部分雾气散去，通往第二处祭坛的道路显现。就在你与提弗洛斯准备前往时，安德烈却从木屋中走出，头也不回地往林中走去。
summary_c34m2_3_001.en: The dreamcatcher floats in the center of the shrine that Typhoeus just destroyed with her arrow. Retrieving it lifts part of the fog and reveals the path to the second shrine. Just as you and Typhoeus are about to head over, Andre staggers out of the cabin and walks into the forest without hesitation.

summary_c34m2_5_001.cn: 提弗洛斯取下捕梦网，仪式被破除，但安德烈仍未苏醒。原来，自仪式中诞生的巫术造物以人的梦境为养料，陷入沉睡的安德烈正是它们最好的“猎物”。
summary_c34m2_5_001.en: Typhoeus retrieves the dreamcatcher and ends the ritual. However, this act fails to wake Andre. It turns out that the spawn of witchcraft feeds on dreams, making Andre in his deep sleep their perfect "prey".

summary_c34m2_9_001.cn: 成功破坏第三处祭坛后，提弗洛斯以为仪式已被破除，当她满怀期待回到木屋后，却发现安德烈仍未苏醒。商量过后，提弗洛斯与你决定利用雪祀创造的方法进入梦境，寻回安德烈的意识。
summary_c34m2_9_001.en: After destroying the third shrine and believing that she has disrupted the ritual, a hopeful Typhoeus returns to the cabin only to see that Andre is still asleep. Following a discussion, Typhoeus and you decide to enter the dreamscape using the Snowpriestess's method and retrieve Andre's consciousness.

summary_c34m3_11_001.cn: 回到木屋中，苏醒的安德烈正等待着你们，你向他解释清原委后，他向提弗洛斯诚挚道谢。提弗洛斯却陷入疑惑：梦中的蹄印是否真的是安玛留下的？
summary_c34m3_11_001.en: You return to the cabin. Andre has awoken and is waiting for you. You explain to him what happened, and he gives Typhoeus his heartfelt gratitude. Typhoeus, however, is still puzzled about something. Did Amma leave those mysterious hoofprints in the dream?

summary_c34m3_13_001.cn: 你们相伴踏上离开的路，从山路旁俯瞰整片林地，此时雾气早已散开，提弗洛斯拿出笔记想要绘下此刻美景，但笔记上却奇妙地出现一行蹄印指向北方。而你也听到了那个伴随大家同行的声音。
summary_c34m3_13_001.en: While taking the mountain trail to leave, you gaze upon the entire forest. The fog has dissipated. Typh takes out her notes to draw the beautiful scene, but a trail of mysterious hoof prints bounding for the north suddenly appear on the paper. You also hear a familiar voice.

summary_c34m3_1_001.cn: 完成进入梦境的仪式，提弗洛斯需要你将三只捕梦网放入木屋外的阵法符文中，最后，再捏一颗包裹安德烈眉毛的雪球放入阵眼。
summary_c34m3_1_001.en: To complete the ritual for entering dreamscape, Typhoeus needs you to place three dreamcatchers in the array runes outside the cabin, pluck Andre's eyebrow, pack the feathers in a ball of snow, and then lay that snowball in the eye of the array.

summary_c34m3_3_001.cn: 仪式准备完毕，你将雪球放入阵眼，提弗洛斯闭上眼念出祷词，仪式启动，等她再睁眼，你们已经处在梦境中。
summary_c34m3_3_001.en: The ritual is prepared. You place the snowball in the array's eye. Typhoeus closes her gaze and chants the prayers that begin the ritual. When she opens her eyes again, both of you are in the dreamscape.

summary_c34m3_6_001.cn: 一阵蹄声将两人从雾气中带出，但道路前方却是深不见底的悬崖，你怀疑那蹄声只是在将你们引入另一处陷阱，但提弗洛斯却想顺应蹄声的指引，继续向前。你决定相信女孩的选择。
summary_c34m3_6_001.en: The two follow the sound of the hooves and manage to leave the fog, but the road suddenly ends in a bottomless chasm. You suspect that the trotting has led you to a trap. Typhoeus, however, intends to follow and take a bold step forward. You decide to trust in her choice.

summary_c34m3_8_001.cn: 你与提弗洛斯跟随声音与蹄印来到一片迷雾前，在这里，安德烈的灵魂正无助悲泣。你们缓缓靠近，想要带他离开，却被一只巨大的巫术造物阻拦。
summary_c34m3_8_001.en: You and Typhoeus follow the sound and hoofprints to a mass of fog. It is where you see Andre's soul weeping helplessly. You approach him slowly and try to bring him home, but a massive witchcraft spawn blocks your way.

summary_c34m3_9_001.cn: 在巫术造物的重重包围中，安玛的蹄印化作一支光箭，提弗洛斯将其射出，梦境被撕裂。最终，你与她顺利离开梦境，回到林中。
summary_c34m3_9_001.en: Surrounded by the witchcraft spawn, Amma's hoofprints transform into an arrow of light. Typhoeus fires it and tears the dreamscape apart, allowing the both of you to escape and return to the forest.

summary_c35m1_10_001.cn: 你与梨诺逃到了安全地带，意外遇到梨诺的粉丝——一名来自工团的少女，格蕾丝。一番交流后，梨诺希望你能为她和格蕾丝拍下一张合照。
summary_c35m1_10_001.en: You and Liino reach a safe place and run into Grace, a Liino fan from the UWST. After chatting for a bit, Liino asks you to take a photo of her and Grace together.

summary_c35m1_13_001.cn: 目送格蕾丝离开，你点出了梨诺言行中的疑点，无法再辩驳的她向你坦言——她并未被绑架，这都是她为摆脱集团控制而布的局。与此同时，为了不辜负粉丝的期待，她打算开一场纯粹的个人演唱会，并希望得到你的帮助。
summary_c35m1_13_001.en: After Grace leaves, you point out the inconsistencies in Liino's story. She finally tells you the truth that she was never kidnapped. It was all part of a plan to escape the agency's control. Still, she wants to give her fans what they deserve, so she's planning a solo concert and hopes you'll help.

summary_c35m1_1_001.cn: 你来到工人之家，遇到了来观看演唱会的阿丽娅，她十分激动地向你介绍了这次演唱会的主角——偶像梨诺。之后，阿丽娅邀请你在附近转转。
summary_c35m1_1_001.en: You arrive at the Worker Dorms and meet Alia, who's there to attend the concert. She's super excited and starts telling you all about the idol named Liino. After that, she asks if you want to take a look around with her.

summary_c35m1_4_001.cn: 感受了现场热烈的气氛后，阿丽娅向你介绍演出的赞助商布莱迪矿业集团，并提及梨诺所属的环塔娱乐事务所就是该集团旗下的。就在这时，阿丽娅接到事务所来电，似乎发生了意外情况，你决定和她一起去看看。
summary_c35m1_4_001.en: After soaking up the lively atmosphere, Alia tells you about the sponsor, Brady Mining Group — and that Liino's agency, Pan-Talosian Entertainment, is one of its subsidiaries. Then she gets a call from the agency. Sounds like something's up. You decide to tag along and see what's going on.

summary_c35m1_5_001.cn: 你们从环塔娱乐事务所员工处得知——偶像梨诺失踪了，疑似遭人劫持。你决定帮助他们寻找梨诺的下落。
summary_c35m1_5_001.en: An employee from Pan-Talosian Entertainment tells you that Liino is missing. She may have been abducted. You offer to help them find her.

summary_c35m1_9_001.cn: 一路追踪之后，你在一处高地遇到了自称“梨诺”的少女，她似乎与你相识甚久，并在得知你失忆后显得十分失落。就在你打算向她询问详情之时，事务所人员赶到，梨诺见状便匆忙拉着你逃离了现场。
summary_c35m1_9_001.en: You follow the trail to the highlands and meet a girl who claims to be Liino. She seems to know you well and looks crushed when she learns you've lost your memory. Just as you're about to ask for more details, agency staff arrive. Liino quickly grabs you and pulls you away.

summary_c35m2_1_001.cn: 你们来到梨诺选中的起飞地点，发现这里存在起飞高度不够的问题。为了完成理想的演出方案，梨诺再次向你请求帮助——制造一个用于加速的助推器。你决定找安德烈帮忙。
summary_c35m2_1_001.en: You and Liino find a perfect launch site, but the launch altitude is a bit too low. To make her dream come true, she asks you for help again in designing a booster. You decide to ask Andre for assistance.

summary_c35m2_2_001.cn: 了解详情后，安德烈答应帮忙制作助推器并告知了使用风险，梨诺却坚持要按照理想高度的功率制作。你对梨诺的安全感到担忧，而她则表示为了演出甘愿冒风险，最终你不再阻拦，并认可了她的勇气。
summary_c35m2_2_001.en: After hearing the details, Andre agrees to build the booster and explains the risks. But Liino insists on full power for her ideal height. Worried for her safety, you try to stop her. But Liino says the risk is worth it for her performance. In the end, you give in and acknowledge her courage.

summary_c35m2_4_001.cn: 助推器制作完毕，你得知最新情况：环塔娱乐事务所并未取消慰问演唱会，而是延期举行，并追加售票渠道，售卖限量周边。梨诺得知后深感愤怒，表示这次不会再妥协，她决定加快筹备脚步，尽快公开个人演唱会的消息。
summary_c35m2_4_001.en: The booster is ready. You're informed that Pan-Talosian Entertainment didn't cancel the charity concert, only postponed it. They're selling even more tickets and releasing limited merch. Liino is furious. No more compromises. She decides to speed things up and announce her solo concert as soon as possible.

summary_c35m2_5_001.cn: 你们来到梨诺选中的降落地点，却发现有工团成员在这里遭到天使的袭击。为了保护众人，你和梨诺一同与天使进行了战斗。
summary_c35m2_5_001.en: You arrive at the landing site Liino chose, only to find the UWST crew mates there being attacked by Aggeloi. To protect everyone, you and Liino fight the Aggeloi together.

summary_c35m2_6_001.cn: 你们从获救的工团成员处得知他们即将前往其他城市工作。他们很高兴见到梨诺，同时为无法观看延期的演唱会而遗憾。就在这时，你告诉了他们梨诺将另行举办个人演唱会的消息，而梨诺也顺势邀请了他们。
summary_c35m2_6_001.en: The UWST crew mates you saved say they're heading off to another city for work. They're happy to see Liino, but disappointed they'll miss the concert. You tell them she's holding her own solo concert instead, and Liino takes the chance to invite them.

summary_c35m2_7_001.cn: 工人们离开后，梨诺确认了降落地点的情况，随后打算进行后续的准备工作——对个人演出进行宣传。一番讨论后，你们决定前往矿区营地，利用那里新修的广播站向众人告知个人演出事宜。
summary_c35m2_7_001.en: After the crew mates leave, Liino checks the landing site and moves on to her next step: promoting her solo concert. You head to the Mining Camp to use their new broadcast station to make the announcement.

summary_c35m2_9_001.cn: 了解详情后，安德烈答应帮忙制作助推器并告知了使用风险，梨诺却坚持要按照理想高度的功率制作。你对梨诺的安全感到担忧，而她则表示为了演出甘愿冒风险，最终你不再阻拦，并认可了她的勇气。
summary_c35m2_9_001.en: After hearing the details, Andre agrees to build the booster and explains the risks. But Liino insists on full power for her ideal height. Worried for her safety, you try to stop her. But Liino says the risk is worth it for her performance. In the end, you give in and acknowledge her courage.

summary_c35m3_11_001.cn: 抵达广播站后，梨诺向众人宣布了个人演唱会的消息，引来粉丝们的关注。在保镖们即将赶到时，你们再度逃离了现场。
summary_c35m3_11_001.en: When you get to the broadcast station, Liino makes the announcement about her solo concert, and the fans start buzzing. The guards are almost on you, but you manage to get out of there just in time.

summary_c35m3_12_001.cn: 顺利甩开保镖后，你道出了自己一路以来观察梨诺的结论。梨诺这次终于不再用其他借口搪塞，将自己真实的情况与想法告诉了你，你则言明了自己打算帮助她的原因。就在这时，安德烈紧急联络了你。
summary_c35m3_12_001.en: After shaking off the guards, you tell Liino what you've noticed about her. This time, she doesn't make excuses. She finally opens up and tells you the truth. You explain why you want to help, and then Andre hits you with an urgent call.

summary_c35m3_6_001.cn: 你们赶往矿区营地后，发现这里聚集的人数已远远超出预期，附近还有保镖正在警戒。即便如此，梨诺仍然决定继续原计划。
summary_c35m3_6_001.en: You rush to the Mining Camp, only to find a much larger crowd than expected, with security guards standing watch nearby. Even so, Liino decides to stick to the original plan.

summary_c35m3_8_001.cn: 在前往广播站的途中，几名工人的争执引起了你们的注意，梨诺似乎因此回忆起了自己过往的经历，心情复杂地发出感慨。
summary_c35m3_8_001.en: While heading to the broadcast station, you notice a few crew mates arguing. The scene seems to remind Liino of something from her own past, and she gets a bit emotional.

summary_c35m3_9_001.cn: 一名路过的工团少年发现了你们的踪迹，从他口中，你们得知了附近保镖的人数。你们本想静待时机，谁知少年却因为自身的正义感主动选择帮助你们。
summary_c35m3_9_001.en: A passing UWST boy spots you and tells you how many security guards are nearby. You were going to wait, but the kid's sense of justice kicks in, and he volunteers to help.

summary_c35m4_5_001.cn: 你与梨诺一同击退了起飞地点的裂地者后，决定继续守在原地直至演唱会开始。在此期间，你让菲奥娜帮忙向布莱迪矿业集团发了一封匿名信，而梨诺则完成了对助推器的最终调整。
summary_c35m4_5_001.en: After driving off the Landbreakers from the launch site, you and Liino decide to wait there until the concert starts. You ask Fiona to send an anonymous letter to Brady Mining Group while Liino makes the final booster adjustments.

summary_c35m4_6_001.cn: 你找到梨诺，向她传达了工人们对她的感谢。梨诺则在说明了自己与事务所解约的现状后，提出了想要加入终末地工业的想法。
summary_c35m4_6_001.en: You find Liino and tell her how grateful the crew mates are. Liino, on the other hand, tells you about her plan to end her contract with the agency and offers to join Endfield.

summary_c6m1_17_001.cn: 乔万尼从碾骨氏族成员的口中套出了营地位置，并主动提出了一个冒进的团队作战计划，没想到一向谨慎的狼卫居然第一时间表示赞同。你明白，狼卫想进一步试探乔万尼。你决定继续配合狼卫，让乔万尼的“计划”顺利推进。
summary_c6m1_17_001.en: Giovanni manages to get the location of the camp from a Bonekrusher. He proposes a high-risk team combat operation. Wulfgard, known for being cautious, surprisingly agrees with Giovanni's plan. You know he is trying to test Giovanni. You decide to play along with Wulfgard's show and ensure the success of Giovanni's "plans".

summary_c6m1_18_001.cn: 击败驻守的碾骨氏族后，狼卫发现乔万尼身上的短刀似曾相识。从乔万尼口中得知，这是他以狼卫教的知识，专门为自己定制的一把刀。
summary_c6m1_18_001.en: After defeating the Bonekrushers guarding this place, Wulfgard notices something familiar about Giovanni's dagger. Giovanni tells him that he learned from Wulfgard's tricks and custom-crafted this dagger for himself.

summary_c6m1_1_001.cn: 来到矿区营地，洛茜将狼卫失联的事告诉了你，希望你可以帮她把狼卫带回来。为了尽快找到狼卫，洛茜将自己做的追踪器交给了你。
summary_c6m1_1_001.en: Upon arriving at the Mining Camp, Rossi tells you about Wulfgard's disappearance, hoping you could help bring him back. Eager to find him as soon as possible, she hands you a tracker she made herself.

summary_c6m1_24_001.cn: 你与狼卫在追回乔万尼的过程中落入陷阱。事后，狼卫向你致歉，并承认因顾念过往友情，他没能将乔万尼视作敌人加以提防，因此连累了你，这让他深感愧疚。最终，狼卫重新坚定了信念，与你一同寻找离开此地的方法。
summary_c6m1_24_001.en: You and Wulfgard try to chase down Giovanni but fall into a trap. Wulfgard apologizes to you and admits that he has been distracted by his old friendship, and failed to treat Giovanni as a proper enemy and maintain his vigilance. Since you also fall into the trap, Wulfgard feels extremely guilty. In the end, he manages to steel his resolve and work with you to find a way to leave the place.

summary_c6m1_29_001.cn: 战后，乔万尼突然现身，将落败的碾骨氏族头目杀死。狼卫揭穿了乔万尼的真面目。一番争辩后，乔万尼却声称他的背后另有主谋。自知已无法达成目的的乔万尼拒绝透露更多信息，并突然对你发起攻击，最终被狼卫杀死。
summary_c6m1_29_001.en: After the battle, Giovanni suddenly appears and kills the defeated Bonekrusher chief. Wulfgard exposes Giovanni for what he truly is. After a heated argument, Giovanni claims there is someone else acting from behind the scenes. But knowing that he has failed their mission, Giovanni refuses to reveal more and suddenly attacks you, only to be killed by Wulfgard.

summary_c6m1_32_001.cn: 在枢纽区的野外，你找到了已将乔万尼安葬的狼卫。他与你一同焚烧了这位故友的几件遗物，并向你讲述了其中的过往。之后，狼卫与你坦白了自己后续的计划，同时希望你将发生的一切视作两人共同的“秘密”。
summary_c6m1_32_001.en: You find Wulfgard who just laid Giovanni to rest at the outskirts of the Hub. Together, you burn the rest of Giovanni's belongings. Wulfgard tells you about their past. He also confides his subsequent plan, and hopes that you can keep the entirety of this encounter as a secret between the both of you.

summary_c6m1_3_001.cn: 经过一番追踪，你找到了狼卫。他将事情的前因后果告诉了你——狼群里出了叛徒。为了弄清楚内幕，狼卫认为自己不能就这样回去，必须追查到底。而为了实现对洛茜的承诺，你决定与狼卫同行。
summary_c6m1_3_001.en: You find Wulfgard after a while of tracking. He tells you about the entire event —— There are traitors in the Pack. Wulfgard feels he cannot simply return with this discovery, and feels extremely compelled to reveal the entire conspiracy. To fulfill your promise with Rossi, you decide to be part of Wulfgard's investigation.

summary_c6m1_6_001.cn: 打倒此地埋伏的碾骨氏族后，你与狼卫遇到了同为狼群一员的乔万尼。他似乎与狼卫关系匪浅。
summary_c6m1_6_001.en: After defeating the ambushing Bonekrushers, you and Wulfgard meet another member of the Pack — Giovanni. He seems pretty close to Wulfgard.

summary_c6m1_7_001.cn: 你们从伪装成碾骨氏族的乔万尼口中得知，他是来寻找疑似投靠碾骨氏族的托马索的——然而狼卫不久前才收到托马索的死讯。面对乔万尼真假难辨的说辞，你与狼卫默契地没有当场拆穿他的谎言，同意让他与你们同行。
summary_c6m1_7_001.en: Giovanni, disguised as a Bonekrusher, tells you that he came here to find Tommaso, whom he suspects has joined the Bonekrushers — However, Wulfgard just recently received news of Tommaso's death. Giovanni's story seems untrustworthy, but you and Wulfgard tacitly choose not to call him out on his lies. Both of you agree to let Giovanni tag along.

summary_db01m1_11_001.cn: 阿奎多提议解析收集的数据，升级最基础的辅助探测技术，延长你在谷地像差中的滞留时间。
summary_db01m1_11_001.en: Aquito recommends deciphering the data collected and upgrading the most basic exploration support tech. This will extend your stay within the Valley's Aberrants.

summary_db01m1_12_001.cn: 阿奎多需要你重复先前实践过的方法，找到能量反应，解除阻碍，扫描“重点目标”。
summary_db01m1_12_001.en: Aquito needs you to repeat your previous attempt, find an energy reaction site, eliminate the obstacles, and scan a "key target".

summary_db01m1_13_001.cn: 帝江号上的谷地像差入口变成了“重点目标”的样子。阿奎多希望你返回谷地像差，确认已探索区域是否发生了变化。
summary_db01m1_13_001.en: The Valley's Aberrants portal aboard Dijiang has assumed the form of the "key target". Aquito hopes you can return to the Protocol Space and verify if the explored zones have undergone any changes.

summary_db01m1_14_001.cn: 阿奎多为你升级了辅助探测技术，她需要你返回谷地像差，确认升级的成果，并继续进行探索工作。
summary_db01m1_14_001.en: Aquito has upgraded an exploration support tech for you. She now needs you to return to Valley's Aberrants to verify the performance of the upgrade and explore more of the Protocol Space.

summary_db01m1_15_001.cn: 阿奎多确认到，谷地像差中只出现了你最近认知的事物。你需要加快探索的节奏。
summary_db01m1_15_001.en: Aquito has realized that the Valley's Aberrants only generates items and objects from your recent experiences. You must speed up your exploration efforts.

summary_db01m1_18_001.cn: 阿奎多告诉你，收集沉积结核或完成委托都可以为研究作出贡献，还能得到相应的奖励。
summary_db01m1_18_001.en: Aquito informs you that collecting precipitation nodules and completing commissions can help push the research progress and provide certain rewards.

summary_db01m1_1_001.cn: 高等源石物理研究专家阿奎多向你介绍，他们在帝江号上发现了一处奇特的协议空间，并将其命名为“谷地像差”。为了帝江号的安全，她希望你协助调查谷地像差。
summary_db01m1_1_001.en: Senior Originium Physicist Aquito tells you that her team found a special Protocol Space aboard Dijiang that they have named the "Valley's Aberrants". She hopes you can help investigate the Valley's Aberrants to ensure the safety of Dijiang.

summary_db01m1_3_001.cn: 阿奎多准备利用仪器主动影响谷地像差的入口，改变协议空间的状态，为你提供更多必要支援。
