summary_gm01m8_3_001.en: The Landbreaker prisoner turns out to be Endfield site support technician Copper, who is also Bronzer's younger twin. He tells you that many robots were heavily damaged while trying to escape from the Landbreakers and only one seems reparable. You decide to help.

summary_gm01m9_1_001.cn: 你偶遇了工团工人英格，她发现反应炉的异常情况后赶来，正尝试进入醇化合物工厂。但工厂大门打不开，于是她计划炸墙而入。
summary_gm01m9_1_001.en: You meet a UWST crew mate named Ingol. She rushed to this place in response to a reactor malfunction and is trying to get into the Kohl Plant. The gate refuses to open, so she intends to blast a hole in the wall.

summary_gm01m9_3_001.cn: 检查了醇化合物工厂的内部情况后，英格告诉你反应炉上方的通风井被凝胶堵住了。英格尝试关闭反应炉，但发现它的控制系统失灵了。你让她不要着急，并决定前去查看情况。
summary_gm01m9_3_001.en: After checking the situation in the Kohl Plant, Ingol tells you that the ventilation shaft above the reactor is clogged by a gel. She tries to shut down the reactor but the control systems have failed. You tell her not to worry and decide to inspect the shaft itself.

summary_gm01m9_4_001.cn: 通风井已经恢复了正常。你回去找到英格。她告诉你现在醇化合物工厂的危机正在被逐步解决，但杰里米还是联系不上。
summary_gm01m9_4_001.en: The ventilation shaft is now working. You return to talk to Ingol. She tells you that the Kohl Plant crisis is slowly getting fixed, but is concerned that she still cannot contact Jeremy.

summary_gm02m10_1_001.cn: 你询问了在池边徘徊的可疑天师阿宝，原来他是在附近寻找爷爷留下的宝藏，你决定帮助他将池里的水抽干。
summary_gm02m10_1_001.en: You approach the suspicious Tianshi named Bao. Turns out, he's searching for a treasure his grandpa left somewhere nearby. You decide to help him drain the pond water.

summary_gm02m10_2_001.cn: 阿宝得知水池下的宝藏原来是爷爷杜曲生留下的陈年秘酒。虽然没能发大财，但他实现了寻宝心愿，对此，他向你表示了感谢。
summary_gm02m10_2_001.en: Bao realizes the treasure under the pond is an old batch of brew left by his grandfather, Du Qusheng. While it isn't a fortune, he is grateful for your help nonetheless.

summary_gm02m10_3_001.cn: 阿宝分析，想要打开天井院底部的大门，需要先找到三个“钥匙”，激活门前的三道机关。
summary_gm02m10_3_001.en: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it.

summary_gm02m10_4_001.cn: 阿宝分析，想要打开天井院底部的大门，需要先找到三个“钥匙”，激活门前的三道机关。
summary_gm02m10_4_001.en: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it.

summary_gm02m10_5_001.cn: 阿宝分析，想要打开天井院底部的大门，需要先找到三个“钥匙”，激活门前的三道机关。你已经集齐了所有“钥匙”。
summary_gm02m10_5_001.en: Bao's analysis indicates that to open the gate at the bottom of the courtyard, you must first locate three "keys" to activate the three mechanisms in front of it. You have now found all the "keys."

summary_gm02m11_1_001.cn: 身为管理员粉丝的天师陆欣，将戴着面具的你当成同好，他委托你这位来自终末地的专家帮忙修复息壤能量定型装置。
summary_gm02m11_1_001.en: Tianshi Lu Xin is a fan of the Endmin. However, he treats you as an Endfield professional and fellow Endmin fan who managed to get a good replica of the Endmin's mask. He asks you to help repair the Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility.

summary_gm02m11_4_001.cn: 你修复了息壤能量定型装置后，陆欣发现“专家”就是他崇拜的管理员，深感荣幸。
summary_gm02m11_4_001.en: After you repaired the Xiranite Energy-Fixing Facility, Lu Xin realized that the "Endfielder pro" actually happens to be the actual Endministrator. He feels extremely honored in your presence.

summary_gm02m12_1_001.cn: 在控制区，你遇到了技术职工刘协，得知他正在寻找传说中的偷懒神器——百宝工具箱。虽对此抱有疑惑，你仍答应他去望楼蓄水站的深处找寻。
summary_gm02m12_1_001.en: You meet technical laborer Liu Xie in the Restricted Area and learn that he is looking for the legendary AFK-Lazy Bum's Solution known as the Omni-Functionable Toolkit. Though you have your doubts, you agree to help him find the device located deep inside the Watchtower Reservoir Station.

summary_gm02m12_7_001.cn: 你们将箱中的《致后来人》交给了刘协，原来它记载着前辈们对后来者的谆谆教诲，刘协还从中发现了许多可提供灵感的素材。
summary_gm02m12_7_001.en: You retrieve the booklet titled To Posterity from the crate and give it to Liu Xie. The booklet contains lessons written by those who worked at this place, and Liu Xie finds plenty of things to draw inspirations from.

summary_gm02m15_1_001.cn: 沃尔顿想要拜托你们前往附近的悬崖上，勘察一座与剑有关的遗迹并拍摄照片，小机灵将与你们随行。你和陈千语答应了下来。
summary_gm02m15_1_001.en: Walton asks you to survey some ruins associated with swords at a nearby cliff, then take a photo of them. Smartie will be joining you as well. Both you and Chen Qianyu accept the job.

summary_gm02m15_2_001.cn: 通过阅读碑文，你们得知当初有三位贤人在此论剑。你们决定继续前进，调查他们留下的记录。
summary_gm02m15_2_001.en: You read the inscriptions and learn that three sages once debated the riddle of swords. You decide to head deeper to find other records they might have left behind.

summary_gm02m15_7_001.cn: 你们将调查记录和照片带了回来，确认这果然与选剑局有不小的渊源。沃尔顿借此抒发了自己对考古的情怀，也对你们表达了谢意。
summary_gm02m15_7_001.en: You return with the surveillance findings and photograph. The site is indeed intertwined with the Bureau of Swordmancers. Walton uses the opportunity to share his passion for archaeology and his gratitude towards your hard work.

summary_gm02m19_2_001.cn: 言告诉你，岸曾是她过去的队长，但在勘查任务中牺牲。她许下诺言，将会延续岸所坚守的那份责任。
summary_gm02m19_2_001.en: Phrase tells you that Shore used to be her task leader until the latter fell in the surveillance mission. She has made a promise to continue uphold Shore's vigilant duty.

summary_gm02m1_1_001.cn: 竹林入口处的神秘老人表示前方的道路变幻莫测，希望众人在找到规律破除幻象后，顺手帮他取回一件放在竹林深处的东西。

summary_gm02m1_1d5_001.cn: 竹林入口老人常驻对话

summary_gm02m21_1_001.cn: 应龙队员炤提到一些源石虫的行为出现异常，在应龙关中到处乱挖，可能会影响烽燧桩的运行。他请求你将源石虫们从废墟中带出，踢回眼前的虫道。
summary_gm02m21_1_001.en: The Yinglung, codenamed Brightfire, reports abnormal Originium Slug activities. The slugs have been burrowing unchecked beneath Yinglung Pass, and this might disrupt the operations of the Balepyre Tower. He wonders if you can kick the slugs in the ruins back into their original tunnels.

summary_gm02m21_3_001.cn: 第五只源石虫又从虫道中弹了出来，还带出了一些令人意外的囤积物。炤搞不懂状况，请你帮忙询问负责维护源石虫生态的队友泠，这时你才知道他不是虫道的负责人。他提到，如果源石虫卡进缝隙，可以找他帮忙赶出来。
summary_gm02m21_3_001.en: The fifth Originium Slug bounces out of the tunnel and surprises you with a secret stash. Brightfire does not know why and asks you to ask Frigid, the actual Yinglung in charge of maintaining the slug ecology. He also tells you that you can call him to release any Originium Slug stuck in a crevice.

summary_gm02m21_5_001.cn: 泠告诉你，这只源石虫不属于刚才那处虫道，你们把错误的虫送回了错误的家。她指出，这只源石虫来自应龙关另一侧，它难以自主进行长距离的迁移，现在的情况并不寻常，你们决定找到炤问个清楚。
summary_gm02m21_5_001.en: The Originium Slug that kept getting bounced is not a resident of the slug tunnel. Frigid tells you that its home is on the other side of Yinglung Pass, but no slugs should be able to make that journey on their own. The two of you decide to question Brightfire.

summary_gm02m21_6_001.cn: 你跟泠找到炤，发现他身边还有不少源石虫——原来是炤好心办坏事，导致源石虫的信息素混乱，它们无法回家。泠告诉你，那些囤积物是源石虫回到家后刨出来的，帮助源石虫迁徙的话，可能会得到“大自然的回馈”。
summary_gm02m21_6_001.en: You and Frigid find Brightfire surrounded by Originium Slugs. He was trying to help but only messed up the slugs' pheromones and prevented them from getting home. Frigid tells you that the slugs have dug up the stashes of their tunnels. Help the slugs migrate for some of this "nature's bounty".

summary_gm02m4_1_001.cn: 在生态实验站附近，你遇到了一位名叫林轲的天师学徒，他正在进行天师桩的启动测试。但帮他设置辅桩的同学却因故缺席，你决定帮助他完成测试。
summary_gm02m4_1_001.en: You encounter a Tianshi disciple named Lin Ke near the Ecological Research Station, who is conducting a startup test on the Tianshi Pillar. However, the classmates assisting him with the auxiliary pillars are absent due to unforeseen circumstances. You decide to help him complete the test.

summary_gm02m4_5_001.cn: 顺利启动所有辅桩后，你将结果告知了林轲。林轲的天师桩启动测试终于进入最终阶段。
summary_gm02m4_5_001.en: You tell Lin Ke about the successful results after activating all auxiliary pillars. Lin Ke's Tianshi Pillar startup test has now reached its final phase.

summary_gm02m4_6_001.cn: 林轲成功完成了这次的天师桩启动测试，他的课题终于得以继续推进，你也为他送上了祝福。
summary_gm02m4_6_001.en: Lin Ke successfully completes his Tianshi Pillar startup test. He can finally continue with his project now, and you offer him your blessings.

summary_gm02m5_1_001.cn: 你在武陵城居民区遇到了正为地下阵列稳定桩检修工作为难的新任天师方泽，答应她帮忙一起完成检修工作。
summary_gm02m5_1_001.en: You find Fang Ze, Wuling's new Tianshi in the Residential Area, wrestling with stabilizing rod repairs in the underground array. Offering your aid, you join the maintenance effort.

summary_gm02m6_1_001.cn: 水渠异动的流言不断扩散，导致居民们不敢用水。惊慌的居民景洪为你们介绍了大致的情况，并建议你们向一旁的天师学徒厉衡进一步询问。
summary_gm02m6_1_001.en: Rumors of the canal's disturbances spread, leaving residents terrified to use water. Jing Hong, a panicked local briefs you and points to Li Heng, a Tianshi disciple for further investigation.

summary_gm02m6_2_001.cn: 厉衡表示自己从没见过水渠的异常，这些流言都是迷信。但为了安抚害怕的居民，他拜托你们去检查两处水渠。
summary_gm02m6_2_001.en: Li Heng dismisses the rumors as superstition. To ease fears, he requests inspections at two canal sites.

summary_gm02m6_3_001.cn: 和厉衡交谈后，你们发现，这些装置是他的课程作业，在水下损坏后造成了水渠的异动，但此时他指出，自己没有在选剑局附近的水渠里放装置，那里的异动却最厉害……你们决定再去看看。
summary_gm02m6_3_001.en: After talking to Li Heng, he admits the devices are his prototypes that caused disturbances, but not the ones near HS.Swords. The worst disturbances are where he didn't deploy them... You decide to investigate further.

summary_gm02m6_4_001.cn: 厉衡扫描了水渠，看到里面堆满了其他天师学徒的课程作业。原来现在是考试季，许多同学跟他一样，用水渠做实验。
summary_gm02m6_4_001.en: Li Heng scans the canal. Turns out it's just clogged with other disciples' prototypes. Exam season has turned the waterways into a junkyard.

summary_gm02m7_1_001.cn: 你在选剑局里遇到一位叫锡锭子的学徒，得知他正在为身后的小剑桩而苦恼，你决定试着帮他启动一下。
summary_gm02m7_1_001.en: In HS.Swords, you find a disciple named Tin Ingot, troubled by the small sword pell behind him. You decide to help him out.

summary_gm02m7_3_001.cn: 见你升起了小剑桩，锡锭子兴奋地拜托你帮他通过测试。
summary_gm02m7_3_001.en: Having witnessed you successfully raise the sword pell, Tin Ingot now eagerly begs your help to pass his trial.

summary_gm02m7_4_001.cn: 你成功升起了巨剑桩，锡锭子正打算庆祝，却被连晓雾的远程通信打断，她将锡锭子狠狠教育了一通。
summary_gm02m7_4_001.en: Just as Tin Ingot is about to whoop in triumph at the central pell's ascent, Lian Xiaowu's holographic reprimand shatters the celebration. Her scolding so fierce, even nearby birds take flight.

summary_gm02m8_1_001.cn: 尚进和莫余两位天师正在争吵，原来他们缺少息壤进行三到钟的激活工作，你答应帮助他们，提供足够的息壤，激活钟上的符文组件。
summary_gm02m8_1_001.en: Tianshi Shang Jin and Tianshi Mo Yu are arguing because they lack enough Xiranite to activate the Bell of Three Presences. You agree to help them by providing sufficient Xiranite to activate the runes on the bell.

summary_gm02m8_5_001.cn: 你提供了足够的息壤，成功激活了三到钟，两位天师都很感谢你。
summary_gm02m8_5_001.en: You supplied enough Xiranite to fully activate the bell. Both Tianshi are relieved and grateful.

summary_m1m6_1_001.cn: 在野外探索时，你遇到一处异象。菲奥娜告诉你，这是一个即将失控的能量淤积点。她请求你清理这个能量淤积点，并提醒你在行动之前要做好充分的准备。
summary_m1m6_1_001.en: You come across an anomaly while exploring the wilderness. According to Fiona, it is an Energy Alluvium about to go out of control. She asks you to clean it up but also reminds you to be fully prepared before approaching it.

summary_sm1l1m10_3_001.cn: 你得知，集成工业研究所的分管负责人希茜似乎向着停车场的方向去了。
summary_sm1l1m10_3_001.en: AIC-RC Manager Cynthia probably went to the parking lot.

summary_sm1l1m10_5_001.cn: 你们偶遇了两名避难者，他们告诉你一桩传闻：这里是“终末地”进行实验研究的地方——附近出没的天使就是“终末地”的杰作。在辟谣之前，你决定先找到希茜。
summary_sm1l1m10_5_001.en: You run into two refugees and they share a rumor about how this place was an Endfield test site and the local Aggeloi were the results of Endfield experiments. You decide to talk to Manager Cynthia before busting the rumors.

summary_sm1l1m10_8_001.cn: 你和希茜没有找到天使聚集的实际原因。但针对终末地的流言等待着平息，你决定等回到枢纽区基地后与避难者们谈谈。
summary_sm1l1m10_8_001.en: You and Cynthia fail to find out why the Aggeloi are gathering. However, rumors about Endfield must be addressed. You decide to head back to the Hub Base and have a talk with the refugees.

summary_sm1l1m10_9_001.cn: 经过了你的亲自澄清，曾被你救下的避难者们很快便解除了对终末地的误会。
summary_sm1l1m10_9_001.en: You personally explain the situation to the people. The refugees whom you saved before quickly dispel their concerns and misunderstandings about Endfield.

summary_sm1l1m11_1_001.cn: 你顺利地为秦茳尺分担了一部分工作，但她的日程依然很满。灾后重建是个漫长的过程，未来还有更多事情需要你们一同面对。
summary_sm1l1m11_1_001.en: You've taken some weight off Qin Jiangchi's shoulders, but her duty roster stays crimson. Rebuilding after catastrophe takes years, and you'll be sharing every battle ahead.

summary_sm1l1m1_13_001.cn: 在一所裂地者占据的房屋外，你找到了工团被抢走的多功能播报器。但为了自己与菲奥娜的耳朵着想，你不得不想办法将它关闭。
summary_sm1l1m1_13_001.en: You found the looted general-purpose broadcaster outside a house occupied by the Landbreakers. You also have to figure out a way to switch it off to protect Fiona's sanity, as well as that of your own.

summary_sm1l1m1_14_001.cn: 回到源石副产物中心，你将“工作提效智能终端”与找到的物资交还给了负责人萨特，但却从萨特那里得知，被抢走的物资中还有部分胶棉炸药未被找到……
summary_sm1l1m1_14_001.en: You return to the Originium BPPC and give both the Smart Performance Booster and the recovered supplies to UWST monitor Satyr. The monitor then tells you about gel-cotton explosives that went missing as well...

summary_sm1l1m1_1_001.cn: 你上前询问后得知，这位名叫“乔斯特”的基地警卫正在研究一块被裂地者画上图案的石头，他很想破解其中的奥秘。最终，你在菲奥娜的提醒下决定尝试扫描这块石头……
summary_sm1l1m1_1_001.en: You talk to a base security officer named Jouster. He is investigating a piece of rock suspected to be covered with Landbreaker graffiti, and he is interested in its secrets. Fiona then advises you to scan the rock...

summary_sm1l1m1_2_001.cn: 完成扫描后，石头上确实出现了图案，但仍然没法看清全貌。
summary_sm1l1m1_2_001.en: The scan reveals some glyphs on the rocks but you cannot see all of them.

summary_sm1l1m1_3_001.cn: 在乔斯特的提议下，你决定前往源石副产物中心——那里不久前遭到了裂地者的袭击，现场或许会有关于裂地者行动的线索。
summary_sm1l1m1_3_001.en: You follow Jouster's advice and go to the Originium Byproduct Processing Center (BPPC). The place was recently attacked by Landbreakers and there might be several clues on breaker activities.

summary_sm1l1m1_7_001.cn: 你从工团在源石副产物中心的负责人——萨特那里了解了裂地者袭击的详情。得知你打算追查那群裂地者的去向，萨特希望你能帮忙把被裂地者抢走的“工作提效智能终端”带回来。
summary_sm1l1m1_7_001.en: You talk to Satyr, the UWST monitor of the Originium Byproduct Processing Center (BPPC). He gives you details about the Landbreakers. When Satyr learns that you intend to track down the Landbreakers, he hopes you can recover the Smart Performance Booster that the raiders looted from his site.

summary_sm1l1m2_1_001.cn: 你回到了之前去过的裂地者营地，在疑似重启的巢雕前发现了一名正处于癫狂状态的裂地者。通过他的只言片语，你推断出巢雕的雾气与碾骨氏族的涂鸦印记可能存在某种关联。
summary_sm1l1m2_1_001.en: You return to the Landbreaker Camp you visited and find a mad landbreaker standing near a re-activated denstack. From his insane ramblings, you figure out that the haze emitted by the denstacks may have something to do with the Bonekrusher graffiti.

summary_sm1l1m2_3d8_001.cn: 你在山洞深处找到了一些工团被抢的物资。遗憾的是，这里依然没有那些丢失的胶棉炸药。
summary_sm1l1m2_3d8_001.en: You find the looted UWST supplies deep inside the cave. Unfortunately, the gel-cotton explosives are still nowhere to be found.

summary_sm1l1m2_4_001.cn: 在山洞中，你遇到了被裂地者关进铁笼中的警卫乔斯特。在向你描述自己被抓的经过后，乔斯特提出了他对枢纽区基地附近裂地者涂鸦的猜测，并将他个人用于研究的记录本送给了你。
summary_sm1l1m2_4_001.en: You find security officer Jouster locked in a cage within the cave. Jouster tells you how he was captured and shares his ideas about the Landbreaker graffiti found near the Hub Base. He then gives you a notebook with his research notes.

summary_sm1l1m4_1_001.cn: 枢纽区基地的物流主管因为四号谷地发生的事忙得无法抽身。她想拜托你与埃里克松商贸公司的人洽谈合作的相关事宜。你可以凭借自己的判断，将合作方的信息记录到档案当中。
summary_sm1l1m4_1_001.en: The logistics director of Hub Base is too busy cleaning up the aftermath of the Valley IV incident. She wonders if you can negotiate with an agent of Erikssohn Trading House. Use your judgment and gather records about Erikssohn's agent.

summary_sm1l1m4_2_001.cn: 你见到了埃里克松商贸的高级业务员哈特曼。按照约定，你需要铺设一组滑索架，为他安排产品演示。
summary_sm1l1m4_2_001.en: You meet Hartmann, a senior sales rep of Erikssohn Trading House. According to the agreement, you must deploy a zipline pylon and give the agent a product demo.

summary_sm1l1m4_3_001.cn: 哈特曼对滑索非常满意，决定立刻与终末地签约。准备签约时，他发现合同落在了车里，哈特曼前去取回合同，与你们约定在枢纽区基地入口会合。
summary_sm1l1m4_3_001.en: Hartmann is very pleased with the zipline and decides to sign a contract with Endfield. However, he then realizes that he left his contract in the car. Hartmann runs off to retrieve the contract and tells you to meet with him at the Hub Base entrance.

summary_sm1l1m4_4_001.cn: 哈特曼受了严重的伤，狼卫建议利用附近的植物为他止血。
summary_sm1l1m4_4_001.en: Hartmann is severely injured. Wulfgard recommends using local plants to stop the bleeding.

summary_sm1l1m4_5_001.cn: 哈特曼告知你们，他遭遇了裂地者的袭击，合同也被劫走。他关于裂地者的描述令狼卫有所怀疑——那不像是裂地者会说的话。狼卫建议在事故现场调查一下。
summary_sm1l1m4_5_001.en: Hartmann tells you he was attacked by Landbreakers and they also took his contract. However, Wulfgard becomes suspicious of Hartmann's description of the Landbreakers and the words they said. He recommends investigating the site of the attack.

summary_sm1l1m4_6_001.cn: 狼卫认为事故更像是文明环带的“文明人”所为。
summary_sm1l1m4_6_001.en: Wulfgard believes the accident was a setup by Banders pretending to be Landbreakers.

summary_sm1l1m4_7_001.cn: 在狼卫的暗示下，你并未向哈特曼透露更多信息。哈特曼无奈地表示与终末地的交易需要推迟了。
summary_sm1l1m4_7_001.en: Wulfgard secretly asks you to hide your findings from Hartmann. The agent has no choice but to delay the deal with Endfield.

summary_sm1l1m5_1_001.cn: 你们见到了自称来自埃里克松商贸公司的业务员亚历山大。他表示自己不认识哈特曼，并称哈特曼是“诈骗犯”。另一位自称汉斯的业务员表示自己近日也深受“诈骗犯”所害。在签约前，你打算先记录下亚历山大的信息。
summary_sm1l1m5_1_001.en: You meet with Aleksandr who claims to be an agent of Erikssohn Trading House. He claims to know nothing about Hartmann and tells you that he might be a "scammer". Another agent named Hans who happens to be passing by also tells you how he became a recent victim. Before signing the contract, you decide to make a file of Agent Aleksandr.

summary_sm1l1m5_2_001.cn: 哈特曼匆匆赶来拦住你。他与亚历山大互相指责对方是诈骗犯。哈特曼拿出公司的终端，准备证明亚历山大并不存在于埃里克松商贸的员工名册中。
summary_sm1l1m5_2_001.en: Hartmann rushes over to stop you. He and Aleksandr then mutually accuse each other as scammers. Hartmann shows you his company's handyterm to prove that Aleksandr is not on the list of Erikssohn employees.

summary_sm1l1m5_3_001.cn: 亚历山大承认自己耍了小手段——他其实是克莱韦思环塔贸易公司的员工。亚历山大表示埃里克松商贸经营不善，与其和哈特曼签约，不如选择自己。他给了你一份来自克莱韦思环塔商贸公司的合同。
summary_sm1l1m5_3_001.en: Aleksandr admits that he used some tricks and reveals that he is actually working for Clavis TGCC Trading. He then tells you that Erikssohn is doing very poorly and offers you a contract from Clavis, claiming that partnering with his company will be a wiser choice.

summary_sm1l1m6_1_001.cn: 佩丽卡根据线索推测：亚历山大很可能在假冒克莱韦思环塔贸易公司的员工。你让狼卫跟着亚历山大，探寻亚历山大所隐瞒的事情。
summary_sm1l1m6_1_001.en: Perlica's intel suggests that Aleksandr may be masquerading as an employee of Clavis as well. You tell Wulfgard to shadow Aleksandr and try to find out what the agent is hiding.

summary_sm1l1m6_2_001.cn: 亚历山大确实曾经是克莱韦思环塔贸易公司的员工，汉斯似乎也并非是单纯路过。可以肯定的是，哈特曼被抢劫的事确实有亚历山大的参与。你们决定再去哈特曼被抢劫的地点看看。
summary_sm1l1m6_2_001.en: Aleksandr is a former employee of Clavis and Hans was not just passing by. It is quite certain that Aleksandr played a role in the attack on Hartmann. You decide to investigate the site of the attack again.

summary_sm1l1m6_4_001.cn: 汉斯背后的门德斯工业是哈特曼遇袭事件的幕后主导，目的是让亚历山大实行他自己的计划。你们决定与这三位业务员谈谈。
summary_sm1l1m6_4_001.en: Hans and his employer Mendez Manufacturing are the mastermind behind the attack on Hartmann. Their aim is to get Aleksandr to carry out his plans. You decide to have a chat with the three agents.

summary_sm1l1m6_5_001.cn: 面对铁证，临阵逃跑的汉斯和其背后的门德斯工业难逃其咎。哈特曼见到亚历山大可怜的模样也产生了恻隐之心。但是，终末地该继续与谁合作的决定权仍在你的手上。
summary_sm1l1m6_5_001.en: You reveal solid evidence. Though Hans flees the scene, he and his employer Mendez Manufacturing will have to answer for their actions. Hartmann also becomes sympathetic to Aleksandr's plight. Regardless, you still get to decide whom Endfield should work with.

summary_sm1l1m6_7_001.cn: 你回去找到了终末地工业的枢纽区基地的物流主管莎曼，告诉了她自己的抉择。
summary_sm1l1m6_7_001.en: You return to Salman, the logistics director of Endfield Industries at Hub Base, and inform her of your choice.

summary_sm1l1m7_1_001.cn: 四号谷地的危机刚刚平息，秦茳尺的工作繁多，抽不开身。你看到她忙碌的样子，决定替她分担一些工作。
summary_sm1l1m7_1_001.en: The Valley IV crisis has been recently averted but Director Qin is getting overwhelmed by work. You decide to help her share some of the burden.

summary_sm1l1m8_1_001.cn: 旧工厂区的工作人员莱科与莱雅想拜托你关闭不稳定的源石精炼炉。
summary_sm1l1m8_1_001.en: Lykor and Laeya are workers at the Old Factory. They need your help to shut down an unstable Originium Refining Unit.

summary_sm1l1m8_4_001.cn: 灾难对莱雅的冲击太大，让她不敢再接近现场。安抚过莱雅后，莱科决定自己一个人带你进去操作。
summary_sm1l1m8_4_001.en: The disaster has severely traumatized Laeya and she is too scared to enter the site itself. After comforting her, Lykor decides to take you into the place on his own so that you can perform the repairs.

summary_sm1l1m8_5_001.cn: 克服恐惧跟上你们的莱雅迅速找到了症结所在。她负责处理坏掉的控制终端，你需要将另外一个控制终端的电源关掉。
summary_sm1l1m8_5_001.en: Laeya overcomes her fears and catches up with you. She then identifies the source of the problem and takes it upon herself to fix the broken terminal. You must help her by shutting off the power to the other terminal.

summary_sm1l1m8_6_001.cn: 成功关停设备后，莱雅重新找回了勇气。塔卫二上仍然存在许多威胁，只有铭记使命、互相支持，才能在危难中坚持下来。
summary_sm1l1m8_6_001.en: Laeya rediscovers her courage after successfully switching off the facility. Many threats still exist on Talos-II. Only those who remember their duty and work with each other can endure these dangers.

summary_sm1l1m9_14_001.cn: 你解决了物资与药品的燃眉之急，但那些留在工人们心中的创口还需要时间来修复。
summary_sm1l1m9_14_001.en: You have solved the shortage of supplies and medication. The wounds of the mind, however, will need some time to heal.

summary_sm1l1m9_15_001.cn: 埃里克对自己无法帮助工人们恢复情绪感到沮丧。你和卢告诉他，很多事情只能交给时间。
summary_sm1l1m9_15_001.en: Eric feels sad when he realizes there is nothing he can do to help his crew feel better. You and Lou tell him that only time can mend the wounds.

summary_sm1l1m9_1_001.cn: 埃里克与卢向你介绍了工人之家恢复工作的情况。你打算和埃里克一起了解工人们的实际需求。
summary_sm1l1m9_1_001.en: Eric and Lou update you on the Worker Dorms repairs. You figure it's best to tag along with Eric and hear the workers out directly.

summary_sm1l1m9_2_001.cn: 你了解到，目前这里医疗物资短缺的问题较为棘手。
summary_sm1l1m9_2_001.en: The shortage of medical supplies is a serious problem.

summary_sm1l1m9_3_001.cn: 工团的老人威尔伯告诉你，工团物流站站长埃斯顿受伤了，他曾叮嘱过威尔伯有一批物资近期会到，但不知为何一直没有消息。
summary_sm1l1m9_3_001.en: UWST veteran Wilbur informs you that UWST logistics station monitor Eston has been wounded. Eston told Wilbur to expect incoming supplies, but they never arrived.

summary_sm1l1m9_4_001.cn: 名叫斯坦利的孩子告诉你，他想要听些音乐。
summary_sm1l1m9_4_001.en: A boy named Stanley hopes to listen to some music

summary_sm1l1m9_5_001.cn: 你和埃里克认为，目前工人们的需求主要集中在药品和物资两个方面。
summary_sm1l1m9_5_001.en: Medicine and supplies are the two most pressing needs of the crew.

summary_sm1l2m1_0d5_011.cn: 得知干员弧光发出了援助请求，你们决定找她本人问问情况。
summary_sm1l2m1_0d5_011.en: You learn that Operator Arclight sends out a request for help. You decide to talk to her and ask about the situation.

summary_sm1l2m1_1_001.cn: 前方等待你们的人不是弧光，而是卡贾。原来，难民暂居处的米娅失踪了，是卡贾拜托弧光联系终末地寻求帮助。弧光已经沿着米娅涂改过的裂地者涂鸦前去寻找了，你们决定也顺着这个线索找下去。
summary_sm1l2m1_1_001.en: You expect to meet with Arclight but Karja shows up instead. Turns out that Mia of the refugee camp has gone missing and he asked Arclight to call Endfield for help. Arclight has already started the search by tracking down Landbreaker graffiti that Mia drew over. You decide to follow the same clues.

summary_sm1l2m1_2_001.cn: 你们在最后的涂鸦前发现了米娅的笔，地面上残留着打斗的痕迹。这里曾经是碾骨氏族的领地，你们需要小心前进。
summary_sm1l2m1_2_001.en: You find Mia's brush at the last graffiti as well as signs of fighting. A Bonekrushers "lab" is up ahead. You decide to proceed carefully.

summary_sm1l2m1_3_001.cn: 你们见到了弧光，她在山壁上发现了一处暗门。佩丽卡建议你做一次扫描，以寻找打开暗门的机关。
summary_sm1l2m1_3_001.en: You meet Arclight. She has found a secret door in the rock wall. Perlica suggests performing a scan to reveal the door opening mechanism.

summary_sm1l2m1_4_001.cn: 弧光的源石技艺对机关无效。问题似乎出在源石电路上，你尝试使用自己的的力量修复开门机关。
summary_sm1l2m1_4_001.en: Arclight's Originium Arts fail to work on the mechanism. You suspect the problem lies in the Originium circuitry, so you attempt to use your powers to repair the door switch.

summary_sm1l2m2_10_001.cn: 你们终于离开了地牢，重见天日。众生长地与弧光给你留下了深刻的印象。在未来的日子里，作为游人与终末地干员的她，还会与你再次相遇。
summary_sm1l2m2_10_001.en: You left the cave and returned to the surface. Arclight and the Hannabit Circuit have left you quite an impression. You have a feeling that the Songseeker and Endfield Operator Arclight will cross paths with you again.

summary_sm1l2m2_11_001.cn: 你们护送米娅与扎克等人回到难民暂居处。米娅与家人重逢的场景令所有人动容，扎克一行人也找到了新的家园，准备开启全新的生活。
summary_sm1l2m2_11_001.en: You escort Mia, Zach, and the other refugees to the refugee camp. Mia's reunion with her family is especially touching. Zach and his friends also receive a new home and prepare themselves for new lives ahead of them.

summary_sm1l2m2_2_001.cn: 你们找到了米娅，迷路的她被几位“哥哥姐姐”搭救了。根据米娅的描述，救她的人目前处境十分危险，你们决定尽快寻找到他们。
summary_sm1l2m2_2_001.en: You find Mia. She told you she got lost but was rescued by several grown-ups. From what Mia said, you deduce that those who rescued her are in danger. You decide to locate them quickly.

summary_sm1l2m2_3_001.cn: 你们在一个牢房里找到了搭救米娅的人。其中一人名叫扎克，他告诉你们，对面路上的小房间里应该有开启铁门的钥匙。
summary_sm1l2m2_3_001.en: You find the people who rescued Mia in one of the cells. A nomad named Zach tells you to find the cage key from the room on the opposite side of the road.

summary_sm1l2m2_4_001.cn: 弧光可以制作热能刀切开牢门，你们需要搜集一些制作会用到的金属元件。
summary_sm1l2m2_4_001.en: Arclight can craft a thermal lance for cutting through the cage door. Collect some metal components needed for the crafting.

summary_sm1l2m2_5_001.cn: 似乎有裂地者袭来，你们需要掩护弧光进行“热指头”的制作。
summary_sm1l2m2_5_001.en: SCENE: Landbreakers might be attacking. You must protect Arclight while she's crafting the hot finger.

summary_sm1l2m2_7_001.cn: 扎克一行人感谢了你们的救命之恩。你们决定把他们带回难民暂居处。
summary_sm1l2m2_7_001.en: Zach and his group thank you for the rescue. You make the call to escort them back to the refugee camp.

summary_sm1l2m2_8_001.cn: 担忧的逃难者仍对四号谷地的危险心有余悸，弧光告诉对方会带他们去安全的难民暂居地。
summary_sm1l2m2_8_001.en: People are still worried and fearful of the crisis that struck Valley IV. Arclight assures them she will take them to a secure shelter.

summary_sm1l2m3_1_001.cn: 你们救出了一位名叫瓦茨的神秘人物。他的行李被裂地者夺去，在将其寻回之前，瓦茨不打算离开。
summary_sm1l2m3_1_001.en: You save a mysterious prisoner named Waitz. His luggage has been seized by the Landbreakers. Waitz does not intend to leave until he recovers all of them.

summary_sm1l2m3_2_001.cn: 你们找回了瓦茨丢失的行李，但他的失物不止一件，他打算自行寻找剩余的部分。
summary_sm1l2m3_2_001.en: Waitz's recovered belongings now sit secured, but the job's only half-done. He insists on tracking down the remaining items himself.

summary_sm1l2m3_3_001.cn: 你们再次找到了瓦茨，决定帮助他从裂地者手中找回遗失的货物。
summary_sm1l2m3_3_001.en: You find Waitz once again and decide to help reclaim his cargo,

summary_sm1l2m3_4_001.cn: 你们追回了一些货物，瓦茨认为剩余的部分可能被裂地者藏进了山洞。
summary_sm1l2m3_4_001.en: You recover part of the cargo. Waitz suspects the Landbreakers have stashed the remainder in the caverns ahead.

summary_sm1l2m3_5_001.cn: 瓦茨称，他丢失的货物里有一些对四号谷地至关重要的物品，可以拯救许多危难中的生命。
summary_sm1l2m3_5_001.en: Those crates held more than goods. They carry Valley IV's survival.

summary_sm1l2m3_7_001.cn: 你终于发现，瓦茨所谓“至关重要的物品”实际上是一组应急物资。得知四号谷地发生意外，他第一时间准备了物资，志愿前来提供帮助。
summary_sm1l2m3_7_001.en: You finally realize that Waitz's cargo of utmost importance is just a batch of emergency supplies. After learning of the crisis in Valley IV, he prepped a batch of supplies, brought them here on his own, and volunteered to give help.

summary_sm1l2m3_8_001.cn: 你帮瓦茨找回了所有物资，他希望能与四号谷地还在运作的管理机构合作，将它们分发出去。
summary_sm1l2m3_8_001.en: You help Waitz recover all the supplies. He wishes to work with various organizations in Valley IV to distribute his provisions.

summary_sm1l2m4_3_001.cn: 你找到的裂地者“宝藏”正是工团丢失的胶棉炸药。在联系萨特前来回收后，事情总算告一段落。
summary_sm1l2m4_3_001.en: The Landbreakers' "treasure trove" you find happens to be the missing UWST gel-cotton. You call Satyr to collect his explosives and conclude the mission.

summary_sm1l3m1_0d2_001.cn: 这道门通往阿伯莉采石场。
summary_sm1l3m1_0d2_001.en: This gate leads to the Aburrey Quarry.

summary_sm1l3m1_1_001.cn: 你见到了陈千语。此处与阿伯莉采石场还有些距离，你们需要寻找进入采石场的方法。
summary_sm1l3m1_1_001.en: You meet Chen Qianyu not too far from the Aburrey Quarry. You must find a way to get inside the place.

summary_sm1l3m1_2_001.cn: 你们见到了阿伯莉采石场的负责人拉蒙，他想寻找失联的工友。但道路被毁，你们需要先维修好采石场的大型起重机才能连通道路。你决定先去看看起重机供电中枢的情况。
summary_sm1l3m1_2_001.en: You meet the Aburrey Quarry monitor Ramon. He wants to find fellow crew mates who went offline. However, many paths in the quarry have been destroyed. The super lifting crane must be repaired to access various locations. You decide to look at the power nexus of the super crane.

summary_sm1l3m2_10_001.cn: 佩妮告诉你们：跳到吊臂上方，从附近的维修通道下去后再调整吊臂的角度，就能搭出一条通往深层管理区的路了。
summary_sm1l3m2_10_001.en: Penny tells you to jump to the top of the crane arm, head down via the maintenance shaft close by, then turn the arm to the proper angle to create a path to the Deep Management Post.

summary_sm1l3m2_11d1_001.cn: 通讯中传来异响，在吊臂上方待命的工团救援小组似乎遇到了什么麻烦。
summary_sm1l3m2_11d1_001.en: You hear strange noises through your handyterm. The UWST SAR crew standing by the crane arm seems to be in trouble.

summary_sm1l3m2_12_001.cn: 你与陈千语决定立即前去查看工团救援小组的情况。
summary_sm1l3m2_12_001.en: You and Chen decide to check if the UWST SAR Crew is alright.

summary_sm1l3m2_1_001.cn: 维修起重机的供电中枢还需要用到起重机改造时使用的图纸，采石场旧址——“联络区”的档案库内，应该还保留着它。你与陈千语需要利用起重机的吊舱前往联络区。
summary_sm1l3m2_1_001.en: You need the schematics once used when modifying the super crane power nexus. A copy should be kept at the Archives in the Listening Post (which used to be the Old Quarry). You and Chen must use the super crane lifting cage to reach the Listening Post.

summary_sm1l3m2_3_001.cn: 被搭救的工团成员米菈惦记着未完成的重要工作，她也需要前往档案库，陈千语邀请她与你们同行。
summary_sm1l3m2_3_001.en: You save Mila, a UWST crew mate, but she intends to complete her important job. Since she is also going to the Archive, Chen invites her to join your team.

summary_sm1l3m2_4_001.cn: 米菈仍有工作需要完成。你们研读图纸后与她告别，准备返回吊运中枢。
summary_sm1l3m2_4_001.en: You finish reading the schematics and prepare to return to the Lifter Central. Mila decides to stay behind and finish her job.

summary_sm1l3m2_6_001.cn: 起重机被成功重启了。你察觉到了拉蒙的异样：原来，阿伯莉采石场即将被关闭，采石场的大家都有些依依不舍。在这最后的时间里，他希望可以让更多人好好告别，安全离开——这便是他能做到的最好的“收尾工作”了。
summary_sm1l3m2_6_001.en: You successfully reactivate the super crane but notice something strange about Ramon. Turns out that the Aburrey Quarry will be shutting down and the quarry crew seems very attached to this site. Ramon hopes the crew can leave the place and say their farewells safely. This is his final closing job for this place.

summary_sm1l3m2_7_001.cn: 你与陈千语决定前往采石作业区。
summary_sm1l3m2_7_001.en: You and Chen decide to go to the Quarry Site.

summary_sm1l3m2_8_001.cn: 有声音阻止了你们前进——一位老妇人劝你们别走这条不太好走的路。
summary_sm1l3m2_8_001.en: You suddenly hear an old lady warning you not to take the more difficult path.

summary_sm1l3m2_9_001.cn: 老妇人名叫佩妮——正是拉蒙一直在寻找的人。她认出了你们来自终末地。得知你们要去深层管理区，佩妮爽快地为你们带路。
summary_sm1l3m2_9_001.en: The old lady, Penny, is the one that Ramon has been looking for. She knows you are Endfielders and when she hears you are headed towards the Deep Management Post, she happily agrees to lead the way.

summary_sm1l3m3_1_001.cn: 工团的救援人手短缺，你们决定出手相助。工团救援人员交给了你们一张电梯钥匙卡，利用它便可通过电梯深入深层管理区实施救援了。
summary_sm1l3m3_1_001.en: You decide to help the understaffed UWST SAR Crew. The SAR crew mates give you an elevator key card. The elevator will take you down into the Deep Management Post for the SAR mission.

summary_sm1l3m3_2_001.cn: 你们营救了几名工团成员。其中一名叫菲莉丝的工友告诉你们，只要修好一旁的备用电梯，他们便可直接撤离回地面了。
summary_sm1l3m3_2_001.en: You rescue several UWST crew mates. One of them, Phyllis, tells you that you can simply repair the backup elevator nearby. The elevator will take everyone directly to the surface.

summary_sm1l3m3_2d4_001.cn: 菲莉丝并非深层管理区的工作人员，她来到此地是为了寻找有关阿伯莉采石场的资料，并试图从中找到一些能避免采石场被关停的方法。
summary_sm1l3m3_2d4_001.en: Phyllis is not a crew mate of the Deep Management Post. She came to this place looking for data about the Aburrey Quarry as she is trying to find ways to prevent the Quarry from getting shut down.

summary_sm1l3m3_3_001.cn: 众人终于重见天日。拉蒙联络你们返回吊运中枢。
summary_sm1l3m3_3_001.en: You and the crew return to the surface. Ramon contacts you and you return to Lifter Central.

summary_sm1l3m3_4_001.cn: 拉蒙感谢了你们。米菈、佩妮和菲莉丝也回来了，陈千语建议你过去看看。
summary_sm1l3m3_4_001.en: Ramon thanks you for your help. Mila, Penny, and Phyllis have returned. Chen asks if you can go and meet them.

summary_sm1l3m3_5_001.cn: 原来，佩妮早已为阿伯莉采石场的众人争取了更好的待遇。她甚至递交了申请，包括起重机在内的许多设备可以与大家一同搬迁到新的采石场。
summary_sm1l3m3_5_001.en: Penny has been fighting for better pay for the Aburrey Quarry crew. She even submitted an application to move the fleet of machinery, including the super crane, to the new quarry.

summary_sm1l3m3_5d3_001.cn: 佩妮希望自己的徒弟们有着属于自己的道路。
summary_sm1l3m3_5d3_001.en: Penny wants her apprentices to start their own careers properly.

summary_sm1l5m1_10_001.cn: 似乎不是这位拍展示照的男士。
summary_sm1l5m1_10_001.en: Hmm. I'm afraid our businessman taking display photos ... isn't the journalist we're looking for.

summary_sm1l5m1_11_001.cn: 似乎不是这位借用眼镜的小姑娘。
summary_sm1l5m1_11_001.en: The girl wearing someone else's glasses is not the one.

summary_sm1l5m1_12_001.cn: 似乎不是这位要与人私奔的女士。
summary_sm1l5m1_12_001.en: The eloping lady is probably not the one.

summary_sm1l5m1_13_001.cn: 眼前这位可疑的女士，正是“那名记者”——拉奎尔·琼斯。你们联系了艾莱扎·柯林斯，准备与她会合。
summary_sm1l5m1_13_001.en: This suspicious lady happens to be Raquel Jones, the journalist you are looking for. You call Aleeza Collins to meet up with you.

summary_sm1l5m1_14_001.cn: 拉奎尔拒绝立刻离开四号谷地，艾莱扎·柯林斯将她带回工团看管。艾维文娜决定问问在环塔商会的记者朋友是否有能说服拉奎尔的办法。有消息之后，她会来联系你。
summary_sm1l5m1_14_001.en: Raquel refuses to leave Valley IV immediately. Aleeza Collins has no choice but to bring her back to the UWST camp where she will be detained. Avywenna decides to ask if her TGCC journalist friends can persuade Raquel to head back. She will give you a call once she makes progress.

summary_sm1l5m1_1_001.cn: 一位疑似来自环塔商会的记者一直在扰乱工团的工作。法比安·柯林斯拜托终末地从中调停，将对方送离四号谷地。这名记者正在难民暂居处内，艾莱扎·柯林斯已经前去调查情况了。
summary_sm1l5m1_1_001.en: A suspicious journalist from the TGCC is disrupting work at a UWST site. Fabian Collins asks if Endfield can help escort the Bander out of Valley IV. The reporter is currently hiding in the Valley Pass Camp. Aleeza Collins has already gone ahead to investigate.

summary_sm1l5m1_3_001.cn: 你遇见了一位信使装扮的卡特斯女性，她叫艾维文娜，就职于终末地，是这次与你一同行动的搭档。
summary_sm1l5m1_3_001.en: You meet a Cautus messenger named Avywenna. She is an Endfielder and your partner for this mission.

summary_sm1l5m1_4_001.cn: 艾维文娜推测那名记者是一位戴眼镜的菲林女性。考虑到她或许会变装，其他的信息暂时无法确定。
summary_sm1l5m1_4_001.en: Avywenna believes the Bander journalist is a Feline woman with glasses. Other pointers cannot be verified as the journalist is reputedly a master of disguise.

summary_sm1l5m1_5_001.cn: 这名菲林男性因为拍照，与工团的人起了矛盾，但似乎只是普通的小纠纷。
summary_sm1l5m1_5_001.en: A Feline man got into an altercation with a UWST crew mate for taking photographs, but the incident feels like a common argument.

summary_sm1l5m1_6_001.cn: 这名菲林女性正戴着眼镜玩耍，但她的视力似乎是正常的。
summary_sm1l5m1_6_001.en: A Feline Woman is playing around with glasses but her eyesight seems to be normal.

summary_sm1l5m1_7_001.cn: 这名菲林女性的行为鬼鬼祟祟，但她看上去非常紧张，似乎在等待谁。
summary_sm1l5m1_7_001.en: You see a suspicious Feline Lady. She looks very nervous and seems to be waiting for someone.

summary_sm1l5m1_8_001.cn: 这名菲林女性看上去平平无奇，但气质与这里格格不入。她似乎在记录着什么。
summary_sm1l5m1_8_001.en: This Feline woman appears pretty ordinary but her actions do not look very local. She seems to be taking notes of various things.

summary_sm1l5m2_1_001.cn: 拉奎尔逃走了。在你和艾维文娜准备前往寻找她的时候，一个陌生的号码联络上了艾维文娜。
summary_sm1l5m2_1_001.en: Raquel has escaped. You and Avywenna are preparing to go after her when the Cautus messenger receives a mysterious call.

summary_sm1l5m2_6_001.cn: 遗落的终端似乎表明了拉奎尔被裂地者掳走的可能性。现在追踪这群裂地者的去向还来得及。
summary_sm1l5m2_6_001.en: The lost handyterm seems to suggest that Raquel has been captured by the Landbreakers. You still have time to catch up to these LBs and rescue the Bander journalist.

summary_sm1l5m2_7_001.cn: 你们成功搭救了拉奎尔。她惊惧之余，似乎也有了新的灵感。她表示这次会乖乖听话。
summary_sm1l5m2_7_001.en: You successfully save Raquel. Though terrified by the ordeal, she seems to have acquired a new inspiration. The journalist promises to behave this time.

summary_sm1l5m2_8_001.cn: 终末地的干员护送拉奎尔离开了四号谷地。艾维文娜圆满完成了任务，与你告别。
summary_sm1l5m2_8_001.en: A team of Endfielders escorts Raquel safely away from Valley IV. Avywenna concludes her mission and says goodbye.

summary_sm1l5m3_1_001.cn: 你们发现基建前站工地上的工人们疲惫不堪，工程进度受到灾害影响而延误。尽管你和陈千语建议休整，但工人代表诺夫曼坚持按命令继续工作。

summary_sm1l5m3_2_001.cn: 你和陈千语遇到一位名叫大潘的厨师，他在基建前站的工地附近做饭，并与你们分享了一些自己了解的情况。

summary_sm1l5m3_5_001.cn: 你们讨论了基建前站工地的情况，发现交通是当前最大的问题——灾难导致横跨峡谷的桥梁坍塌，裂谷阻断了基建前站与工团核心区域的道路。为解决交通问题，大潘建议建造滑索运输人员和货物。

summary_sm1l5m3_7_001.cn: 诺夫曼对新设备很期待。他向你们介绍了基建前站的功能。它原本计划用于设备的研发和生产，但正好可以在重建四号谷地时派上用场。

summary_sm1l5m4_1_001.cn: 诺夫曼和陈千语就是否前往有侵蚀的总控中心出现争执：诺夫曼认为可以按标准流程推进，而陈千语担心安全问题。大潘试图通过做饭的话题来缓解紧张气氛。

summary_sm1l5m4_2_001.cn: 你和陈千语、大潘商议如何劝阻诺夫曼，最终决定模仿卡尔的笔迹来给出建议。

summary_sm1l5m4_3_001.cn: 诺夫曼看了卡尔老师的“工作笔记”，意识到自己太心急。你和陈千语决定先前往总控中心查看情况，并考虑联系支援。大潘决定一同前往。

summary_sm1l5m4_4_001.cn: 总控中心的设备发生了结构性损坏，大潘表示他有能力修理，但需要你帮忙收集备用零件。

summary_sm1l5m4_6_001.cn: 大潘修好了设备，却不打算与你一同回基建前站工地。他拜托你将桂花糕带给诺夫曼。

summary_sm1l5m4_7_001.cn: 诺夫曼收到了大潘送的桂花糕，回想起他的老师卡尔曾提及的那位朋友，他若有所悟，似乎明白了卡尔和大潘之间的关系。

summary_sm1l6m1_1_001.cn: 矿区营地药物短缺的情况严重，药物很可能是在运输过程中出了意外。一位名叫莉莉卡的女孩需要急救，佩丽卡决定为小女孩先使用应急的便携药物。
summary_sm1l6m1_1_001.en: The Mining Camp is extremely short on medication. The Endfield medical supplies probably met an accident during transportation. A girl named Lilica is in desperate need of help. Perlica decides to administer some emergency portable medication.

summary_sm1l6m1_2_011.cn: 你们把莉莉卡送到病床上，还发现了莉莉卡口中“莫莉姐姐”的证件。
summary_sm1l6m1_2_011.en: You help Lilica to her bed and find an ID belonging to Molly — someone Lilica mentioned.

summary_sm1l6m1_3_001.cn: 莫莉是一名优秀的工团成员，她似乎在调查药物丢失一事。你认为，当务之急是找到那些不知去向的药物。
summary_sm1l6m1_3_001.en: Molly is an outstanding UWST crew mate and she seems to be investigating the missing medical supplies. You decide that the top priority is to locate the lost medication.

summary_sm1l6m1_4_001.cn: 一个来自工团的求救信号自废弃的气候监测站传来。那里早已成为裂地者的领地。你决定跟随求救信号前往气候监测站。
summary_sm1l6m1_4_001.en: You receive a UWST distress call from an abandoned meteorological station. The place has been occupied by the Landbreakers for a while. You decide to trace the call and head to the facility.

summary_sm1l6m1_5_001.cn: 几名工团成员潜入气候监测站寻回药物的时候，遭遇了裂地者。莫莉为了帮三位工友殿后，没能成功逃离裂地者的追捕。你们决定跟随带路的工团成员前去解救莫莉。
summary_sm1l6m1_5_001.en: Several UWST crew mates attempted to sneak into the meteorological station to recover the medical supplies. Unfortunately, they encountered the Landbreakers. Molly covered the retreat of three crew mates but ended up being captured by the raiders. You decide to follow the UWST crew into the facility and rescue Molly.

summary_sm1l6m1_6_001.cn: 菲奥娜发来了该区域的图纸，她提到有一处废弃的下水管道很适合潜入。你们告别了带路的工团成员，准备从下水管道潜入气候监测站。
summary_sm1l6m1_6_001.en: Fiona sends you the plans and layouts of this area. She mentions an abandoned sewer line that is perfect for sneaking into the meteorological station. You tell the UWST crew to head back and prepare yourself for the infiltration mission.

summary_sm1l6m2_1_001.cn: 你们看到莫莉正在被裂地者审问，莫莉没有回答，而是质问对方药品的位置。
summary_sm1l6m2_1_001.en: You see Landbreakers interrogating Molly, but she refuses to answer. Instead, she questions them about the location of the medical supplies.

summary_sm1l6m2_3_001.cn: 你们需要想办法避开侵蚀，离开这里。
summary_sm1l6m2_3_001.en: You must find a way through the Blight and leave this place.

summary_sm1l6m2_4_001.cn: 莫莉与裂地者谈判，试图劝他们还回药物。裂地者轻蔑地拒绝了她，并粗暴地毁坏了药物。此时，佩丽卡与你及时出现，与裂地者对峙。
summary_sm1l6m2_4_001.en: Molly tries to negotiate with the Landbreakers and offers herself in exchange for the medical supplies. The Chief rejects her outright and violently smashes the supplies. You and Perlica arrive at the scene and face off the LB brute.

summary_sm1l6m2_5_001.cn: 佩丽卡告知你还有部分药物可以回收利用。莫莉谢过你们，表示自己需要独自一个人走走。
summary_sm1l6m2_5_001.en: Perlica tells you that part of the medical supplies can still be salvaged. Molly thanks you and says she prefers being left alone for now.

summary_sm1l6m2_6_001.cn: 你们从越医生那里得知，莫莉自己申请了处分。佩丽卡传来消息：新一批药物很快便可以启运了。
summary_sm1l6m2_6_001.en: Molly applies for administrative punishment while Perlica sends you news. Delivery of the second batch of medical supplies will begin shortly.

summary_sm1l6m2_7_001.cn: 你们又见到了莫莉，她对重回基层岗位后的生活适应良好，但裂地者的生存法则还是对她的理念造成了冲击。
summary_sm1l6m2_7_001.en: You meet Molly again. She seems to be taking her demotion to a crew mate pretty well. However, the Landbreakers' rule of survival severely challenged her beliefs and ideals.

summary_sm1l6m3_17_001.cn: 你们赶往营地西北边的大门，发现詹娜正与马特维争执。你及时劝服了詹娜，阿丽娅也出言安抚了她的情绪，将她送回家中。
summary_sm1l6m3_17_001.en: You rush to the northwestern gate and find Jenner arguing with Matvei. You manage to convince Jenner in time. Alia also soothes her emotions and escorts her back home.

summary_sm1l6m3_1_001.cn: 你得知詹娜的病情很可能是矿石病导致的，而越医生为了给她配药，目前急需一批新的药材。
summary_sm1l6m3_1_001.en: You learn that Jenner's disease is probably caused by Oripathy. Medical Officer Yue needs a batch of new medical ingredients right now to give Jenner treatment.

summary_sm1l6m3_3_001.cn: 醒来的詹娜竟然没能认出阿丽娅，反而一眼认出了你。而在她的描述中，源石大树似乎还安然无恙……
summary_sm1l6m3_3_001.en: Jenner is awake but doesn't recognize Alia. Instead, she identifies you immediately. From her words, she seems to think that the Great Originium Oak is still around...

summary_sm1l6m3_4_001.cn: 越医生提醒你们，詹娜应该是出现了记忆回退，考虑到她的身体状况，尽量避免让她受到强烈刺激。你们意识到必须想办法向詹娜隐瞒源石大树已经被炸毁一事。而就在这时，詹娜那边似乎出现了新情况……
summary_sm1l6m3_4_001.en: Medical Officer Yue reminds you that Jenner's memory may be suffering from age regression. Given her physical condition, the best approach is to avoid exposing her to strong stimuli. You realize that you must figure out a way to hide the fact from Jenner that the Great Originium Oak has been blown up. While you are discussing, something happens to Jenner again...

summary_sm1l6m3_6_001.cn: 你们来到食堂，发现詹娜正与厨师争执，她质疑厨师竟然不会做工团的特色菜黄油羽兽。在和厨师解释了詹娜的特殊情况后，为了让詹娜吃到记忆中的菜肴，你决定向她询问这道菜的菜谱。
summary_sm1l6m3_6_001.en: You arrive at the canteen and find Jenner arguing with the chef. She questions why the chef doesn't know how to make the UWST signature dish of butter fowl. You inform the chef of Jenner's special condition. In order to serve Jenner the dish from her memories, you decide to ask her for its recipe.

summary_sm1l6m3_6d5_001.cn: 你从詹娜口中获悉了黄油羽兽的菜谱，并将之转告给了厨师。为了帮助厨师完成这道菜，你决定出发寻找缺少的食材——番茄罐头。
summary_sm1l6m3_6d5_001.en: You learn the butter fowl recipe from Jenner and inform the chef. To help out, you decide to hunt down the missing touch — canned tomatoes.

summary_sm1l6m3_8_001.cn: 你与马特维回到矿区营地，修建阻路工事的工团成员正因为人手不足而烦恼，马特维决定留下帮助他们，而你则需要尽快将找到的食材送往食堂。
summary_sm1l6m3_8_001.en: Matvei and you return to the Mining Camp. The UWST crew mates making the road barricades need more people, so Matvei decides to stay and help them. You, on the other hand, need to find the ingredients quickly and send them to the canteen.

summary_sm1l6m3_9_001.cn: 回到食堂，你将找到的番茄罐头交给了厨师。之后，詹娜终于吃上了久违的黄油羽兽，但她也因此回忆起当年广播会播放而如今却未能听到的歌曲，现实与记忆的矛盾令她陷入某种恍惚。
summary_sm1l6m3_9_001.en: You return to the canteen and give the canned tomatoes to the chef. Jenner finally gets some of the butter fowl she sorely missed. However, as she reminisces about the good old times, Jenner notices that the radio isn't playing the music she's used to. The dissonance between reality and her memories is making her rather confused.

summary_sm1l6m4_1_001.cn: 你找到阿丽娅，从她口中了解了詹娜失踪的详情。阿丽娅怀疑詹娜已经发现源石大树被炸毁，而在你的安抚下，阿丽娅平复了心情，决定先去寻找詹娜。
summary_sm1l6m4_1_001.en: You find Alia and she tells you the details about how Jenner went missing. Alia suspects that Jenner already knows the Great Originium Oak has been destroyed. You comfort Alia and help her feel better, then decide to look for Jenner.

summary_sm1l6m4_4_001.cn: 你与阿丽娅前往源石树苗的种植地。詹娜如同往常那样正在照料源石树苗，她似乎已经恢复如初，但随后却向你们托付了她一直以来的使命与心愿……
summary_sm1l6m4_4_001.en: Alia and you proceed to the Originium sapling garden. Jenner is tending to the Originium sapling as usual. She seems to have recovered. However, she passes on her lifelong mission and dreams to you...

summary_sm1l7m1_10_001.cn: 面对你们的质问，阿尔乔姆否认自己有背叛行为。你们决定把他交给安格鲁。
summary_sm1l7m1_10_001.en: You question Artyom but he denies any involvement in betraying the UWST. You decide to hand him over to Angro.

summary_sm1l7m1_11_001.cn: 两名最初的嫌疑人和你们中途发现的新嫌疑人均被控制，安格鲁和肖娜将顺着线索继续追查。
summary_sm1l7m1_11_001.en: Both the initial suspects and the new suspect you discovered midway have been detained, and Angro and Shawna will follow up on the clues to continue the investigation.

summary_sm1l7m1_12_001.cn: 工人们的爆发让事情变得更加复杂。为了稳住局势，也是为了能给逝去的工人一个交代，你决定站出来，不能让愤怒把即将揭开的真相重新掩埋。
summary_sm1l7m1_12_001.en: The crew mates' riot is further complicating the incident. You decide to step forward, not just to get the situation under control, but to give proper justice to the crew mates who lost their lives in the incursion. Fury must not bury the truth that is about to be revealed.

summary_sm1l7m1_13_001.cn: 在破解任务一筹莫展之际，你们想到，可以用源石技艺模拟同型号设备，重建运行模式，来加快进度。
summary_sm1l7m1_13_001.en: With conventional decryption at a standstill, you pivot to Originium Arts simulation to reconstruct the device's operational patterns.

summary_sm1l7m1_14_001.cn: 虽然你们洗刷了尤莉娅的叛徒嫌疑，但她依旧会因自己的严重违规行为受到严厉的惩罚。对其他嫌疑人的调查此时也有了进展。
summary_sm1l7m1_14_001.en: Though cleared of treason, Yulia now faces tribunal for her security breaches. Meanwhile, other suspects' shadows grow sharper under the investigative lens.

summary_sm1l7m1_15_001.cn: 潜伏的你们被中间人发现，正面冲突已经不可避免。
summary_sm1l7m1_15_001.en: You are trying to hide nearby when the go-between discovers you. Direct confrontation is unavoidable.

summary_sm1l7m1_16_001.cn: 账单证实了格奥尔基并非你们要寻找的叛徒。肖娜逼问中间人谁在和裂地者来往。随着她的追问，真正的罪人似乎浮出了水面。
summary_sm1l7m1_16_001.en: The manifest proves that Georgi is not the traitor you are looking for. Shawna interrogates the go-between about the Landbreaker's contact. Her questioning seems to reveal the identity of the actual traitor.

summary_sm1l7m1_17_001.cn: 被愤怒冲昏头脑的肖娜冲进监控室与阿尔乔姆对质，幸好有你的阻拦，才没有让她犯下大错。在阿尔乔姆的坦白下，事情的真相也浮出了水面。
summary_sm1l7m1_17_001.en: A furious Shawna rushes into the monitoring room to question Artyom. Fortunately, you manage to stop her from committing a grievous error. Artyom finally confesses and reveals the truth behind the incident.

summary_sm1l7m1_18_001.cn: 再次见到肖娜，她感谢你及时阻止她犯下大错。现在她申请加入工团安全局继续调查。你衷心祝愿，希望她能找到真相。
summary_sm1l7m1_18_001.en: You meet Shawna again. She is thankful that you prevented her from committing a grievous error. She is now applying to join the UWST Security Bureau to help in the investigation. You give her your best wishes and hope that she can uncover the truth.

summary_sm1l7m1_1_001.cn: 碾骨氏族能进犯供能高地，可能是工团内部有人接应。了解完情况后，你们决定协助安格鲁与肖娜进行内部调查。
summary_sm1l7m1_1_001.en: The UWST suspects they have a mole who helped the Bonekrushers invade the Power Plateau. After understanding the situation, you decide to assist Angro and Shawna in their investigation.

summary_sm1l7m1_4_001.cn: 你们找到了季米特里，从他那里获得了长程通信记录库的终端机，并得知尤莉娅曾在袭击发生前删掉了一段通信记录。
summary_sm1l7m1_4_001.en: After tracking down Dmitry, you secure the terminal for the long-distance comms database and uncover a critical gap: Yulia purged one specific log sequence before the attack occurred.

summary_sm1l7m1_5_001.cn: 你恢复的通信记录加重了尤莉娅的嫌疑。你们觉得有必要和她当面谈一谈。
summary_sm1l7m1_5_001.en: Restored logs have significantly escalated Yulia's suspicion index. Face-to-face interrogation is now mandatory.

summary_sm1l7m1_6_001.cn: 尤莉娅的拒绝配合给调查增加了难度。随着她被停职审查，你们决定，在结果出来前继续收集线索。
summary_sm1l7m1_6_001.en: Yulia's noncompliance has stonewalled the investigation. With her now suspended pending review, the team pivots to evidence gathering, since answers won't come from her lips.

summary_sm1l7m1_7_001.cn: 你们找到了格奥尔基，询问他关于储藏点账目异常和物资失踪的事。面对询问，格奥尔基显得十分紧张。
summary_sm1l7m1_7_001.en: The interrogation begins with hard inventory logs and missing supply manifests. Under scrutiny, Georgi's fingers dig into his sleeves, sweat beading where his collar meets twitching nerves.

summary_sm1l7m1_8_001.cn: 试图悄悄离开的格奥尔基被工人拦下，你们就追查到的丢失物资下落对他进行质问。
summary_sm1l7m1_8_001.en: Georgi tries to sneak away, but you stop him with an interrogation about the missing items.

summary_sm1l7m1_9_001.cn: 知道阿尔乔姆的下落后，你们赶忙前往调查。虽然没找到他，但在热心工人的帮助下，获得了关于他行踪的线索。
summary_sm1l7m1_9_001.en: You learn where Artyom is and quickly proceed with your investigation. Although you fail to find him, helpful crew mates manage to locate clues of his whereabouts.

summary_sm1l7m2_2_001.cn: 你与佩丽卡来到源石发电站，工团的物流负责人向你们介绍了机器人故障的详细情况。为了进一步调查，你们决定前往现场。
summary_sm1l7m2_2_001.en: Perlica and you arrive at the Originium Power Plant. The UWST logistics monitor shares details about the robot malfunctions. You decide to investigate an actual site of the breakdown to further understand the situation.

summary_sm1l7m2_2d2_001.cn: 你与佩丽卡在监测设备指示的地点遇到了一名工团技术员。他对你们尝试解决故障的想法不以为然，认为这种事毫无意义。
summary_sm1l7m2_2d2_001.en: You and Perlica arrive at the location marked by the monitoring device and meet a UWST technician. He is not impressed with your ideas for fixing the robots and believes this entire thing is a fool's errand.

summary_sm1l7m2_2d8_001.cn: 在机器人的聚集地，你们遇到了一名工团的小女孩。她希望能让自己的机器人朋友“恢复精神”，你决定帮助她。
summary_sm1l7m2_2d8_001.en: You meet a little girl from a UWST crew family at the robot gathering site. She wants to "restore the morale" of her robot friends. You decide to help.

summary_sm1l7m2_4_001.cn: 在机器人聚集地的最深处，你们遇到了一名工团的技术专家。他执着于自己的人工智能研究，对你们的到来十分抵触。但面对始终无法启动的机器人，他也束手无策，最终将它交给了你们。
summary_sm1l7m2_4_001.en: You meet a UWST tech expert in the deepest parts of the robot gathering site. The man is engrossed in his AI project and seems unhappy about your presence. However, he does not know how to re-activate a robot and finally decides to hand it over to you.

summary_sm1l7m2_4d5_001.cn: 你成功重新启动了这个故障机器人，发现它能解码收到的神秘指令。之后，致使机器人故障的神秘指令再次发来，你紧急为眼前的机器人加装了新模块，成功让机器人定位到了发信方的位置。
summary_sm1l7m2_4d5_001.en: You successfully reboot the malfunctioning robot and realize that it is capable of deciphering the mysterious commands it's been receiving. Shortly afterwards, a mystery command that induces malfunction arrives again. You quickly install a new module on this robot and successfully locate the position of the signal emitter.

summary_sm1l7m2_7_001.cn: 你重新解析了受损机器人身上的数据，意识却进入了一片花海之中。残留的声音数据萦绕在花海中，似乎在告诉你——这里只是一个梦境。之后，你在佩丽卡的呼喊中醒来，让受损的机器人获得了真正的安眠。
summary_sm1l7m2_7_001.en: You decrypt the data on the damaged robot one more time, only to find your consciousness sucked into a sea of flowers. An audio file echoes within the sea and seems to tell you that this is only a dream. Perlica eventually wakes you up loudly. The damaged robot is finally laid to permanent rest.

summary_sm1l7m2_8_001.cn: 回到机器人的聚集地，工团的物流负责人告诉你们，机器人们已经全部从故障中恢复。而在看到那片花田的影像后，他讲述了关于花田的往事——那似乎是最早一批机器人在“醒来”后看到的第一处风景。
summary_sm1l7m2_8_001.en: You return to the robot gathering site. The UWST Logistics Monitor tells you that all the robots have started functioning normally again. After seeing an image of the sea of flowers, the Monitor shares a story about it — apparently, it's the very first scene the first batch of robots saw after their "awakening".

summary_sm2l1m1_1_001.cn: 你们在清波寨外寨的北面找到了巡卫李惴。他对迷踪林充满了恐惧，你们主动提出陪同他一道前往，寻找失踪的巡林员与天师。
summary_sm2l1m1_1_001.en: You meet Watchguard Li Zhui at the north of the Qingbo Bailey. He is extremely frightened of the Stragglers Grove. You offer to explore the place with him and help find the missing forest ranger and Tianshi.

summary_sm2l1m1_4_001.cn: 你们救起了受伤的巡林员晏林，他告诉了你们竹林异动的“真相”。
summary_sm2l1m1_4_001.en: You save Yan Lin, an injured forest ranger. He tells you the "truths" about the strange happenings in the grove.

summary_sm2l1m2_1_001.cn: 你们找到了失踪的清波寨寨民洪泥，他也为你们指出了竹林异动的“真相”。
summary_sm2l1m2_1_001.en: You find Hong Ni, the Qingbo Stockade resident who went missing. He also shares his explanations for the disturbances in the grove.

summary_sm2l1m3_1_001.cn: 你们找到了失踪的语轩天师，她为你们讲述了竹林异动的“真相”——迷踪林近期的异常，是安抚竹林虫的定波器失灵导致的。你们决定帮助她重启定波器。
summary_sm2l1m3_1_001.en: You find Yuxuan the missing Tianshi. She shares her own explanations behind the recent disturbances of the grove. Turns out a fixed wave emitter that once pacified the grovenymphs has malfunctioned. You decide to help her repair the device.

summary_sm2l1m4_1_001.cn: 你们在湖心小岛上遇见了一位年老的天师。你们尝试与她交谈，她却向你提出了一个奇怪的问题。在得到你的回答后，她让开了路。
summary_sm2l1m4_1_001.en: You meet an old Tianshi at the islet in the lake. You try to talk to her but she instead asks you a few strange questions. After hearing your answers, the old Tianshi steps out of the way.

summary_sm2l1m4_2_001.cn: 你们重启了定波器，年老的天师又向你们提出了一个出乎意料的问题。
summary_sm2l1m4_2_001.en: You reset the fixed wave emitter. Once again, the old Tianshi asks you an unexpected question.

summary_sm2l1m4_3_001.cn: 竹林异动的原因水落石出，你们对此感慨纷纷，而李惴萌发了辞职的念头。
summary_sm2l1m4_3_001.en: You find out the true reasons behind the disturbances of the grove. It is quite a sentimental discovery. Li Zhui feels a sudden urge to resign.

summary_sm2l1m5_2_001.cn: 放跑名叫“小吴”的长耳兽以后，你们见到了前来寻找它的天师学徒阿土。得知了真实情况，你们决定帮其找回小吴。
summary_sm2l1m5_2_001.en: After letting go the long-ear named Woolsey, you meet a Tianshi disciple named Ah Tu who happens to be looking for the critter. After learning about the situation, you decide to help Ah Tu recover her Woolsey.

summary_sm2l1m5_3_001.cn: 逃离的长耳兽被寨民大桨抓住了，他提出了交易的要求。
summary_sm2l1m5_3_001.en: The escaping long-ear was captured by stockade resident Da Jiang. He offers his terms.

summary_sm2l1m5_4_001.cn: 你们用食物换回长耳兽时，它却再次逃脱。
summary_sm2l1m5_4_001.en: You trade the food ingredients for the long-ear but she escapes again.

summary_sm2l1m5_5_001.cn: 你们与阿土的学长永宁交谈，得知了阿土不断换专业的事情。
summary_sm2l1m5_5_001.en: You talk to Yongning who happens to be Ah Tu's senior. He tells that Ah Tu is always changing her major.

summary_sm2l1m5_6_001.cn: 你们与阿土的导师陆摇风交谈，得知了阿土不断延毕的事情。
summary_sm2l1m5_6_001.en: You speak with Lu Yaofeng, Ah Tu's instructor, and he tells you why she keeps delaying graduation.

summary_sm2l1m5_7_001.cn: 接连不断的寻找似乎令阿土陷入了迷茫，你们劝说阿土不要放弃。
summary_sm2l1m5_7_001.en: The endless searching seems to leave Ah Tu feeling lost. You encourage her not to give up.

summary_sm2l1m5_8_001.cn: 阿土受到了小吴的启发，决定去找导师聊聊。
summary_sm2l1m5_8_001.en: Inspired by Woolsey, Ah Tu decides to talk with her instructor.

summary_sm2l1m5_8d5_001.cn: 阿土给了你们一张小吴的照片，决定去探寻心仪的项目。
summary_sm2l1m5_8d5_001.en: Ah Tu gives you a photo of Woolsey. She has decided to find a project she truly loves.

summary_sm2l1m5_9_001.cn: 你们听到阿土和导师陆摇风的争执，得知了阿土的想法。
summary_sm2l1m5_9_001.en: You overhear a heated exchange between Ah Tu and her instructor, Lu Yaofeng, and gain insight into Ah Tu's thoughts.

summary_sm2l2m1_13_001.cn: 你和小武及时解救了被骚扰的老驮兽。
summary_sm2l2m1_13_001.en: You and Little Wu manage to rescue Old Burdenbeast just in time.

summary_sm2l2m1_14_001.cn: 最终，小武向固执的老驮兽妥协，你们决定去往它曾经耕种过的那片田地。
summary_sm2l2m1_14_001.en: Little Wu finally concedes to the stubborn Old Burdenbeast. You decide to take him to the farm where he once worked.

summary_sm2l2m1_15_001.cn: 老驮兽终于见到了自己耕作过的田地，然后便满意地离开了。
summary_sm2l2m1_15_001.en: The Old Burdenbeast sees the farm he once worked at. He is satisfied and prepares to leave.

summary_sm2l2m1_17_001.cn: 被黎风叫醒后，你发现老驮兽和小武都只是自己的一场梦。
summary_sm2l2m1_17_001.en: Lifeng wakes you up. Turns out Old Burdenbeast and Little Wu are just people from a dream.

summary_sm2l2m1_1_001.cn: 收到黎风的消息，你来到工农生产单位，见到了此次参赛的驮兽。
summary_sm2l2m1_1_001.en: You receive Lifeng's message and arrive at the industrial and agricultural production unit to meet the burdenbeasts taking part in the contest.

summary_sm2l2m1_2_001.cn: 爱好自由的王牌饲养员欧阳先生向你介绍了他自己的驮兽。
summary_sm2l2m1_2_001.en: Mr. Ouyang the Freedom Lover, aka the #1 burdenbeast expert, shows you his burdenbeast.

summary_sm2l2m1_3_001.cn: 喜欢玄学的职农安女士向你介绍了她自己饲养的驮兽。
summary_sm2l2m1_3_001.en: Ms. An the Little-Stitious shows you her burdenbeast.

summary_sm2l2m1_4_001.cn: 在黎风向你介绍他的驮兽时，一位名叫小武的牧童找上门来，请求你帮忙寻找走失的老驮兽。
summary_sm2l2m1_4_001.en: While Lifeng introduces his burdenbeast, a herder named Little Wu enters the scene and asks you to help find a missing old burdenbeast.

summary_sm2l2m1_5_001.cn: 找到老驮兽后，你得知它跑出兽栏，只是因为放不下自己耕作过的田地。你决定帮助老驮兽寻找那块田地。
summary_sm2l2m1_5_001.en: After finding the Old Burdenbeast, you learn that he left his pen because he misses the farm that he worked on. You decide to help the Old Burdenbeast locate the farm.

summary_sm2l2m1_5d5_001.cn: 你带老驮兽去了工农生产单位附近的农田，发现这里并不是它要找的地方。
summary_sm2l2m1_5d5_001.en: You take the Old Burdenbeast to the farm near the industrial and agricultural production unit, but quickly realize this isn't the place he's looking for.

summary_sm2l2m1_6_001.cn: 走到半路，老驮兽因为年老体衰，实在走不动了，拜托你为它找些水来喝。
summary_sm2l2m1_6_001.en: Halfway through the journey, the Old Burdenbeast becomes exhausted and cannot move. It asks you to fetch some drinking water.

summary_sm2l2m1_7_001.cn: 和追上来的小武大吵一架后，老驮兽气愤地跑没了影儿。
summary_sm2l2m1_7_001.en: After arguing with Little Wu who catches up to the group, the Old Burdenbeast runs off angrily.

summary_sm2l2m1_7d6_001.cn: 你和小武找到了老驮兽留下的粪便。
summary_sm2l2m1_7d6_001.en: You and Little Wu find a pile of burdenbeast poop.

summary_sm2l2m1_8_001.cn: 在市民广场上，你看到了和大家一起跳舞的老驮兽。为了纪念这一刻，老驮兽希望你能为它拍一张照片。
summary_sm2l2m1_8_001.en: You see the Old Burdenbeast dancing with everyone in the Citizen Square. He also asks you to take a photo to commemorate the moment.

summary_sm2l2m1_9_001.cn: 拍照时，你和小武发现老驮兽再次失踪。
summary_sm2l2m1_9_001.en: While taking the photo, you and Little Wu notice the Old Burdenbeast has disappeared again.

summary_sm2l2m2_2_001.cn: 你们来到方兴衢，却遇到阿仔和田阿姨正在竞争一家空置铺面的承租经营权。经过调解，二人同意以比赛形式一较高下。
summary_sm2l2m2_2_001.en: You arrive at Fangxing Avenue and find Ah Zai and Aunt Tian arguing over leasing rights and business license of an empty stall. After some mediation, the two agree to have a competition.

summary_sm2l2m2_6_001.cn: 你们完成了活动测试流程。阿仔向你们道出他“创新想法”的来由。
summary_sm2l2m2_6_001.en: You complete the trial run of Ah Zai's event. The young lad then shares the origins of his "creative ideas" with you.

summary_sm2l2m2_8_001.cn: 你们将竹林虫笋交给了田阿姨，她决定教你们做烂肉面。
summary_sm2l2m2_8_001.en: You give the grove nymphsprouts to Aunt Tian and she decides to teach you how to make braised meat noodles.

summary_sm2l2m2_9_001.cn: 你们尝到了烂肉面，田阿姨回忆起过去一段艰难的时光。
summary_sm2l2m2_9_001.en: You enjoy some braised meat noodles. Aunt Tian then reminisces about the difficult times people had before.

summary_sm2l2m3_11_001.cn: 你们根据尹冬得到的情报，来到材料研究所。名为拂秋的天师听过莫天师的事迹。原来莫天师执着于“打潮鞭”的研究项目已有近十年，并对侵蚀有着极深的仇恨。你们决定在研究所的其他地方调查一下。
summary_sm2l2m3_11_001.en: You follow Yin Dong's intel and visit the Institute of Materials Science. A Tianshi named Fu Qiu has heard about Tianshi Mo's projects. The old man spent nearly a decade obsessing about his "Tide Flayer" project and is known for his great hatred for the Blight. You decide to investigate the various sites of the Institute.

summary_sm2l2m3_12_001.cn: 你们找到了莫天师曾经的研究项目记录，备注显示项目的危险系数过高。记录上还有着莫天师旧居的位置，你们打算过去看看，一探究竟。
summary_sm2l2m3_12_001.en: You find research logs of a project Tianshi Mo once worked on. The reviewers' noted that the project's "hazard factors are too high". The logs also contain the address of Tianshi Mo's old residence. You decide to investigate the place.

summary_sm2l2m3_14_001.cn: 你们来到了莫天师的旧居，找到了一封莫天师友人留下的书信，相约在安思园商议细节。你们决定再于屋内做一番调查，以确认莫天师的下落。
summary_sm2l2m3_14_001.en: You arrive at Tianshi Mo's old residence and find a letter left behind by his friend. They have agreed to meet at Serenity Garden to talk about certain details. You decide to investigate the house and verify where Tianshi Mo went.

summary_sm2l2m3_15_001.cn: 城区医疗点的崔大夫告诉你们，半年来，莫天师的精神状况变得不稳定，在医疗点引起不少麻烦。此前莫天师也有过私自跑出去的经历，技术生产办公室的试验田是他经常去的地方。你们决定根据线索去那儿碰碰运气。
summary_sm2l2m3_15_001.en: Physician Cui of the City Medical Clinic tells you that Tianshi Mo grew rather unstable during the last six months. He caused quite a bit of trouble due to his habit of running away from the Clinic. The test fields of the Technological Production Office was a place he frequented during his escapes. You decide to try your luck with this lead.

summary_sm2l2m3_16_001.cn: 安思园也没有莫天师的踪迹，你们决定等明天再来这里一趟，等等看那位与莫天师有约的友人。
summary_sm2l2m3_16_001.en: You do not find Mr. Mo in Serenity Garden. Thus, you decide to come back tomorrow and wait for the friend he promised to meet.

summary_sm2l2m3_1_001.cn: 你们在武陵城城郊遇见了一个焦急的年轻人——尹冬，他声称自己的老师——莫天师在侵蚀潮来袭时失踪了。目击者的线索表示他朝着城外待修缮区去了。尹冬拜托你们帮他寻找老师的行踪。
summary_sm2l2m3_1_001.en: You meet a desperate young man named Yin Dong in Wuling Outskirts. He tells that his mentor, Tianshi Mo, has gone missing during the Blight Tide. Witness testimonials suggest that he went to the Maintenance Zone outside the city. Yin Dong then asks you for help in finding his mentor.

summary_sm2l2m3_2_001.cn: 你们把得到的线索告知了尹冬——疑似莫天师留下的鞭痕延伸到了侵蚀潮前消失了。尹冬还没有放弃希望。你们想起他曾经提到莫天师待过的城区医疗点，决定去那里看看。
summary_sm2l2m3_2_001.en: You tell Yin Dong about what you found. Whip lashes, which were probably left there by Tianshi Mo, have been found at the edge of the Blight Tide before disappearing. Nevertheless, the young man refuses to give up. You remember that Tianshi Mo stayed at the City Medical Clinic before and decide to pay a visit.

summary_sm2l2m3_5_001.cn: 你们在技术生产办公室附近遇到了夏毅天师，他抱怨此前一位行为疯癫的老人来过此处，并用鞭子在田地里“捣乱”。眼下，田地因侵蚀而受损严重，你们决定帮忙处理侵蚀，同时寻找莫天师的踪迹。
summary_sm2l2m3_5_001.en: You meet Tianshi Xia Yi near the Technological Production Office. He complains about an old whip-wielding "troublemaker" who made a mess of the fields. Since the fields are severely affected by the Blight, you decide to help with the clean-up while searching for clues on Tianshi Mo's whereabouts.

summary_sm2l2m3_6_001.cn: 你们发现这些鞭痕似乎在有意瞄准侵蚀核心。夏毅天师也得知老人并非是在捣乱。线索再次中断，你们打算和尹冬商量一下，汇总情报。
summary_sm2l2m3_6_001.en: You notice that the lash marks are aimed at the Blight Core. Tianshi Xia Yi realizes that the Old Mo was not making trouble. However, no other evidence could be found at the test fields. You decide to talk to Yin Dong and organize the findings so far.

summary_sm2l2m3_7_001.cn: 你们在莫天师的旧居内发现了他留下的天师仪，将其修好后，找到了一些日记片段，上面写满了不甘和遗憾。
summary_sm2l2m3_7_001.en: You find a Tianshi apparatus left behind by Tianshi Mo at his old residence. After repairing it, you find part of a diary entry has been saved to it. The writings are filled with anguish and grief.

summary_sm2l2m3_8_001.cn: 你们发现，莫天师在两年前停止了打潮鞭项目，且对已故学生春荷心怀愧疚。尹冬提出想去安思园看看。
summary_sm2l2m3_8_001.en: You find that Tianshi Mo has ended his Tide Flayer project two years ago. The old man felt extremely guilty about the death of his late disciple, Chun He. Yin Dong recommends visiting Serenity Garden to find him.

summary_sm2l2m3_9_001.cn: 你们来到了安思园，看到了刻有莫天师曾经的学生——春荷的功绩石。尹冬告诉你们，春荷曾是最支持打潮鞭项目的人，但她英年早逝，打潮鞭的研究被放弃，或许与她的离去有关。你们决定为春荷献一枝花。
summary_sm2l2m3_9_001.en: You arrive at Serenity Garden and see the merit stone of Chun He, the late disciple who once studied under Tianshi Mo. Yin Dong tells you that Chun He was the greatest supporter of the Tide Flayer project. However, Chun He died and her death may have ended the project. You decide to offer Chun He a flower.

summary_sm2l2m4_1_001.cn: 你们如约来到安思园，遇到了庄方宜和大潘，原来庄方宜就是与莫天师相约之人。她告诉尹冬，莫天师的嘱托是希望她照顾好自己最后的学生。庄方宜担忧莫天师还是放不下执念，提议去看看他所念念不忘的“潮水”。
summary_sm2l2m4_1_001.en: You arrive at Serenity Garden as promised but run into Zhuang Fangyi and Da Pan. It turns out that Zhuang is the person who promised to meet Tianshi Mo. She tells Yin Dong that Tianshi Mo hopes she can take care of his last disciple. Zhuang is also worried that Mr. Mo never truly let go and proposes to head to the "Tidal Waters" that he has been obsessing about.

summary_sm2l2m4_3_001.cn: 一位老人端坐在侵蚀潮边，旁边放着一壶酒。“潮水”在他面前一分为二，如同被钉在了原地，不敢向前蔓延……尹冬奋力喊着“老师”，却没能得到回应。众人感慨莫天师的壮举，又遗憾世事难全，为莫天师送上了敬意。
summary_sm2l2m4_3_001.en: An old man sits next to the Blight Tide with a cask of wine by his side. The "Tide" has been neatly split in two and the halves seem to be locked in place, making no attempt to spread further... Yin Dong calls out to his mentor but there is no response. Everyone is greatly moved by the old Tianshi's achievement and pays their greatest respect. There is no perfect ending for every story.

summary_sm2l2m4_4_001.cn: 你们在莫天师的家里遇见了尹冬，他拒绝了去其他天师那里学习的机会，决定作为莫天师最后的学生，继承老师的研究。看着尹冬离去，你们猜测起莫天师劈开侵蚀潮时的所思、所感、所悟。
summary_sm2l2m4_4_001.en: You meet Yin Dong at Tianshi Mo's residence. He refuses to continue his mentorship under another Tianshi and chooses to carry on Tianshi Mo's project as his last disciple. As Yin Dong leaves, you speculate on the old Tianshi's final thoughts, feelings, and enlightenment when he split the Blight Tide in half.

summary_sm2l2m6_6_001.cn: 你们询问阿仔，发现“闯入”确有其事，却是因为一个出人意料的原因。
summary_sm2l2m6_6_001.en: You question Ah Zai and find out the surprising reason behind the supposed "break-in".

summary_sm2l2m6_7_001.cn: 你们发现，田阿姨和阿仔竟然是亲戚。两人由于生活方式和理念的不同才产生了争执。
summary_sm2l2m6_7_001.en: You find out that Aunt Tian and Ah Zai are related. The two often argue due to differences in beliefs and lifestyles.

summary_sm2l2m7_1_001.cn: 比赛开始，田阿姨的摊位售卖的是“田阿姨烂肉面”，而阿仔的摊位则是“武陵生活方式总店”。
summary_sm2l2m7_1_001.en: The competition begins. Aunt Tian's stall is selling "Aunt Tian's Braised Meat Noodles" while Ah Zai's stall is named "Wuling Lifestyle Station".

summary_sm2l2m7_7_001.cn: 阿仔向光顾摊位的客人们讲述了自己小时候与宠物小壳兽“坨坨”的往事。
summary_sm2l2m7_7_001.en: Ah Zai tells the patrons stories about his childhood and his mini shellbeast pet named "Pebbles".

summary_sm2l3m1_1_001.cn: 你们救下了一位名叫杜鸣的寨民，他自称因为与阮一争吵而被关在了这里。得知阮一之死，杜鸣大为失落。他打算前往祖泉，尽到自己作为“守泉人”的职责。为了避免他被裂地者所伤，你们决定护送他一程。
summary_sm2l3m1_1_001.en: You rescue a Stockade resident named Du Ming. He tells you that Ruan Yi imprisoned him following an argument. Du Ming becomes rather distraught when he hears about Ruan Yi's death. The youth decides to head to the Ancestral Spring to fulfill his duties as the spring guardian. To protect him against potential Landbreaker attacks, you decide to escort him.

summary_sm2l3m1_4_001.cn: 你们到达了地下道路的尽头，有关杜鸣的线索却在此中断。为了尽快找到杜鸣，你们决定前往清波寨，向汤汤求助。
summary_sm2l3m1_4_001.en: You reach the end of the underground passage and no longer find any signs of Du Ming or his footprints. You decide to return to Qingbo Stockade and ask Tangtang to help search for the man.

summary_sm2l3m1_5_001.cn: 你们寻至一处洞穴，却发现了一具裂地者的尸体，他疑似死于杜鸣之手。一番推断后，你们猜测杜鸣很可能因忧心祖泉的泉源，而跳入裂地者炸开的洞口，前往了地下深处。
summary_sm2l3m1_5_001.en: You find a cave and a Landbreaker's body. The raider was probably killed by Du Ming. The spring guardian looked very concerned about the source of the ancestral spring. You deduce that Du Ming probably leaped into the Landbreakers' blasting tunnels and went deep underground.

summary_sm2l3m2_1_001.cn: 来到清波寨，你们发现，虽然寨民们仍未从阮一之死的阴影里完全走出，但作为大当家的汤汤已能独当一面。你们刚向汤汤说明来意，就有寨民跑来转述了杜鸣现身徒手降彪兽的传闻。
summary_sm2l3m2_1_001.en: You arrive at Qingbo Stockade. The Stockaders have yet to fully accept Ruan Yi's death but Tangtang is living up to her Chiefly duties. While you inform Tangtang about your visit, a Stockader suddenly reports Du Ming's sudden appearance and how the man defeated rakerbeasts with his bare hands.

summary_sm2l3m2_4_001.cn: 战后，杜鸣向你们简述了他之前的遭遇。此时汤汤带人赶到，杜鸣却再度陷入癫狂，仓皇逃走。你们一路追踪，发现他似乎跑向了之前那个洞穴。说服汤汤守在原地后，你们前往洞穴，试图追上杜鸣。
summary_sm2l3m2_4_001.en: The battle has ended and Du Ming tells you about his encounters. Tangtang arrives with her people but Du Ming suffers another bout of insanity and flees. You track him down to the cave that you discovered the last time. After convincing Tangtang to stay put, you went inside the cave and attempt to catch up to Du Ming.

summary_sm2l3m2_5_001.cn: 你们追上杜鸣，发现他原来是刻意引你们下来。一番交谈后，杜鸣决定带你们前往地下更深处，那里似乎藏着他一系列离奇行为的真正原因。
summary_sm2l3m2_5_001.en: You catch up to Du Ming and realize that he has been intentionally guiding you to the place. After conversing with him, Du Ming decides to bring you deeper into the area. It seems to be hiding the true cause of his strange behavior.

summary_sm2l3m2_6_001.cn: 在杜鸣的指引下，你们来到地下最深处，得知了祖泉的泉源免于侵蚀影响的原因——一座炎国天师留下的水利装置。但装置储污池中多年积攒的大量侵蚀随时可能上涌，危及清波寨。在杜鸣的请求下，你将装置关停封死。
summary_sm2l3m2_6_001.en: Following Du Ming's guidance, you venture into the deepest parts of the underground area. There, you learn why the Ancestral Spring water has always been free of the Blight — and it turns out to be an irrigation machine built by Yanese Tianshi. However, the Blight containment tank is filled with years of Blight buildup. The tank may burst at any given moment and endanger Qingbo Stockade. Du Ming asks you to shut down and seal the machine for good.

summary_sm2l3m3_1_001.cn: 杜鸣如计划那样装作被“仙人”附身，告知汤汤等人“生路需自寻”。汤汤与寨民们为此表明了各自的态度，心愿得偿的杜鸣装疯而去。在你的劝阻下，汤汤没有强留杜鸣，决定和寨民们一同等他“回来”。
summary_sm2l3m3_1_001.en: Du Ming goes with his plan and pretends to be "possessed" by a spirit and tells Tangtang and the Stockade residents to "seek their own way of survival". After receiving their positive responses, the "mad" Du Ming leaves. You persuade Tangtang to stop chasing after Du Ming. She decides to stay in the Stockade with her Fam and wait for his "return".

summary_sm2l3m4_1_001.cn: 你和佩丽卡在顶天梁附近遇到自称“天师”的皮奥特。他委托你们救出被寨民关押的同伴玛蒂娜。
summary_sm2l3m4_1_001.en: You and Perlica meet a self-proclaimed Tianshi named Piot. He asks you to save his companion Martina who has been imprisoned by the Stockade residents.

summary_sm2l3m4_3_001.cn: 你们救出了玛蒂娜，可她不愿回去，执意继续冒险，以完成她的课题取材。你们决定协助玛蒂娜，加入了她的冒险。
summary_sm2l3m4_3_001.en: You save Martina but she refuses to head back. Instead, she wants to continue her adventures and gather more materials for her project. You decide to help her by joining her expedition.

summary_sm2l3m4_3d5_001.cn: 你决定帮助玛蒂娜完成第一处暗语的拍摄。
summary_sm2l3m4_3d5_001.en: You decide to help Martina photograph the first secret message.

summary_sm2l3m4_4_001.cn: 玛蒂娜解读出了第一处暗语的含义——“爱人辛夷已经从河边离开”。
summary_sm2l3m4_4_001.en: Martina deciphered the meaning of the first secret message: "My beloved Xin Yi had left the riverbank."

summary_sm2l3m4_5_001.cn: 你们找到了暗语里提及的“河边”。玛蒂娜与佩丽卡讨论了关于“水竹铃”的传统习俗，并推测出暗语的另一层含义。之后，玛蒂娜请你为此处拍照，帮助她完成取材。
summary_sm2l3m4_5_001.en: You find the "riverbank" mentioned in the secret message. Martina and Perlica discuss the traditions of "bamboo water chimes" and deduce another meaning to the secret messages. Martina then asks you to photograph the visual materials she needs.

summary_sm2l3m5_1_001.cn: 玛蒂娜解读出了第二个暗语的含义——“我在清波寨的高处睡觉”。
summary_sm2l3m5_1_001.en: Martina deciphers the meaning of the second secret message: "I'm sleeping at a high place within the Stockade."

summary_sm2l3m5_2_001.cn: 到达第二处暗语所提示的地点，你们遇到了寨民长杆头，他讲述了睡在高处的缘由，并请求你们帮他取回眼罩。
summary_sm2l3m5_2_001.en: You reach the location hinted at by the second secret message. There you meet a Stockade resident named Punty Pole. He describes his reasons for sleeping at a high place and asks you to help retrieve his eye mask.

summary_sm2l3m5_4_001.cn: 玛蒂娜很喜欢你拍摄的照片。你们准备前往最后一个暗语处。
summary_sm2l3m5_4_001.en: Martina really likes the photographs you took. You get ready to head to the location of the last secret message.

summary_sm2l3m5_5_001.cn: 第三处暗语的内容有些混乱，玛蒂娜没能完全理解。但她仍从中辨识出“山洞”“练习”“源石技艺很痛，很好玩”等信息，根据这些线索，你们准备前往下一处目的地。
summary_sm2l3m5_5_001.en: The third secret message is a little confusing. Though Martina cannot completely decipher it, she identifies the words and phrases that include "cave", "training", "Originium Arts are painful but fun". You use these as hints and prepare to head to the next location.

summary_sm2l3m6_1_001.cn: 你们找到了暗语里提及的“山洞”。在洞中搜集线索后，你们得知：此处曾经生活过一位清波寨寨民，他因过度使用源石技艺，最终死于矿石病。随后，玛蒂娜向你们坦白了她的真实身份——一名游历四方的博物学者。
summary_sm2l3m6_1_001.en: You find the "cave" mentioned in the secret message. After searching the place, you learn that a Qingbo Stockade resident once lived here. He succumbed to Oripathy due to excessive use of the Arts. Martina finally divulges that she is actually a traveling naturalist.

summary_sm2l3m6_2_001.cn: 你们推测，此处曾是一名母亲秘密养育孩子的地方。不知出于何种苦衷，那位母亲最终在此告别了孩子，任其随流水漂向下游。她在暗语中寄托了对孩子的思念与祝福，而你们，也被这之中蕴藏的真切情感打动。
summary_sm2l3m6_2_001.en: You deduce that a mother had secretly raised a child in this place. Then, due to some reasons, she placed the child in the basket and let the river carry it away. Her secret message includes her love and best wishes for the child. Everyone is moved by the sincere emotions conveyed in the message.

summary_sm2l3m6_3_001.cn: 你们护送玛蒂娜与皮奥特离开山洞。玛蒂娜忽然提出，回到菈梵朵玛后，她要筹办一场清波寨文化展览，并热情地邀请你们参加。你们欣然应允，随后互相道别。
summary_sm2l3m6_3_001.en: You escort Martina and Piot out of the cave. Martina suddenly plans to host a Qingbo Stockade cultural exhibition once she returns to La Fantoma, and eagerly invites you. You happily accept and then bid each other farewell.

summary_sm2l4m1_11_001.cn: 你们在巡卫贾班的执勤点发现了一件施术单元，周围有失控的源石活性化痕迹。
summary_sm2l4m1_11_001.en: You find an Arts Unit at watchguard Jia Ban's post. It is surrounded by residues of uncontrolled Originium activation.

summary_sm2l4m1_12_001.cn: 你们与赶来的弭弗同步调查结果，却突然得知巡卫贾班被找到的消息，而第三具遗体的身份再度变得扑朔迷离。
summary_sm2l4m1_12_001.en: Mi Fu hurries into the scene and you share your investigative findings with her. You suddenly learn that watchguard Jia Ban has been found and the identity of the third body becomes a mystery again.

summary_sm2l4m1_1_001.cn: 你们应弭弗之请，前往城建馆地下的医护舱，得知有三具遗体无法确认身份。
summary_sm2l4m1_1_001.en: You receive Mi Fu's invitation and head to the medical cabin under the Urban Development Hall. There are three bodies that have yet to be identified.

summary_sm2l4m1_5_001.cn: 你们确认了一具遗体的身份信息，剩下两具的仍不明朗。第三位逝者生前患有矿石病，你们决定前去城区医疗点寻找更多线索。
summary_sm2l4m1_5_001.en: You verify the identity of the first body but the other two remain obscure. The third deceased was an Oripathy-positive. You decide to visit the City Medical Clinic for clues.

summary_sm2l4m1_6_001.cn: 你们来到城区医疗点，在矿石病患者档案中未找到与第三位逝者相关的信息。
summary_sm2l4m1_6_001.en: The team arrives at the City Medical Clinic. However, you fail to find any information about the third deceased from the case files of Oripathy-positives.

summary_sm2l4m1_7_001.cn: 你们离开城区医疗点后与弭弗沟通，决定分头行动，她负责寻找巡卫甄行远的线索，你们则前往巡卫贾班最后的执勤点调查其他细节。
summary_sm2l4m1_7_001.en: After leaving the City Medical Clinic, you talk to Mi Fu and decide to split your forces. She will search for data about watchguard Zhen Xingyuan while you investigate watchguard Jia Ban's last post of duty.

summary_sm2l4m1_8_001.cn: 你们在巡卫贾班的执勤点调查，意外碰到了此前遇见的清波寨寨民铁锚子，后者正在寻找自己失约的哥哥锈钩子。
summary_sm2l4m1_8_001.en: You investigate watchguard Jia Ban's post and unexpectedly meet Iron Boatswain the Qingbo Stockade. He is looking for his missing older brother, Rusty Hook.

summary_sm2l4m2_1_001.cn: 你们赶赴安思园，与卖花少女菱月沟通后，得知了她发现巡卫贾班时的情景。
summary_sm2l4m2_1_001.en: You arrive at Serenity Garden and talk to Yue the little florist to learn how she came across Jia Ban.

summary_sm2l4m2_4_001.cn: 你们在功绩石前的息壤块底下发现了锈钩子的衣服。铁锚子悲痛欲绝，向着爷爷的功绩石诉说因由。
summary_sm2l4m2_4_001.en: You find Rusty Hook's clothing beneath the Xiranite block in front of the merit stone. Iron Boatswain is devastated by this finding and reveals everything before his grandfather's merit stone.

summary_sm2l4m2_6_001.cn: 你们在城区医疗点向醒来的巡卫贾班了解信息，得知了锈钩子与贾班互换衣服以及最终牺牲的真相。
summary_sm2l4m2_6_001.en: You talk to Watchguard Jia Ban who woke up at the City Medical Clinic, and finally learn the truth about Rusty Hook's sacrifice and why he changed his outfit with Jia Ban.

summary_sm2l4m2_7_001.cn: 你们离开城区医疗点，与陈千语和铁锚子会合。聆听锈钩子留下的录音，了解了事情的另一面。
summary_sm2l4m2_7_001.en: You leave the City Medical Clinic and meet up with Chen Qianyu and Iron Boatswain. You listen to Rusty Hook's final audio log and get another side to this story.

summary_sm2l4m3_1_001.cn: 悼念仪式开始前，你们应铁锚子的邀请来到永垂壁处。铁锚子原本准备将锈钩子的名字偷偷刻在壁上，却发现有人抢先一步。
summary_sm2l4m3_1_001.en: Iron Boatswain invites you to meet him at Eternal Wall before the memorial service. He is about to secretly carve Rusty Hook's name on the wall when he realizes that someone has already done so.

summary_sm2l4m4_1_001.cn: 你们来到城建馆，再次碰见了铁锚子。铁锚子正在为成为见习巡卫做准备。
summary_sm2l4m4_1_001.en: You arrive at the Urban Development Hall and run into Iron Boatswain again. He is now preparing for his new career as a trainee watchguard.

summary_sm2l4m4_2_001.cn: 你们与铁锚子再次对话，展望了美好的新生活。
summary_sm2l4m4_2_001.en: You talk to Iron Boatswain again. He is hopeful about a beautiful new life.

summary_sm2l4m5_2_001.cn: 你来到首墩，正在工作的奚墨格外焦躁，对其他人的态度非常恶劣，你感到不快，但还是以修复工作为重，受他委托回材料研究所拿取资料。
summary_sm2l4m5_2_001.en: You arrive at the Marker Stone to find Xi Mo at work. He seems irritated and angry with those around him. While his behavior displeases you, you decide to focus on the repair work and accept his task: fetching data from the Institute of Materials Science.

summary_sm2l4m5_3_001.cn: 峰常年坚守北部禁区，此次回到武陵城，感慨变化巨大的同时，他回忆起与已故朋友的约定。
summary_sm2l4m5_3_001.en: Summit (Shen Jiao'e) has spent years at this post in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. This return to trip to Wuling has made him rather sentimental about how the city has changed. He reminisces about a promise made with a lost friend.

summary_sm2l4m5_6_001.cn: 材料研究所中，你见识到奚墨虽脾气古怪，但仍有许多人认可他的能力。而峰也怀念起自己的朋友，认为对方如果还活着，肯定也能获得大家的认可。
summary_sm2l4m5_6_001.en: Your tour of the Institute of Materials Science reveals that Tianshi Xi Mo is a man of peculiar temperament, but his achievements are recognized by many. Summit is also feeling nostalgic for his late friend. If the person were still alive, he would have won everyone's admiration as well.

summary_sm2l4m5_8_001.cn: 你检查巨兽心脏后，竟然有通道打开，奚墨判断，通道的出现与首墩内巨兽心脏能量爆发频率增高有关。一只墨魉示意你们进入通道，查明原委。
summary_sm2l4m5_8_001.en: You inspect the Feranmut's Heart and realize a passage has been opened. Tianshi Xi Mo believes that its appearance is correlated with the increased energy burst frequency of the Feranmut's Heart in the Marker Stone. An Ink Spirit appears. It seems intent to have you enter the passage and further the investigation.

summary_sm2l4m5_9_001.cn: 你们进入通道，发现峰并未跟过来。你们发现了一只可爱的蟠兽在首墩四处乱窜，决定追上它。
summary_sm2l4m5_9_001.en: You enter the portal and realize that Summit is not right next to you. You and Xi Mo find a cute pantailbeast prancing about the Marker Stone and decide to chase after it.

summary_sm2l4m6_1_001.cn: 奚墨和你上前靠近“蟠兽”，它是逸散的巨兽心脏能量化成的，你们需要将其送回画卷。
summary_sm2l4m6_1_001.en: You and Xi Mo approach the "pantailbeast" that manifested from spilled Feranmut Heart energy. You must send it back to the scroll.

summary_sm2l4m6_2_001.cn: 你与奚墨一起将巨兽心脏能量化成的蟠兽送回画卷。一路上，他谈起工作总是显得暴躁，你对他坚持留在这里工作表示不解，但他却告诉你，自己是应故人之约，坚守在武陵。
summary_sm2l4m6_2_001.en: Together, you and Xi Mo send the pantailbeast formed from Feranmut Heart energy back into the scroll. You notice his frustration when he talks about work and cannot understand why he insists on staying at Wuling. To your surprise, he reveals that he is trying to fulfill a promise.

summary_sm2l4m6_4_001.cn: 你将峰的经历告知奚墨。你觉得他们二人的过往有些相似之处，奚墨认为只是巧合。
summary_sm2l4m6_4_001.en: You share Summit's story with Xi Mo and point out the similarities in their experiences. Xi Mo brushes them aside as mere coincidence.

summary_sm2l4m6_5_001.cn: 你们找到了峰，他正与几只巨兽心脏能量化成的蟠兽玩得开心。
summary_sm2l4m6_5_001.en: You find Summit. He is happily playing with several pantailbeasts formed from Feranmut Heart energy.

summary_sm2l4m6_6_001.cn: 你们三人将所有“蟠兽”送回画卷，奚墨向你们表示感谢。
summary_sm2l4m6_6_001.en: The three of you send all the "pantailbeasts" back into the scroll. Xi Mo thanks you for your assistance.

summary_sm2l4m6_7_001.cn: 回到首墩下层，峰和奚墨竟然发现对方竟然就是当年的朋友，只是世事无常，才生出了种种误会，以为对方早已去世。你看他们聊起双方这些年的变化，为他们的重逢感到高兴。
summary_sm2l4m6_7_001.en: After returning to the Marker Stone Lower Floor, Summit and Xi Mo are surprised to discover that their long-lost friend is actually the other. Each had believed the other was dead due to the fickle nature of life. You feel happy for them as they talk about the changes they have been through.

summary_sm2l4m6_8_001.cn: 离开首墩，你发现庄方宜已经在外面等着你。你向她讲述了今天发生的事，并希望自己也能遇到曾经的老友。
summary_sm2l4m6_8_001.en: As you leave the Marker Stone, you find Zhuang Fangyi waiting outside for you. You share your experiences of the day and tell her you also wish to meet a few old acquaintances.

summary_sm2l5m1_10_001.cn: 你们将机芯模块全部送回丙型辅桩后，激活了试验园区的经纬田。此时丙型天师桩出现了异状，你们决定前往丙型天师桩的操作台处查看情况。
summary_sm2l5m1_10_001.en: After returning all the core modules to the Type-C Auxiliary Pillars, you activate the Test Area meridian grid. The Type-C Tianshi Pillar then begins to act abnormally. You decide to head to its control panel to investigate.

summary_sm2l5m1_1_001.cn: 你们在试验园区外遇到了一位天师学徒，她似乎很想进入因侵蚀潮影响而封锁的园区。
