summary_sm2l5m1_1_001.en: The Test Area is sealed off due to the Blight Tide. Outside, you meet a Tianshi disciple who seems eager to enter the place.

summary_sm2l5m1_3_001.cn: 为了帮助陆令香，你们与巡卫进行了交涉。最终巡卫退让，并提醒你们园区内的侵蚀非同一般，最好做足准备后再进入。
summary_sm2l5m1_3_001.en: To help Lu Lingxiang, you negotiate with the watchguard. In the end, he relents but reminds you that the Blight inside the park is no joke. It would be best to be fully prepared before entering.

summary_sm2l5m1_4_001.cn: 你们路过了外形特别的“丙型辅桩”。陆令香告诉你们，原本与丙型辅桩搭配工作的机芯模块现下散落在试验园区内，你们决定协助她找回。
summary_sm2l5m1_4_001.en: You pass by the distinctively shaped Type-C Auxiliary Pillar. Lu explains that the core modules originally designed to work with these pillars are now scattered throughout the Test Area. You decide to assist her in retrieving them.

summary_sm2l5m1_7_001.cn: 你目睹机芯模块接入丙型辅桩的过程，一种熟悉感涌上心头。你下意识调试了丙型辅桩的整套系统，丙型辅桩竟然将机芯模块的核心交给了你。
summary_sm2l5m1_7_001.en: Witnessing the process of the core module connecting to the Type-C Auxiliary Pillar, a sense of familiarity washes over you. You instinctively adjust the entire Type-C Auxiliary Pillar system, and it unexpectedly entrusts you with the kernel of the core module.

summary_sm2l5m2_3_001.cn: 你们赶走了盘踞此地的野兽，完善了丙型天师桩，试验园区恢复了生机。
summary_sm2l5m2_3_001.en: You drive away the beasts that occupied this site, complete the improvements to the Type-C Tianshi Pillar, and restore the signs of life to the Test Area.

summary_sm2l5m3_2_001.cn: 你们碰到了匆匆赶来的巡卫，得知这里正是陆令香的前辈们研究污水处理装置——净水节点的地方。
summary_sm2l5m3_2_001.en: You run into a watchguard who came rushing in. From him, you learn that this was the place where Lu Lingxiang's seniors once worked on a water treatment device known as the purification node.

summary_sm2l5m3_3_001.cn: 陆令香打算重启前辈们未竟的项目——净水节点，让污水处理区发挥真正的作用。最终，你们为这个项目起了一个新名字。
summary_sm2l5m3_3_001.en: Lu decides to revive her seniors' unfinished project, the Purification Node, to finally let the water treatment sector fulfill its true purpose. In the end, you all give the project a new name.

summary_sm2l6m1_10_001.cn: 将这里埋藏着的秘密告诉连晓雾等人后，众人在秘库里又探查了一番，佩丽卡找到了一段与你相关的录音，你们从中得知了当初泰拉各国把这些珍贵遗产保存在此的深意。
summary_sm2l6m1_10_001.en: After sharing the buried secrets with Lian Xiaowu and the others, the group investigates the secret vault once more. Perlica discovers an audio recording about you. With it, you finally learn the profound reasons why the nations of Terra chose this very place to safeguard their cultural legacies.

summary_sm2l6m1_11_001.cn: 成功破解第一座遗迹剑桩的机关后，你们推断，三座遗迹剑桩是为保护谷底而设立的。此时，那道红色的影子再次出现——一只小山犼兽似乎在有意跟随你们。
summary_sm2l6m1_11_001.en: After successfully solving the mechanism of the first Ancient Sword Stele, you deduce that the three steles were set up to protect the dale floor. The red shadow reappears. It turns out to be a young rockhowler who wants to follow you around.

summary_sm2l6m1_14_001.cn: 看守藏剑谷入口的天师学徒林瑚给你们放行，还送了一些爆炸物用来对付拦路的障碍。
summary_sm2l6m1_14_001.en: Lin Hu the Tianshi disciple who guards the entrance to Sword Vault Dale grants you passage. He even gives you some explosives to get rid of potential obstacles along the way.

summary_sm2l6m1_16_001.cn: 石碑上的铭文显示，当初炎国将苦心搜罗的秘宝埋藏于此，只要解开全部三座遗迹剑桩的机关，就能打开宝库。
summary_sm2l6m1_16_001.en: According to the tablet inscriptions, the nation of Yan invested a great deal of effort to create this trove of treasure. Solving the mechanisms of the three Ancient Sword Steles will open the vault.

summary_sm2l6m1_17_001.cn: 检索结果出乎你们的意料，这里并没有藏着“赤霄剑法”或其他失落的技术资料，而是各种人文典藏。
summary_sm2l6m1_17_001.en: The search results are far from what you expected. The vault neither contains "Chi Xiao Swordmancy" nor data about lost tech. Instead, it is a repository of cultural works.

summary_sm2l6m1_18_001.cn: 秘库识别出了你终末地管理员的身份，为你打开了大门。
summary_sm2l6m1_18_001.en: The vault recognizes your identity as Endministrator of Endfield Industries, and opens its doors for you.

summary_sm2l6m1_1_001.cn: 清波寨东南面的藏剑谷里似乎有座保存炎国技术遗产的秘库，连晓雾委托你前去探查，陈千语也决定同行。
summary_sm2l6m1_1_001.en: Southeast of Qingbo Stockade lies Sword Vault Dale, home to a secret vault preserving Yan's ancient technologies. Lian Xiaowu has asked you to investigate. Chen Qianyu also decides to tag along.

summary_sm2l6m1_2_001.cn: 陈千语告诉你，这些野兽是被称作“山犼兽”的云兽亚种，平时并不像现在这样凶猛狂躁。随后，你们接到了一个未知通信。
summary_sm2l6m1_2_001.en: Chen Qianyu informs you that the rockhowlers are a variant of the cloudbeast. She also says that they should not be this aggravated or fierce. Soon enough, you receive a call from an unknown sender.

summary_sm2l6m1_3_001.cn: 求援者自称沃尔顿，为了描述位置，他提到了“遗迹剑桩”，但通信突然中断，你们无法确定他的下落。此时，你好像看到了一个红色的影子，在远处一闪而过。
summary_sm2l6m1_3_001.en: The one requesting help introduced himself as Walton. He described his place as one with "Ancient Sword Steles" before he was unexpectedly cut off. This is also the moment when you notice a flash of a red figure in the distance.

summary_sm2l6m1_4_001.cn: 不远处有一些清波寨寨民，似乎是之前从大门边的缺口进来的。
summary_sm2l6m1_4_001.en: There is a group of Qingbo Stockade residents not too far away. They might have entered this place using the gap next to the door.

summary_sm2l6m1_6_001.cn: 你们搭救了沃尔顿，并得知了令人惊讶的消息——这里不仅有炎国留下的遗产，还有泰拉各国的知识和技术备份。尽管沃尔顿的动机并非无私，但你们决定先与他合作，探索这里的宝藏。
summary_sm2l6m1_6_001.en: You save Walton and learn a startling truth. This place contains not only legacies of Yan but also a backup stash of knowledge and technology of various Terran nations. Although Walton's motives are far from selfless, you decide to work with him for now and explore the hidden treasures as a team.

summary_sm2l6m1_7_001.cn: 解开第二座遗迹剑桩的机关后，从谷底传来了惊人的响动，你们必须加紧向深处前进。
summary_sm2l6m1_7_001.en: After solving the mechanisms of the second Ancient Sword Stele, you hear a terrifying sound from the bottom of the dale. You must move forward and quickly.

summary_sm2l6m1_8_001.cn: 你们击败盘踞在此的猛兽之后，“小机灵”留下了礼物，而后回归到了它的伙伴中间。
summary_sm2l6m1_8_001.en: After you defeat the local beasts, "Smartie" leaves you a gift and returns to its companions.

summary_sm2l6m1_9_001.cn: 你们终于进入了遗迹宝库，其中储存着许多书卷。陈千语提议先查找一下和“赤霄剑法”相关的内容。
summary_sm2l6m1_9_001.en: You finally enter the ruin's treasure vault where countless scrolls are stored. Chen suggests searching for information regarding "Chi Xiao Swordmancy" first.

summary_sm2l7m1_13_001.cn: 你帮忙打开了箱子，发现里面存放着的是几件乐器。这时，你遇见了前来找你的诀和佩丽卡。诀提出由她来协助嵘执行任务，你担心诀的伤势，便跟她们一起行动。
summary_sm2l7m1_13_001.en: You open the crate and find several musical instruments inside. Arcane and Perlica arrive at your location right after your discovery. Arcane wants to help Precipice with his task and you decide to join them out of concerns for Arcane's injuries.

summary_sm2l7m1_14_001.cn: 你们根据线索，找到了出身宏南戏班的大厨沈海，将一把二胡交给了他。沈海告诉了你们更多关于戏班的事，以及另一位戏班成员——巡卫李良良——的位置。
summary_sm2l7m1_14_001.en: You follow the lead and find Shen Hai. The chef used to be a member of the South Hongshan Troupe and you return an erhu. Shen Hai shares more stories about the touring troupe and the location of another troupe member, a watchguard named Li Liangliang.

summary_sm2l7m1_15_001.cn: 你们找到了被蚀影袭击而受伤的李良良。李良良告诉了你们更多关于宏南戏班的事，但她并不知道除了沈海外的其他戏班成员在哪儿。
summary_sm2l7m1_15_001.en: You find Li Liangliang. She has been ambushed and wounded by Blightshades. The watchguard tells you more about the South Hongshan Troupe. With the exception of Shen Hai, she does not know where the other troupe members are.

summary_sm2l7m1_16_001.cn: 在你们一筹莫展之际，李良良收到了召集巡卫寻找失联的天师轻竹的消息。
summary_sm2l7m1_16_001.en: The search hits a wall, but Li Liangliang suddenly receives a call asking the watchguards to look for a Tianshi named Qingzhu.

summary_sm2l7m1_1_001.cn: 你在北部禁区碰见了需要帮助的应龙队员——嵘，他正为一个因源石电路损坏而无法打开的箱子感到苦恼。
summary_sm2l7m1_1_001.en: You meet an Yinglung with the codename of Precipice. He is frustrated by a crate that refuses to open due to its damaged Originium circuitry.

summary_sm2l7m1_7_001.cn: 你们救出了正遭受蚀影袭击的天师轻竹，蓝衫正好也在那里保护她。你们从轻竹那里得知了更多关于宏南戏班的事，这时，嵘与你们取得了联系，原来你们已经回到了寻找戏班成员的起点。
summary_sm2l7m1_7_001.en: Lan Shan is trying to protect Tianshi Qingzhu from attacking Blightshades. You intervene and rescue her. The Tianshi then tells you more about the South Hongshan Troupe. Precipice contacts you, saying you've returned to your starting point in the search for the troupe members.

summary_sm2l7m1_8_001.cn: 你们回到了最初的起点，线索到这里就中断了。正当蓝衫想要为自己赋予无论如何都要将笛子交给戏班成员的使命时，他的哥哥峰也赶了过来。你们告诉蓝衫，或许他可以自己接下这支笛子。
summary_sm2l7m1_8_001.en: You return to the starting point but all the leads end there. Just when Lan Shan is about to give himself the mission of returning the flute to its rightful owner, his older brother Summit arrives. You advise Lan Shan that he should inherit the flute.

summary_sm2l7m1_9_001.cn: 在你们离开后，峰向蓝衫展示如何吹奏笛子，几次尝试后，蓝衫终于吹出了声。
summary_sm2l7m1_9_001.en: After you leave, Summit shows Lan Shan how to play the flute. The young watchguard manages to play a note after several tries.

summary_sm2l8m1_10_001.cn: 蚀影被你们击败后，你们找到了阿生哥哥的遗物。这时你们突然意识到，刚才与你们战斗的或许正是阿生哥哥的蚀影。伙伴们都已经找到了亲人的遗物，你们决定在周围继续寻找黎风父母的相关线索。
summary_sm2l8m1_10_001.en: After defeating the Blightshade, you recover the belongings of Ah Sheng's brother and realize you might have just fought his Blightshade. Since Lifeng's friends have found their families' belongings, you decide to focus the search on clues about Lifeng's parents.

summary_sm2l8m1_11_001.cn: 你们找到了黎风当年的撤离登记，决定跟随这条线索前往谈剑堂北侧的锈器堆。
summary_sm2l8m1_11_001.en: You found Lifeng's evacuation registration and decide to follow this lead. Together, you head towards the Rust Mound north of Tanjian Hall.

summary_sm2l8m1_14_001.cn: 经过一番寻找，你们找到了黎风父母相关的线索。这时，远处突然传来了一阵惊呼。
summary_sm2l8m1_14_001.en: After an extended search, you finally find clues about Lifeng's parents. Right after the discovery, you hear panicked shouts in the distance.

summary_sm2l8m1_15_001.cn: 你们击败了蚀影，但这次你们没有在附近找到任何与黎风父母遗物有关的线索。
summary_sm2l8m1_15_001.en: You defeat the Blightshade. However, the victory does not reveal any clues or leave any belongings of Lifeng's parents.

summary_sm2l8m1_16_001.cn: 你找到黎风，倾听了他内心的想法。这时，附近的天师与职农围了过来，在众人的宽慰下，黎风想到了该怎么祭奠亲人。
summary_sm2l8m1_16_001.en: You find Lifeng and listen to him. The Tianshi and farmers gather around to comfort the young watchguard. Lifeng then has an idea to pay respects to his parents.

summary_sm2l8m1_17_001.cn: 你们一起祭奠了黎风的父母。虽然没有找到黎风父母留下的物品，但黎风却已经找到了父母留下的“遗物”。黎风自己，和对他们的记忆，就是他们传承的证明。
summary_sm2l8m1_17_001.en: Together, you pay respects to Lifeng's parents. Although you fail to find anything that belonged to Lifeng's parents, the young watchguard has discovered his parents' true relic. Lifeng himself and his memories of them are proof of their legacy.

summary_sm2l8m1_18_001.cn: 你们来到了选剑局器物库，遇见了在这里吊唁的选剑局天师们，其中就有连晓雾。但你们暂时没有在人群中看见阿生和小然。
summary_sm2l8m1_18_001.en: You arrive at the Bureau Arsenal. Lian Xiaowu and other Tianshi from the Bureau of Swordmancers are grieving and paying their respects. However, you do not see Ah Sheng or Xiao Ran in the group.

summary_sm2l8m1_19_001.cn: 你们来到了谈剑堂北侧的锈器堆，但黎风却停下了脚步，向你袒露了他内心的想法。
summary_sm2l8m1_19_001.en: Lifeng and you arrive at the Rust Mound north of Tanjian Hall. The lad suddenly stops and starts describing his feelings.

summary_sm2l8m1_1_001.cn: 你来到息壤研究所门口，找到了正准备进入的黎风。一番交谈后，你决定陪黎风一同寻找遗物。
summary_sm2l8m1_1_001.en: You arrive at the entrance of the Xiranite Research Labs and find Lifeng who is just about to head in. After a short discussion, you decide to accompany Lifeng and find his parents' belongings together.

summary_sm2l8m1_24_001.cn: 与阿生交谈后，你们决定在附近寻找小然母亲的遗物。
summary_sm2l8m1_24_001.en: After talking to Ah Sheng, you decide to look for the belongings of Xiao Ran's mother.

summary_sm2l8m1_25_001.cn: 将找到小然母亲遗物的消息告诉她后，你们决定继续寻找阿生和黎风亲人的遗物。
summary_sm2l8m1_25_001.en: After telling Xiao Ran about the discovery of her mother's belongings, you decide to help Ah Sheng and Lifeng find things that belonged to their loved ones.

summary_sm2l8m1_26_001.cn: 你们找到了更多关于黎风亲人的线索，但并没有找到与阿生亲人遗物有关的事物。这时，黎风表示想要再多留一会儿，帮助悲伤的连晓雾。
summary_sm2l8m1_26_001.en: You find more clues about Lifeng's parents but still cannot locate anything belonging to Ah Sheng's brother. Lifeng hopes he can stay here and help comfort a grieving Lian Xiaowu.

summary_sm2l8m1_2_001.cn: 你们遇见了在息壤研究所参与清理与重建工作的白霜。了解完情况，你们分头继续寻找遗物。
summary_sm2l8m1_2_001.en: You run into Bai Shuang who is also cleaning up and rebuilding the Xiranite Research Labs. After learning about the situation, you decide to speed up the search by splitting the group.

summary_sm2l8m1_3_001.cn: 你们将遗物交还给了白霜，白霜也将她找到的关于黎风父母的线索交给了你们。她还告诉了你们，另外两位伙伴——阿生与小然也要来，他们打算前往选剑局器物库。
summary_sm2l8m1_3_001.en: You give Bai Shuang her father's belongings. She also shares with you clues she has found about Lifeng's parents. Bai Shuang then tells you that two more friends, Ah Sheng and Xiao Ran, are also coming. They are planning to look around the Bureau Arsenal.

summary_sm2l8m1_4_001.cn: 黎风站在息壤研究所门前沉思，他为白霜回想起儿时经历感到高兴，但也为自己模糊的记忆感到悲伤。最终，你们决定前往选剑局器物库，与阿生和小然会合。
summary_sm2l8m1_4_001.en: At the entrance of the Xiranite Research Labs, Lifeng begins to ponder. He feels happy about Bai Shuang remembering her childhood, but sad about his own fuzzy memories of the past. You decide to head to the Bureau Arsenal and meet up with Ah Sheng and Xiao Ran.

summary_sm2l8m1_5_001.cn: 穿过满面悲戚的天师们，你们找到了阿生。
summary_sm2l8m1_5_001.en: You walk past the emotional and grieving Tianshi and find Ah Sheng.

summary_sm2l8m1_6_001.cn: 你们帮助小然找到了她母亲的遗物，并将这一消息告诉了她。
summary_sm2l8m1_6_001.en: You help Xiao Ran find her mother's belongings and toast the discovery to her.

summary_sm2l8m1_7_001.cn: 听完连晓雾的倾诉后，她也帮你们推测出了关于黎风与阿生亲人的线索，你们决定通知阿生一同前往旧居民区。
summary_sm2l8m1_7_001.en: After Lian Xiaowu pours out her heart and soul, the Tianshi helps you deduce more leads about Lifeng and Ah Sheng's families. You decide to toast Ah Sheng and rendezvous at the old residential area.

summary_sm2l8m1_8_001.cn: 你们与阿生在旧居民区会合后，开始寻找亲人遗物相关的线索。
summary_sm2l8m1_8_001.en: You rendezvous with Ah Sheng at the Old Residential Area and begin looking for clues about Lifeng and Ah Sheng's families.

summary_sm2l8m1_9_001.cn: 你们在寻找线索的过程中，遭遇了蚀影的袭击。
summary_sm2l8m1_9_001.en: While searching for clues, you are suddenly ambushed by Blightshades.

summary_sm2l9m1_1_001.cn: 提弗洛斯在大石碑附近找到了有关雪祀去向的线索，邀请你同她一起再度进入梦境中。
summary_sm2l9m1_1_001.en: Typhoeus discovers clues about the Snowpriestess's whereabouts near the big stone stele. She invites you to dive into the dreamscape with her.

summary_sm2l9m1_22_001.cn: 从梦中回到现实，你与提弗洛斯一起见证了雪祀的结局，尽管感慨颇多，但你们还是决定静静离开，不再打扰她安眠。
summary_sm2l9m1_22_001.en: From the dreams to reality, you and Typhoeus witness the final moments of the Snowpriestess. It has been a deeply sentimental journey, but in the end, you decide to leave quietly and not disturb her rest.

summary_sm2l9m1_7_001.cn: 启动通往梦境的仪式后，提弗洛斯有些犹豫，她还没有准备好面对雪祀真正的结局。而你说服她前往梦中，一起为雪祀的故事画上句号。
summary_sm2l9m1_7_001.en: The ritual for entering dreamscape has been started. Typhoeus is a little hesitant. She is not ready to witness what finally happened to the Snowpriestess. You persuade her to dive into dreamscape. Together, you will conclude the Snowpriestess's story.
